zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_ERROR_HUMANS_REQUIRED_TT: 无法开始游戏。所有开放的玩家槽位填满后才能开始游戏。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_MAP_WORLD_BUILDER_MAPS_TOOLTIP: 只显示地图生成器地图。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_PLAYER_COLOR_COLLISION: 该文明的配色与其他文明相冲突。请从下拉列表中重新选择喜欢的其他配色。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_PLAYER_PARAMETER_ERROR_POPUP: 造成此结果的常见原因是游戏选项设为不允许重复，而实际却选择了重复的领袖或文明。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_RESTORE_DEFAULT_TT: 将所有参数恢复到默认值。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION: 创建帝国的旅程从这里开始，从卑微的最初到伟大卓越，以此谱写您的历史。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]您会通过伟大战役征服世界，还是成为第一个派遣国民探索太空的人？您会用自己的国民文化影响世界，还是将自己的信仰传遍世界各个角落？[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]时间会证明一切…[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]所有伟大文明都是从一位伟大领袖开始。从下方教程中选择您想体验的文明。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_TUTORIAL_LEADER_1: 埃及帝国的克利欧佩特拉统治着拥有强大盟友和伟大的城市建造者的文明。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SETUP_TUTORIAL_LEADER_2: 苏美尔帝国的吉尔伽美什统治着辽阔土地，他本人也是一位受人尊敬的征服者。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SIEGE_RANGED_DEFENSE_DESCRIPTION: 防御远程攻击时+10战斗力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SLOTTYPE_CLOSED_TT: 玩家无法使用已关闭的槽位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SLOTTYPE_HUMANREQ_TT: 真人玩家加入开放的位置后方可开始游戏。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_SLOTTYPE_OPEN_TT: 加入游戏的玩家可占有空缺槽位。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_STAGING_ROOM_COPY_JOIN_CODE: 点击“加入密码”即可复制
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_STANDARD_CLOUD_SAVES_HELP: 标准云储存 – 可与PC，Mac和Linux版本兼容。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_START_WAITING_FOR_TURN_TT: 点击查看当前游戏世界状态。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_CVS_MALAYSIA_UA_D: 无法建造圣地区、获得大预言家，或创建宗教。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_CVS_MALAYSIA_CSQ] 完成已经被其他文明宗主城邦的任务时，额外奖励 1 个 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者。每宗主一个城邦，则 +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1海岸。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_CVS_SWITZERLAND_U: 获得城邦“日内瓦”的宗主国效果：[ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡提供 +5% [ICON_Science] 科技开销。[NEWLINE]训练间谍时 +50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。敌方间谍在我方城市中，效力降低 1 级。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4草原山脉、T4平原山脉。
获得城邦“日内瓦”的宗主国效果：[ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡提供 +5% [ICON_Science] 科技开销。[NEWLINE]训练间谍时 +50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。敌方间谍在我方城市中，效力降低 1 级。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4草原山脉、T4平原山脉。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_LEU_ARGENTINA_DES: 获得 [ICON_ENVOY] 城邦“布宜诺斯艾利斯”的宗主国效果：加成资源如同奢侈品资源一样，每种类型资源提供 1 点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE]“帝国初期”市政后，牧场提供 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；并为圣地、学院、工业区和剧院广场提供大量相邻加成。宫殿提供 2 个 [ICON_GreatWork_MUSIC] 音乐巨作槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3牧场资源。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_LIME_TEO_MEN_BECO: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线会根据所宗主城邦类型获得额外产出：[NEWLINE]宗主宗教城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]宗主军事或工业城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]宗主贸易城邦则获得 +3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]宗主科技城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE]宗主文化城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]若宗主两个同样类型城邦，则额外产出增至三倍。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_LIME_THULE_HUNTIN: 猎人小屋可为相邻的单元格提供额外产出：[NEWLINE]冻土单元格+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物（雪地则翻倍）；[NEWLINE]营地和渔船+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]玩家通过科技或文化每进入一个新时代，在 [ICON_Capital] 首都获得一个“鲸鱼猎人”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T2海岸、T1冻土。特殊：更深的冻土。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_MER_KALEVALA_DESC: 冻土和冻土丘陵的非市中心单元格上：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]树林或资源提供 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物（不可叠加）；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]拥有“法典”市政后，魅力值为“惊艳”的资源提供 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有“政治哲学”市政后即可在古树林 2 个单元格范围内栽种树林。建成 3 个古树林后，在 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都获得 1 个自然学家。购买自然学家的 [ICON_FAITH] 花费 -50%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1冻土、T4树林。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_CVS_ESCHER_UA_DESCRIPTI: 商业中心和工业区从山脉获得标准相邻加成。[NEWLINE]位于山脉 2 个单元格范围内的城市：修建市场、银行、工作坊和工厂时 +100% [ICON_Production] 生产力；“帝国初期”市政后，+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_CVS_ISKANDAR_UA_DESCRIP: “帝国初期”市政后，建立在海岸 3 个单元格范围内的城市获得 1 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口（包括已经建立的）。[NEWLINE]海军近战单位 +1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_GEDEMO_BISMARK_DESCRIPT: 解锁科技铸铜术后，立即解锁商业中心。军营区域从商业中心获得标准 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值相邻加成，从商业同业公会获得大量 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力相邻加成。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_JFD_CABEIRI_MYSTERIES_D: “政治哲学”市政后，军营提供的 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数 +1。皇家学堂+1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] 影响力点数。可以使用 [Icon_Faith] 信仰值购买军营内建筑。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]创立  [ICON_Religion] 宗教后，信仰马其顿的宗教且拥有皇家学堂的己方城市，每个 [ICON_Citizen] 人口提供 +0.5 [Icon_Science] 科技值。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_JFD_CABEIRI_MYSTERIES_E: 我们因众神的光辉而欢欣。获得+{1_Num} [COLOR_GREEN][ICON_ENVOY] 使者[ENDCOLOR]。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_JFD_CABEIRI_MYSTERIES_P: 他人听闻了我们关于宙斯之子的愿景。获得+{1_Num} [COLOR_GREEN][ICON_GREATGENERAL] 大将军点数[ENDCOLOR]和+{2_Num} [COLOR_GREEN][ICON_GREATPROPHET] 大预言家点数[ENDCOLOR]。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LEU_EVITA_DESCRIPTION: 建造剧院广场和工业区时获得1 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口。这两个区域还额外提供+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物和 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LEU_ROCA_DESCRIPTION: 在文明边境旁作战时获得 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力加成。在己方堡垒或牧场旁击败敌方单位时，获得所有相邻单元格。完成"骑马"科技后可建造庄园区域。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LEU_SANMARTIN_DESCRIPTI: 击败敌方单位时获得 3 点 [ICON_GreatPerson] 大将军和 3 点 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] 大音乐家伟人点数（联机速度下）。[NEWLINE]近战、远程单位和摇滚乐队 +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力， [ICON_PROMOTION] 晋升时不会结束回合。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LIME_PHOE_AHIRAM_MERCHA: 国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线从起源于腓尼基城市里的每一个奢侈品资源获得+0.5 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力和2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。在解锁“写作”科技之后可建造特色建筑“皇家陵墓”。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LIME_TEO_OWL_FIRE_IS_BO: 建造完波奇特卡聚集地和大使馆建筑分别获得+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。解锁特色 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督：“西雅赫·卡克”。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LIME_THULE_DAVE_HEART_N: 侦察单位在冻土或雪地开始回合时+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力和+5 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LL_TEKINICH_II_WRATH_OF: 当进入古典时代后，首都6环内的军事单位-2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。首都6环外的军事单位+4 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。每启动一个 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡时刻，为所有单位回复5点生命值并获得2点经验值。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_MER_OUR_HOMES_OUR_FAITH: 所有单位受伤带来的战斗力减益 -50%。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TURNLIMIT_CUSTOM_DESCRIPTION: 在完成规定数量的回合后，游戏结束。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TURNPHASE_DYNAMIC_DESC: 处于和平状态的玩家同时进行回合。处于交战状态的玩家按顺序进行回合。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TURNTIMER_DYNAMIC_DESC: 回合时间受到游戏中城市和单位数量的影响。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TURNTIMER_NONE_DESC: 玩家在没有时间限制的情况下进行各自的回合。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TURNTIMER_STANDARD_DESC: 回合时间取决于回合时间选项（以秒为单位）。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIVROYALE_INTRO_BODY: 欢迎来到末日世界！在行将就木的星球上，各方势力将在“红死风暴”中互相混战，争夺文明的最后一丝微光。玩家的目标是成为最后一个存活的势力，登上最后一艘飞船离开这个破败之地。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIVROYALE_INTRO_DETAILS: 游戏中无城市和外交系统。最后一个平民单位被俘或被杀后，便宣告玩家游戏失败。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIVROYALE_RED_DEATH_BODY: 红死风暴是一种放射性风暴。随着红死风暴不断吞噬世界，安全区也将不断缩小。安全区和受到红死风暴影响的区域将在地图上标出。小心别被红死风暴吞没！
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIVROYALE_RED_DEATH_DETAILS: 处于红死风暴区域中的单位每回合将受到伤害。处于水域中的单位每回合也将受到伤害。赶紧逃离这个灾祸肆虐的星球吧。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIVROYALE_UNITS_BODY: 调查城市废墟、清理劫掠者哨站所和收集空投补给均可得到新单位并获得经验值。以上是获得新单位的仅有手段，所以发起进攻前务必三思！
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIVROYALE_UNITS_DETAILS: 指派单位护送平民，使其免遭俘虏和杀害，这点也十分重要。此情景中的单位可获得全新升级，帮助您在这片法外废土上生存下去。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_NEW_TO_STRATEGY: 不熟悉回合制策略游戏。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_CREW_BODY: 舰队规模越大，掠夺能力越强。利用船员来俘获受伤的敌方船只，并将他们添加到您日益壮大的海盗帝国中。船员还可以加入海岸巡逻队，搜索并埋藏隐匿的宝藏。船只与港口的市中心相邻时，您可以使用“造访酒馆”操作来招募新船员。每次造访酒馆时还将获得一张新的藏宝图。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_CREW_DETAILS: 注意！您的海盗军团都是一帮贪图钱财的亡命徒。您将根据舰队中的船只数量每回合损失金币。如果金币库存长期低迷，将发生叛变。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_INTRO_BODY: “大海盗时代”是供1到4名玩家游戏的快节奏情景，以海盗时代为背景，持续时间60回合。游戏目标是在回合限制中获得最多的声望。游戏能在著名的历史海盗胜地加勒比群岛或随机生成的群岛上进行。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_INTRO_DETAILS: “大海盗时代”中不需要城市。玩家初始便拥有一艘能够出海的旗舰，并能随游戏进展获得更多船只。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_SCORING_BODY: 获得声望的方式有三种：[NEWLINE]宝藏、极恶海盗与战斗。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]宝藏[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+30 - 埋藏宝箱[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+20 - 击沉运宝船[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+5 - 掠夺宝箱[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+2 - 掠夺建筑或区域[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+1 - 掠夺贸易路线[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+1 - 掠夺改良设施[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]极恶海盗[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+15 - 掠夺港口[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+20-50 - 击沉极恶海盗的船只[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+5 - 肃清残暴海盗堡垒[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]战斗[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+10 - 摧毁或俘获另一位玩家的单位[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+5 - 摧毁或俘获殖民势力单位[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+5 - 摧毁或俘获残暴海盗单位[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+1 - 在战斗中存活
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_TREASURE_BODY: 宝藏是海盗生活的核心要义。宝箱可能漂浮在海上，也可能被埋在地下。埋藏宝藏即可将金币转换为声望。宝箱中包含金币和海盗遗物。请务必藏好宝藏，因为其他海盗会来偷取您的金币和声望。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]海盗遗物十分强大，拥有特殊游戏效果与加成。在宝箱、运宝船和酒馆中有时能够找到遗物。您可以同时装备3件遗物，并随时进行修改。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_TUTORIAL_PIRATES_TREASURE_DETAILS: 宝藏舰队将不时起航前往欧洲。其携带有大量金币和遗物，但守卫严密。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不太平的海域中还存在历史上真实存在的极恶海盗。击沉他们即可增加您的声望。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UI_PEDIA_ABILITY_INACTIVE_DESC: 必须满足特殊要求才能激活。查看说明了解更多。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UI_PEDIA_MADE_OBSOLETE_BY: 随着发展会被以下替代
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UI_PEDIA_MADE_REMOVED_IF: 游戏开始的时代如晚于以下时代，则移除
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UI_PEDIA_PLACEMENT_ADJ_TO_CITY: 必须靠近市中心，且需要有一个相邻的河流、湖泊、绿洲或山脉
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UI_PEDIA_PLACEMENT_ADJ_TO_COAST: 必须放置在靠近陆地的海岸上
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CVS_MALAYSIA_UU_DESCRIPTION: 马来西亚文艺复兴时期特色海军近战单位，替代轻快帆船，拥有更高的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。消灭敌方单位时恢复 20 点生命值。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CVS_SWITZERLAND_UU_DESCRIPTION: 瑞士中世纪时期特色单位，取代长矛兵。这是一种具有抗骑兵特性的特殊单位。解锁于“雇佣兵”市政。造价更低。拥有一组独特的 [ICON_PROMOTION] 晋升，且每次 [ICON_PROMOTION] 晋升从以下选项中随机选择 3 个。无需维护费，初始获得 1 次 [ICON_PROMOTION] 晋升。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]戟兵：攻击时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]长枪方阵：防御时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]先锋：攻击受伤单位时+7 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]楔形阵：可击退敌方单位。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]赫尔维蒂战法：攻击后可移动。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]纵队：+100% 夹击加成。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]州旗：忽略来自丘陵的 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力惩罚。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_LEU_GAUCHO_DESCRIPTION: 阿根廷特色现代近战单位，替代步兵，解锁于“动员”市政。无法从大将军处获得 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力加成。能忽视控制区。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_LEU_GRANADERO_DESCRIPTION: 何塞·德·圣马丁的特色骑兵单位，替代骑兵，通过"民族主义"解锁。除普通近战攻击外还拥有较弱的远程攻击，受伤时不承受战斗力减益。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_LIME_TEO_OWL_WARRIOR_DESC: 特奧蒂瓦坎特色古典时期近战单位，替代“剑士”，解锁于“政治哲学”市政。+1视野并且生产时不消耗[ICON_RESOURCE_IRON] 铁资源。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_LIME_THULE_DOGSLED_DESCRIPTION: 图勒远古时代特色侦查单位，替代侦察兵。拥有一次 [ICON_CHARGES] 劳动力次数，能建造猎人小屋。

zh_Hans_CN.LOC_POLICY_CULTURE_EDUCATION_DESCRIPTION: 每回合的 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、[ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家和 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数 +4。每有一个古罗马剧场，每回合的 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家点数便 +2；每有一个艺术博物馆，每回合的 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大作家点数便 +2；每有一个广播中心，每回合的 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数便 +4。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_POLICY_PEACEFUL_EVOLUTION_DESCRIPTIO: 其他文明对您的 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩减少 20%。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_POLICY_WAR_HOSPITAL_DESCRIPTION: 所有军事单位每回合恢复的生命值 +20。
zh_Hans_CN.LOC_UNIT_CCB_THULE_WHALEMAKER_DESCRIPTIO: 图勒特色陆地支援单位。拥有 1 [ICON_CHARGES] 次劳动力，可以消耗1点 [ICON_CHARGES] 劳动力和1 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口在海岸单元格上创造奢侈品资源 [ICON_RESOURCE_WHALES] “鲸鱼”。 [NEWLINE]无法训练或购买，只能通过技能获得。可以在城市间传送，解锁“占星术”科技后可以下海。
zh_Hans_CN.TRAIT_BANNOCKBURN_EXTRA_MOVEMENT_DESC: 从丘陵单元格上开始回合时+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。（班诺克本）

en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_MAP_DESCRIPTION: Map used exclusively for the tutorial.
en_US.LOC_TECH_DAWN_OF_CIVILIZATION_DESCRIPTIO: Prerequisite knowledge for the dawn of civilization
en_US.LOC_TECH_DAWN_OF_CIVILIZATION_QUOTE_1: In the beginning, the earth was without form. And void. And then the sun shone upon the sleeping earth. Into this swirling maelstrom of fire air and water, the first stirrings of life appeared.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_INTRO: As your advisor I am qualified to assist you in all matters related to ruling our civilization.[NEWLINE]If you do not require my service, you can dismiss me to attend to other matters.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_1: Greetings My Liege! As your personal advisor, I am qualified to assist you in all matters related to ruling our civilization. I am at your service.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_2: All great civilizations begin with a great city, and our Settlers have found an ideal location. Order them to found a new city here.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_3: Well done! You have founded your first city. From these roots your civilization will grow to stand the test of time. Now you must nurture and protect what you have created.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_4: Security is of great importance. There are barbaric tribes near us who want nothing more than to pillage and plunder what is ours.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_5: Direct the production efforts of this city to train Warriors to deal with this impending threat.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_6: Training has begun, but it will be some time before our new Warriors are ready. There are no further matters to attend to right now.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_7: Your city is busy training Warriors for its defense, but a great civilization cannot thrive on military might alone. We have people talented in the ways of science and discovery. You should employ them in researching new technologies which will advance our civilization.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_8: Wise decision, Your Majesty. This technology will let us better extract the riches from the earth and increase [ICON_Production] Production in our cities. I will let you know when we have finished our research.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_9: Your Majesty, hostile Barbarians have been seen near our [ICON_Capital] Capital. If left alone they are sure to attack our people and pillage our lands. Your newly trained Warriors await your orders to attack!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_10: Our Warriors were victorious! They fought well to defend our people against this threat. However, the Barbarians are still envious of our civilization. We should be prepared in case they return in greater force.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_11: There are other matters, Your Excellency.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_12: Since Warrior training is complete, it is time to assign a new production task to the city.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_13: The lands surrounding our city could be bountiful if we develop them. We should train Builders to create improvements to the lands within our borders.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_14: There are mysteries that await us outside our borders in the uncharted lands beyond. The only way to find out is to explore.
en_US.LOC_META_14_BODY: At the beginning of the game, your city and the lands immediately around it are revealed, but the areas beyond, represented by blank parchment, indicate parts of the world you have not yet explored.
en_US.LOC_META_16_BODY: Warrior units have a [ICON_Movement] Movement range of 2.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The blue colored indicator shown on the lands around the unit displays the furthest the selected unit can move in a single turn.
en_US.LOC_META_17_BODY: Open terrain, like Plains and Grassland, only consume 1 [ICON_Movement] Movement point, whereas more difficult terrain, like Woods and Hills, will consume 2 or more [ICON_Movement] Movement points. Move the Warrior unit to the highlighted location by right clicking.
en_US.LOC_META_17b_BODY: RIGHT-CLICK the highlighted location to move your Warrior.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_15: Your Majesty, our Warriors have discovered a small Tribal Village whose inhabitants are welcoming and friendly. Shall we investigate it and send the Warriors to speak with them?
en_US.LOC_META_18_BODY: Exploring Tribal Villages can give your civilization one of many instant benefits, like granting an additional [ICON_Citizen] Population in your city, or awarding [ICON_Gold] Gold. It is a good strategy to explore as many Tribal Villages as possible.
en_US.LOC_META_20_BODY: To explore a Tribal Village, move one of your units into the Tribal Village hex. Try moving your Warrior unit there now.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_16: It appears that the Tribal Villagers are also harassed by the Barbarians. They are impressed by our culture, and have decided to join us in the fight!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_17: Good news indeed! They are skillful Scouts and wily travelers. They can move faster than our Warriors, making them ideal for exploring the surrounding lands, but they are not as strong in combat. They eagerly await your orders.
en_US.LOC_META_21_BODY: Notice that the Scout unit has a [ICON_Movement] Movement of 3, allowing it to move a greater distance than other units. Move the Scout unit toward an undiscovered part of the map.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_18: Scouts are excellent at exploring, but they are not as strong in combat as our Warriors. It is better to have them focus on exploration and survival rather than fighting our enemies.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_19: A team of Builders has finished their training in our city. They are ready to work on improving the surrounding lands. There are ideal locations for the growing of [ICON_Food] Food to support our populace. Constructing a Farm there would increase our yield from those lands.
en_US.LOC_META_22_BODY: Builders can construct a wide variety of improvements to your land. The type of improvement they can build on a plot is often determined by the type of terrain. Plains and Grassland plots are ideal for Farms, which help increase [ICON_Citizen] Population.
en_US.LOC_META_23_BODY: Move your Builder to the highlighted Plains area next to your city.
en_US.LOC_META_24_BODY: Construct a Farm improvement here by clicking on the "Build Improvement: Farm" button next to the Unit Panel.
en_US.LOC_META_25_BODY: Constructing a Farm here has increased the [ICON_Food] Food yield from this plot from 1 [ICON_Food] Food per turn to 2. The amount of [ICON_Food] Food generated by your city determines how fast the Population of that city grows, granting you new [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to work more tiles. More [ICON_Food] Food means faster growth.
en_US.LOC_META_26_BODY: Builders can build up to 3 improvements before exhausting their workforce. This number is indicated in the Unit Panel. This Builder unit has consumed one of its workforce from building the Farm and now has 2 remaining.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_20: Your Majesty, it is once again time to choose where to direct the production efforts of our city. Your leadership is without equal and our civilization continues to thrive. Shall we construct a Monument to honor our civilization's growing greatness?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_SELECT_END_TURN: There are no more pressing issues at this time. Shall we continue with our duties?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_2: Our explorers on the frontier have discovered a Barbarian camp. This is the source of the Barbarians threatening our region. We must destroy this stronghold, or they will continue to plague us.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_3: I would advise you to use caution. The Barbarian camp is heavily defended by their best troops and will be hard to take. We should send an assault force of multiple military units to ensure victory.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_BARBARIAN_CAMP_DISCO: In developing your military, it is always a good strategy to diversify. Not all units are created equal, some are better against others, and have abilities that separate them from the rest.
en_US.LOC_META_124_BODY: In developing your military, it is always a good strategy to diversify. Not all units are created equal, some are better against others, and have abilities that separate them from the rest.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_7: Our explorers have spotted another friendly Tribal Village. I suggest we send our Scouts to investigate it.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_8: A good city can become a great city through careful planning. Deciding where to place a city district is an important decision. Be sure to pick a location best suited to reap the most benefit.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_4: Your Excellency, I am happy to announce that because of our city's prosperity, our [ICON_Citizen] Population has grown!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_CITY_POPULATION_CHAN: The [ICON_Citizen] Population of your first city has grown from 1 to 2. As long as a city is well fed and its people are happy, it will continue to grow. The [ICON_Citizen] Citizens of the city work the surrounding plots and improvements contributing to greater yields. Higher [ICON_Citizen] Populations contribute to faster [ICON_Science] Science research, faster city [ICON_Production] Production, and faster [ICON_Culture] Cultural growth.
en_US.LOC_META_125_BODY: The [ICON_Citizen] Population of your first city has grown from 1 to 2. As long as a city is well fed and its people are happy, it will continue to grow. The [ICON_Citizen] Citizens of the city work the surrounding plots and improvements contributing to greater yields. Higher [ICON_Citizen] Populations contribute to faster [ICON_Science] Science research, faster city [ICON_Production] Production, and faster [ICON_Culture] Cultural growth.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_CITY_POPULATION_CHAN: It is always a good strategy to not only found new cities to expand your realm, but also to grow those cities.
en_US.LOC_META_126_BODY: It is always a good strategy to not only found new cities to expand your realm, but also to grow those cities.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_MESSAGE_NATURAL_WONDER_REVEA: In Civilization VI, you can get Eureka Moments that boost your technology research through in game achievements. This Eureka Moment was gained by discovering a natural wonder. Other achievements could be winning a battle with a specific unit or constructing a building. Achieving these greatly accelerates your technological progress.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_1: Through exploration we have discovered a natural wonder of the world. There is no doubt that it could provide a great benefit to the one who settles the lands surrounding it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_2: Reconnaissance units like Scouts are unique in that they can gain experience by exploring and discovering parts of the world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_3: The workforce of our Builder unit has been expended. We will need to train more Builders to continue building improvements on the lands surrounding our cities.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_4: Enacting new policies in our government can be of great benefit. Our people await your decree.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_5: The opportunity has arrived for a change into a new and more powerful system of government. Let us strengthen our identity and enact more policies to govern our people.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_6: We have the opportunity to develop a formal Trade Route between two cities. A Trader unit is required to establish such a route, which would be very beneficial for our economy.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_7: In addition to bringing riches to our civilization, this Trade Route will gradually develop Roads between our cities. Roads allow our units to no longer be impaired by the difficult terrain through which they pass.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_9: This military unit has proven themselves. From the experience they have gained in combat they are eligible to be granted a promotion. How will you award these brave souls?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_10: The combat achievements of this unit have become legendary, and worthy of a name unique to them. With what title shall we honor them?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_11: The health of this unit is very low and in danger of being lost. Allowing a unit to take a break from combat and rest will allow it to heal over time.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_12: It is best to use caution when moving close to enemy units. Doing so will often force the unit to be in the enemy's 'zone of control', restricting its movement.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_13: My liege, our city would do well with some farms or other improvements. I suggest we train a Builder soon.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_14: Our Builders have been idle. Perhaps we should direct their efforts to improving the lands around our city.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_15: Our capital flourishes! But I think it is time that we begin establishing roots elsewhere. Perhaps we should train a Settler.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_16: My liege, we have an Envoy at our disposal. We can use the Envoy to gain favor with a city-state. Becoming friendly with a city-state neighbor can be greatly beneficial to our civilization.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_17: Our City-State neighbors have made a request of us. If we can impress them, I think they will reward us handsomely.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_18: I'm afraid I must report that we are bankrupt. It is imperative that we do whatever we can to ease ourselves of this debt. May I suggest we disband some of our military?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_19: Your grace, I must warn you that some of the improved lands around our city have been pillaged. We should find those responsible and ensure no more damage can be done.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_20: We have recently gained advanced knowledge in city planning. Creating districts in our cities can be much more powerful and lucrative than simple improvements like Farms and Mines.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_21: Our military has learned the way of combining two military units into larger scale Corps. These Corps units are much more powerful than their singular counterparts.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_22: Our military now is trained in the way of combining three military units into a single Army, much larger and more powerful than a Corps unit.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_23: Your Grace, we have obtained greater knowledge in the art of building static fortifications. Building Walls around our cities will not only make them stronger against a foreign invader, but will also allow them to bombard nearby enemies.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_24: Your grace! The enemy is at our gates, and this city is surrounded and under siege. Supplies and food cannot get through, and our city cannot heal its wounds. It is paramount that we break this encirclement.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_25: An enemy is in range of our city. Order the city garrison to conduct a ranged attack against the invaders.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_26: It is important to keep a close eye on our neighbors, and our people may be able to help. Listen carefully, for they are sometimes privy to more information than we are.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_27: My liege, we are beginning to attract the attention of the Great People of the world. Of course, there are other leaders vying for their attention, too.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_28: The more specialized districts we construct, the more we will draw in specialized Great People to share their talents with our civilization. I advise that we continue to build these.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_29: A famous artist is inspired by our civilization, and has come to our lands to create great works of art. I suggest we find somewhere to house these masterpieces immediately.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_30: This writer has been inspired by our civilization, and comes to our lands to create great works of writing. I suggest we find somewhere to house these masterpieces immediately.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_31: Our populace has attracted a Great Prophet to our lands! Send this most holy person to our Holy Site and rejoice, for the time has come to found a religion for ourselves.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_32: This musician is inspired by our civilization, and has come to our land to create great musical works. I suggest we find somewhere to house these masterpieces immediately.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_33: Our civilization's attention to the naval arm of our military has given rise to a Great Admiral among our ranks. When deployed wisely among our ships we are sure to have a distinct advantage in battle.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_34: Our civilization's dedication to military affairs has given rise to a Great General among our troops. When used wisely in the field, generals can change the tide of battle in our favor.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_35: A great merchant has come to our civilization! Each one has a unique talent which will help our economy flourish.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_36: Our dedication to the ways of science has attracted a great scientist to our civilization! I am certain we will be able to use them to benefit future scientific developments.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_37: Constructing wonders of the world not only is a remarkable display of our empire's greatness, they have other benefits as well. Remember, other civilizations may also be competing in this endeavor, and there can only be one of each type in the world.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_38: Just as our citizens have faith in your leadership, so they are beginning to have faith in a higher power. I think it is wise to cultivate this new way of thinking - perhaps there is some benefit to be gained.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_39: The number of faithful has grown, and it is time for us to define our beliefs. Let us choose a pantheon to worship.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_40: My liege, we have the ability to train religious missionaries to begin spreading our great religion to foreign lands.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_41: Your majesty, I believe that we may benefit from recruiting an apostle to spread our religion. These holy people are quite powerful in the ways of conversion.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_42: All other religions in the world are a threat to our faith. We can recruit Inquisitors to purge the heretics from our cities.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_43: Your Excellency, I feel it is time to build some Neighborhoods for our growing populous. We should build these on our most beautiful lands - near natural wonders, or perhaps by the Coast.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_44: My liege, all of our military has been destroyed and we are completely defenseless. Training military units is of utmost importance if we are to survive.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_45: Our explorers have spotted another friendly Tribal Village. I suggest we send a Scout to investigate.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_46: Your Majesty, keep your allies close and your enemies closer. We are now able to recruit a Spy who could help us better understand what it is that our neighbors do… On a more covert level.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_50: Some resources, like this one, can be harvested. This will remove the resource in exchange for an immediate gain.  But once it is removed, it will not come back.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_51: We have discovered a City-State! Establishing diplomatic relations with them will surely be beneficial for our empire. Perhaps we should send them an envoy…
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_52: There are several different types of City-States, and each may provide different benefits in return for our friendship. Our government, over time, will allow us to earn envoys to grow these relationships.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_53: We have trained our first ranged unit, capable of hitting enemies from afar, while out of the range of hand-to-hand combat.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_54: A siege unit! This will surely be useful if we choose to engage in a city attack.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_55: We are now skilled in the construction of walls to protect our cities. In addition to providing protection from invaders, they are also excellent vantage points to bombard enemies with ranged attacks.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_56: The enemy has surrounded the city and we are under siege. We must break this blockade or we will not be able to reinforce the garrison and repair our defenses.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_57: My liege, this city has great defenses. With enough force, and the right military, I think we can take it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_58: Your majesty, there are times when peace is not the better option. I think we now have good reason to show our military might, but it is a careful decision that you must make alone.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_59: It is a difficult world to face alone, but if I may, I do believe that one of our neighbors has proven worthy. Shall we extend the hand of friendship to them?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_60: Your excellency, I feel it is time that we send a diplomatic delegation to those around us. This will allow us to sow the seeds of friendship, and perhaps give us a better insight as to what these other people may be doing.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_61: I have good news! If we wish it, I think we may have an ally amongst our neighbors. This could come in handy if we ever find ourselves in need of help.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_62: Do not distress, my liege. There are those out there who cannot be pleased, no matter what. It is important to remember what you stand for, and if the time comes… to fight for it.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_63: My liege, I must warn you that denouncing other civilizations will have long and lasting consequences. It is important to think carefully on these matters.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_64: Though it appears as if we may have offended someone, do not fret. There will always be other leaders with different ideas than our own.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_65: It seems that our choices have won favor with one of our neighbors. But everyone has their own agenda, and I am sure that someone else may be watching us warily.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_66: Your grace, If I may, I think it is time that we begin exploring what is beyond our shores. It may be that our land units would be fit for this opportunity.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_67: It isn't just our lands that can be improved, but our waterways as well. I suggest we search for opportunities to exploit the resources along the shores.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_68: I think we may have an opportunity to convince the followers of another religion of the error of their ways. Shall we seize this opportunity?
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_69: Foreign proselytizers have been seeking audience with our citizens. I must advise that we do something about this threat to our holy lands. Perhaps we should launch an inquisition.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_70: Neighborhoods with higher appeal will house more citizens, whereas neighborhoods built by marsh, airports, or rainforest are not going to be very populated at all.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_71: Our treasury is filled with gold, and I think it could be wise to make an investment. Perhaps we could expand our military.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_72: We have not yet constructed a Holy Site, and the great prophet that we have attracted to our city has nowhere to go. Let's construct one!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_73: Our populace has attracted a Great Prophet to our lands! Send this most holy person to Stonehenge and rejoice, for the time has come to found a religion for ourselves.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_74: A Great Engineer has come to our civilization, ready to work hard to advance our infrastructure. Each has a different talent, but all of them can improve our cities in some way.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_75: We now have the ability to build a Spaceport. If we further our research, we may be able to unlock the mysteries of the stars.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_76: We have uncovered a way to increase our farming output. To tap into this potential, I suggest we try to maintain two adjacent farms to each plot of farmland.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_77: We have furthered our agricultural technology yet again! Each farm that we build next to another will increase the output of both - I suggest we do this as often as possible.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_78: Times have changed, and the era of diplomatic delegations has passed. It is important that we now establish Embassies with our friends and allies.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_79: This earth is a gift, and it is important that we protect it. I recommend we establish a National Park. It may even attract tourists!
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_80: It isn't simply seagulls that flock to our shores now. If we build a Seaside Resort, we may be able to benefit from this new attraction to the ocean.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_82: A Relic! If we can house this for our people to see, I am certain that it will attract more of the faithful to our lands.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_83: It appears we have become quite a popular attraction to the people of the world. I wonder how many more tourists will travel through our borders…
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_84: You are a brave and mighty conqueror! I have great faith that you will soon rule all of the lands before us.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_85: Our religion spreads throughout the lands. It is a great joy to see so many people embracing what we know to be true. Though, there are still more who have yet to see the light.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_86: Though our population grows, there is little room for our newest citizens. We should find a way to add more housing to this city.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_87: Your grace, I worry about the happiness of our citizens. I would advise that we investigate a means of increasing their contentment.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_88: Our people have discovered that they have a particular, useful skill that I think we should explore. If we begin construction on this new district now, I believe we will have it completed in no time at all.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_89: Alas, all of this time that we spend at war is taking a toll on our people. I see pain in their eyes, and our productivity has reached record lows.
en_US.ADVISOR_LINE_LISTENER_90: The building of an Archeological Museum will allow us to train Archeologists. There is so much to learn from the world, and they will help us gain this knowledge.
en_US.LOC_META_1_BODY: Click on the Settler unit to select it.
en_US.LOC_META_8_BODY: Since there are no more decisions to make this turn, click the Next Turn button to continue.
en_US.LOC_META_11a_BODY: Tasks which must be completed before you can end your turn will appear in the notification panel in the bottom right of the screen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Since production has finished in this city, you get a reminder that you need to choose the next thing to produce before you can end your turn.
en_US.LOC_META_11_BODY: Click the Choose Production notification to select your next production task.
en_US.LOC_META_33b_BODY: Research must be selected before the turn can be completed.
en_US.LOC_META_13a_BODY: A Builder unit has been added to the city's Production Queue. It will take several turns to complete its training. Since there are no remaining decisions that need to be made this turn, the Next Turn button is displayed.
en_US.LOC_META_13_BODY: Click the Next Turn button to continue.
en_US.LOC_META_19_BODY: Since your Warrior unit has used all of its [ICON_Movement] Movement points, it is done with its actions this turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Production and research tasks are still in progress, so there are no other decisions to be made.
en_US.LOC_META_19b_BODY: Click the Next Turn button once again to continue.
en_US.LOC_META_9_BODY: Click on the Warrior unit to select it.
en_US.LOC_META_2_BODY: Click the Found City button to order your Settler to found a new city at this location.
en_US.LOC_META_3_BODY: Open the Production Chooser of this city by clicking the Change City Production button.
en_US.LOC_META_4a_BODY: This is the city's Production Chooser. From here you can construct buildings, create wonders of the world, and train military and civilian units.
en_US.LOC_META_4b_BODY: Select the Warrior button to start training a Warrior unit in your city.
en_US.LOC_META_5a_BODY: Civilization is a turn-based game where decisions are made and actions performed during a game turn, much like playing a board game with friends. Once all the other players have made their moves, a new turn will begin.
en_US.LOC_META_5b_BODY: Building items in your city takes time. The number of game turns it will take is indicated on each item in the menu.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This is calculated based on the [ICON_Production] Production cost of the item versus the [ICON_Production] Production yield of the city. The higher the yield, the fewer turns it will take to build.
en_US.LOC_META_5_BODY: Click the Next Turn button to finish your turn.
en_US.LOC_META_7a_BODY: The Research Panel displays what technology your civilization is currently working toward. It is empty because you have not yet chosen a technology to research.
en_US.LOC_META_7_BODY: Select the Mining technology from the menu to begin researching it.
en_US.LOC_META_10_BODY: Military units can attack enemy units by moving into their hex. Right-click on the Barbarian unit to attack it. Try doing that now.
en_US.LOC_META_27_BODY: In addition to training units, your city can focus its production on constructing buildings like the Monument.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Try building one now by selecting it in the city's Production Queue.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_21: With Barbarians in our midst, I think our people would be more comfortable if our Warriors were closer to the city. Order them to return and defend.
en_US.LOC_META_28a_BODY: Units can be ordered to move longer distances by giving them a multi-turn order. This will eliminate the need to give a separate move order every turn to reach a destination.
en_US.LOC_META_28_BODY: Try ordering the Warrior to return to the city by clicking the Move To button, then clicking the city.
en_US.LOC_META_29_BODY: When using a multi-move order, a path will display on the map indicating the path the unit will take, along with indicators of the number of turns until it reaches the destination.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_22: Your Majesty, our Scouts are eager to explore the surrounding lands and uncover new areas of the continent. Send them forth!
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_23: There are no further matters to attend to at present, My Liege.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_24: Our brightest minds have discovered new and ingenious ways to extract precious stones and metals from the earth. There is an abundance of valuable Stone nearby, it would be wise to send our Builders to construct a Quarry there.
en_US.LOC_META_30_BODY: Scattered around the map are resources of various kinds. There are 3 categories of resources:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Luxury: These contribute to the overall happiness of your citizens.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategic: Essential for creating some very powerful military units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bonus: Provide additional yields of [ICON_Food] Food , [ICON_Production] Production, or [ICON_Gold] Gold.
en_US.LOC_META_31a_BODY: This Stone is a Bonus resource. It provides an additional +1 [ICON_Production]Production to your city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If you build a Quarry improvement here, it will raise the yield to +2 [ICON_Production]Production.
en_US.LOC_META_31b_BODY: Move your Builder unit to the Stone resource and have them construct a Quarry improvement there.
en_US.LOC_META_32_BODY: Quarry improvements increase the [ICON_Production]Production of the city they're in. Higher Production allows units and buildings to be constructed faster. In short, the higher the Production of a city, the less turns required to build something there.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_26: Our citizens are comforted by the return of our Warriors to the city. Might I suggest having them adopt a more defensive stance for the time being? They will be vigilant against the Barbarian threat.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_27: Great news! Our craftsmen have completed the Monument in our city! It is a symbol of the accomplishments and perseverance of our civilization, and inspires our people to push even further into the lands beyond.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_28: Your Majesty, we should expand our realm. We have adventurous families ready to strike out and claim new lands for the glory of our people. If we do not expand our borders, then in time we will find ourselves surrounded by our enemies.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_29: Settlers will take some time to complete their training. Our Scout should continue exploring undiscovered lands. I would advise we keep our Warriors in the [ICON_Capital] Capital to defend it.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_30: The Settlers are ready to embark on their journey to found a new city and expand our civilization. The lands beyond are dangerous, and it would be wise to insure their protection by sending them with a military escort.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_31: Our Settlers should be safe on their journey under the protection of our Warriors. But we will be without protection in the [ICON_Capital] Capital once they leave. I suggest we begin training a Slinger unit immediately to defend the city.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_32: Well done, Your Majesty. Our great minds have already begun work on new ways to store and preserve our food.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_33: May the triumphs of our great civilization know no bounds! Our second great city awaits your direction. With your wise leadership it too shall grow and thrive.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_34: Like our [ICON_Capital] Capital, this city can produce buildings and units, increase its population, and expand its borders. More cities means more to manage, but I have great faith in Your Majesty.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_36: Your Majesty has shown wisdom and understanding in the fundamentals of ruling a civilization. I shall be available to assist you at any point should you wish, but for now I take my leave.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_37: Our farmers are very skilled at providing [ICON_Food] Food for our people, but we need to find better ways to store it. I suggest we direct the efforts of our scientists to solving this problem.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_39: Our dedication to developing a consistent written language has allowed us to record our knowledge for future use. If we were to provide a common location in our city for our scientists to share this information I'm sure their pursuits would be much more efficient.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_40: Excellent! Construction on a Campus has begun. Our scientists look forward to its completion.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_41: The Campus is complete and we have already begun to see its benefits. Construction of a Library would be ideal at such a location, should your highness agree to it.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_42: It seems we are not the only people competing for control of these lands. I suggest we proceed with caution.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_43: Your Highness we are at war. Security of the realm is of greatest importance. We must begin mobilizing an army immediately.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_44: Uniting your governance with a strict code of laws can be most beneficial to us. I think it is time to enact a set of policies to strengthen our progress toward a more refined civilization.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_45: Strict discipline in our military ranks would give us an edge against the unorganized Barbarian horde. More structured Urban Planning will make our cities more organized and efficient. I suggest we enact these policies.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_46: Nurturing our populace is important, but we must also protect them. There are barbaric tribes near us who want nothing more than to pillage and plunder what is ours.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_47: We continue to make progress on training a team of Builders, and research is continuing as planned. [NEWLINE] Our Warriors are very close to the Tribal Village and should arrive soon.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_48: Our people have looked to the heavens, and begun to wonder if our fortunes may be guided by the hands of a greater power. Who are these great gods, and what blessings might they bestow on us?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_49: In a life dedicated to searching for guidance in the mysteries of the universe, one has had an epiphany that will guide our faithful for millennia to come. Let the teachings of this Great Prophet spread people of all cultures across the face of the earth. By proliferating our Religion, we may be victorious over our rivals.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_50: Congratulations, My Liege! Your leadership has inspired our people to greatness, and now one among them has attained true genius. Their contribution will reverberate throughout history.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_51: Your Majesty, we must reach out to our neighbors in trade. Through them, we stand to boost our economy, and gain new insights into the mysteries of the world.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_52: My Liege, we have made contact with some outsiders. These people are more advanced than the Tribal Villagers that have aided us in the past. Should we extend a hand in friendship, or seek to conquer them?
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_FTUE_53: Caution, your majesty. This city is hostile to us and its people will surely fight to the bitter end to keep it out of our hands. We must be well prepared
en_US.LOC_META_332_BODY: Click the Choose Research button to display the research chooser.
en_US.LOC_META_33_BODY: Select the Pottery technology from the Research Menu.
en_US.LOC_META_34_BODY: If there are units that have not moved this turn and are awaiting orders, you can address them by clicking the Unit Needs Orders notification. Click the notification now to be taken to your Scout unit so you may issue new orders.
en_US.LOC_META_35_BODY: Continue to explore the world with your Scout unit.
en_US.LOC_META_36a_BODY: When not advancing a military unit, it is often a good idea to fortify the unit. When ordered to fortify, the unit will spend up to 2 turns digging in. This will increase their [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength if they are attacked.
en_US.LOC_META_36_BODY: Try ordering the Warrior unit to do so by clicking on the Fortify button.
en_US.LOC_META_37_BODY: This unit will now have an advantage in combat when defending. However, if the unit is moved it will lose its fortified status and will have to be ordered to fortify again in order to receive the bonus.
en_US.LOC_META_38a_BODY: Your Builder still has one of its workforce remaining.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You can use it to build either a Mine on the Hill plot (+[ICON_Production] Production), or a Farm on the Plains plot (+[ICON_Food] Food).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This may take more than one turn, one to move the Builder unit, and another turn to build the improvement.
en_US.LOC_META_38b_BODY: Remember: Builders can only construct improvements within the borders of your city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]By generating [ICON_Culture] Culture, the borders of your city will expand, allowing you access to more resources.
en_US.LOC_META_39_BODY: Feel free to continue exploring the map with your Scout unit. End your turn when you have finished giving orders to your Builder and Scout.
en_US.LOC_META_40_BODY: Your city has finished production on the Monument building. All buildings contribute to a city’s development in specific ways. The Monument will increase the [ICON_Culture] Culture generated by the city, which extends the city’s influence over additional hexes.
en_US.LOC_META_41b_BODY: Open the Production Chooser and begin training a Settler unit. Remember, the Production Chooser can either be accessed from the city's Information Panel or from the Choose Production reminder in the Notification Panel on the right side of the game view.
en_US.LOC_META_42_BODY: Units like Settlers and Builders are non-combat, civilian units and thus cannot defend themselves. This leaves them highly vulnerable to be captured or killed by enemy units. However, your military units can act as protection for the civilian unit if they occupy the same hex.
en_US.LOC_META_43a_BODY: An easy way to move the two units together is by linking them together until they reach their destination.
en_US.LOC_META_43_BODY: Select either the Settler or the Warrior and click the Escort button in the unit panel.
en_US.LOC_META_44_BODY: Begin moving the units southeast toward the indicated map marker. If you have not yet revealed that part of the map it might make your journey easier if you sent your Scout there as well.
en_US.LOC_META_45a_BODY: In a game of Civilization, once a player loses all of their cities, the game is over. It is very important that you protect your cities, especially your [ICON_Capital] Capital, from any foreign threat.
en_US.LOC_META_45_BODY: Add a Slinger unit to the city's Production Queue and end your turn when you are finished.
en_US.LOC_META_46_BODY: As is often the case in history, technological discoveries inspire new technologies, building upon knowledge gained in the past. In a game of Civilization, this is simulated by the Technology Tree. Click the open Technology Tree button in the Research Panel to view it.
en_US.LOC_META_46a_BODY: Click to open the Technology Tree
en_US.LOC_META_47_BODY: The Technology Tree displays all of the researchable technologies available in a game of Civilization, from the Ancient era all the way to the Information era and beyond.
en_US.LOC_META_48_BODY: The gold colored nodes represent technologies that you have already finished researching. You have just finished researching Pottery, so it has been marked as complete.
en_US.LOC_META_49_BODY: The dark grey nodes represent technologies that are available to begin researching, but are not complete.
en_US.LOC_META_50_BODY: Light grey nodes represent technologies that are not yet available to begin researching. These technologies need to first be unlocked by researching one or more prerequisite technologies.
en_US.LOC_META_51a_BODY: Since we have already researched Pottery, we are now able to begin research on the Writing technology.
en_US.LOC_META_51_BODY: Start research on Writing by clicking on the Writing node in the Technology Tree.
en_US.LOC_META_52_BODY: Notice the Writing technology node status has changed, indicating that it is currently being researched. The number of turns required to finish research on a technology is indicated in the upper right corner of the node.
en_US.LOC_META_53A_BODY: The symbols displayed inside the technology node represent new units, buildings, wonders and abilities that are unlocked by the technology once it is completed.
en_US.LOC_META_53B_BODY: For example, once you have finished researching the Writing technology, you will be able to construct the Campus district as well as the Library building in all of your cities. The Campus and Library allow you to increase the amount of [ICON_Science] Science you generate each turn, allowing you to research technologies faster!
en_US.LOC_META_54_BODY: Since you're done designating new research, we can close the Technology Tree by clicking the X button in the upper right corner.
en_US.LOC_META_54a_BODY: Click to close the Technology Tree
en_US.LOC_META_55_BODY: Continue moving your Settler unit to the indicated location.
en_US.LOC_META_56_BODY: In choosing a location to settle a new city, it is important to look at the fertility of the surrounding land. Proximity to sources of [ICON_Food] Food, resources, and fresh water are all very important. For this tutorial we have already found an ideal location for you.
en_US.LOC_META_57_BODY: When your Settler unit is able, click the Found City button to create a new city here. This may require moving on to the next turn if your Settler is out of [ICON_Movement] Movement points.
en_US.LOC_META_58_BODY: To win a game of Civilization, as a player you need to defeat all other civilizations in the world. There are multiple ways to achieve this. You can conquer their cities militarily, bringing them into your civilization. You can also win technologically, or through cultural or religious dominance.
en_US.LOC_META_59_BODY: On the path to victory, there are fundamental strategies to assist you in building your civilization.[NEWLINE]---[NEWLINE]For this tutorial, we have provided four goals for you to achieve. Complete all four and you can complete the tutorial. However, in order to WIN the tutorial, you need to complete the fifth goal.
en_US.LOC_META_61_BODY: Congratulations![NEWLINE]---[NEWLINE]You have completed the fundamentals of growing and maintaining a civilization that will stand the test of time. You can finish the tutorial, or you can keep playing and win this game by eliminating the rival civ.
en_US.LOC_META_63_BODY: In this tutorial you are playing on a small map with a single rival civilization. A standard game of Civilization presents a larger map of the world, with several rival civilizations, all competing to win. The task is larger, but the goals remain the same.
en_US.LOC_META_62_BODY: To win this game, you must conquer all the rival civilization’s city(s) with your military.[NEWLINE]---[NEWLINE]Good luck!
en_US.LOC_META_76_BODY: Open the Production Chooser of your first city by clicking the production button on the City Banner.
en_US.LOC_META_77_BODY: In Civilization VI, there are many types of districts that can be built in your cities, each with a specific purpose.
en_US.LOC_META_78_BODY: By completing research on Writing, you are now able to construct a Campus district in your city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Campus district is dedicated to increasing the amount of [ICON_Science] Science generated by the city that contains it.
en_US.LOC_META_79_BODY: Many districts in the game also get a bonus depending on where they are placed within the city. The Campus gets a bonus when built next to Mountains or Jungles.
en_US.LOC_META_80_BODY: Click the Campus button in the Production Chooser to start building one in this city.
en_US.LOC_META_81_BODY: When placing a district, the map changes slightly to indicate ideal locations in which to build it.
en_US.LOC_META_82_BODY: This plot has Mountains on two of its edges, each providing +1 [ICON_Science] Science per turn. Placing the Campus here would be ideal.
en_US.LOC_META_83_BODY: Click this hex to begin building a Campus here.
en_US.LOC_META_84_BODY: Since you have finished the Writing technology, you now must choose what to research next. If you would like a suggestion, Animal Husbandry and Bronze Working are both good choices.
en_US.LOC_META_85_BODY: Animal Husbandry will allow you to build the Pasture and Camp improvements in your cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bronze Working will help you militarily by unlocking the Encampment district, as well as allow you to train Spearmen.
en_US.LOC_META_86_BODY: Some buildings can only be constructed in districts. The Library is a building exclusive to the Campus district. Since we have completed construction on the Campus, we are now able to build a Library on it.
en_US.LOC_META_87_BODY: Click the Choose Production button in the lower right to begin building a Library.
en_US.LOC_META_88_BODY: Congratulations!![NEWLINE]You have won your first game of Civilization.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You are now ready to take on much larger challenges and objectives, explore new worlds, meet new civilizations for the first time, and achieve victory on your terms.
en_US.LOC_META_89_BODY: When engaged in a war with another civilization, it is best to have a sufficient number of combat units, both to defend your cities as well as fight abroad.
en_US.LOC_META_90_BODY: Sometimes it is necessary to suspend production on a building or district in order to train units to fight the war. To do this, simply change the current production task of the city to the combat unit you wish to create.
en_US.LOC_META_91_BODY: When you are satisfied with the size of your military, you can resume production on what was being built previously without losing the progress you made on it.
en_US.LOC_META_92_BODY: Engaging in diplomatic relations with other civilizations can be very lucrative. Of course, relations can also go sour. How you interact with other leaders is your choice. Just remember, in the path to victory, you cannot always be everyone’s friend.
en_US.LOC_META_93a_BODY: By accumulating [ICON_Culture] Culture, you have just unlocked Code of Laws, which contains your first government: Chiefdom.
en_US.LOC_META_93b_BODY: To access it, click the Government button.
en_US.LOC_META_94_BODY: There are many types of governments in Civilization VI. In addition to various benefits, each government has a number of slots in which you can enact policies.
en_US.LOC_META_95a_BODY: The first government available to you is Chiefdom. It has 2 available slots for policies. The first slot in Chiefdom is for Military policies. The second is for Economic policies.
en_US.LOC_META_96_BODY: To slot a policy, click and drag the policy from the right to the appropriate slot in your government on the left.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Try that now by adding the Discipline policy to the Military slot, then add the Urban Planning policy to the Economic slot. Click the Confirm Policies button when you are done.
en_US.LOC_META_97_BODY: By enacting these policies, your military units will now get a +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength bonus when fighting against Barbarians. Also, your cities receive +1 [ICON_Production] Production per turn, allowing them to train units and construct buildings faster than before.
en_US.LOC_META_98_BODY: Much in the same way you research new technologies by generating [ICON_Science] Science in your cities, you unlock civics by generating [ICON_Culture] Culture.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You have already unlocked the Code of Laws civic which enabled you to establish your first government.
en_US.LOC_META_99a_BODY: Now you need to select a new civic to advance toward.
en_US.LOC_META_99b_BODY: Open the Civics Tree by clicking the Civics Tree button in the upper left corner of the screen.
en_US.LOC_META_100_BODY: Similar to the Technology Tree, the Civics Tree has different choices and paths as you progress through the game.[NEWLINE]For this tutorial, click the Craftsmanship civic to start advancing next.
en_US.LOC_META_100c_BODY: Click to close the Civics Tree
en_US.LOC_META_102_BODY: Click Builder to begin training a Builder unit.
en_US.LOC_META_103_BODY: The city is the cornerstone of any great civilization. A city’s size is represented by its [ICON_Citizen] Population, indicated to the left of its nameplate.
en_US.LOC_META_103_OTHER_BODY: A Slinger unit has finished training in your capital. Slingers are ranged class units, allowing them to attack from distance without engaging in melee combat. This keeps them from taking reciprocal damage during the attack.
en_US.LOC_META_104_BODY: Each city also claims the surrounding lands for your exclusive control. These lands are indicated by the colored border surrounding the city. The unique features within your borders will have a profound influence on the potential strengths of each city.
en_US.LOC_META_104_OTHER_BODY: Ranged units also tend to have lower defense strength than their melee fighting counterparts, so it is best to keep them close to friendly units of other types for protection.
en_US.LOC_META_105_BODY: You must choose how each city in your civilization is to grow and expand over time, improving the land you control and creating new buildings and districts within your borders.
en_US.LOC_META_105_OTHER_BODY: As you progress through the game and research new technologies, you will unlock better, stronger, and more advanced units. Building a strong and diverse fighting force is essential in competing against other civilizations, and preserving the safety of your people.
en_US.LOC_META_WRITING_COMPLETE: We have just completed research on Writing.
en_US.LOC_META_POTTERY_COMPLETE: In addition to [ICON_Food] Food, your people also require [ICON_Amenities] Amenities in their cities. One source of [ICON_Amenities] Amenities are Luxury resources, such as this [ICON_Resource_Coffee] Coffee next to your [ICON_Capital] Capital. With the Pottery technology complete, it would be a good idea to research Irrigation to enable your Builders to improve Luxury resources, such as the [ICON_Resource_Coffee] Coffee next to our [ICON_Capital] Capital. This will provide [ICON_Amenities] Amenities to our city, increasing its happiness.
en_US.LOC_META_GOAL_6_COMPLETE: You have completed the goal of improving a tile within range of the second city!
en_US.LOC_META_GOAL_8_COMPLETE: You have completed the goal of exploring another tribal village!
en_US.LOC_META_GOAL_9_COMPLETE: You have completed the goal of growing a city to a population of six!
en_US.LOC_META_GOAL_10_COMPLETE: You have completed the goal of building five improvements!
en_US.LOC_META_GOAL_14_COMPLETE: You have completed the goal of constructing Walls in your [ICON_Capital] Capital city!
en_US.LOC_META_GOAL_15_COMPLETE: You have completed the goal of constructing a Barracks!
en_US.LOC_META_106_BODY: Each city generates a variety of yields at the start of every turn. These are obtained from the hexes that the city controls.
en_US.LOC_META_107_BODY: Each hex within your city borders can provide a number of yields to help you advance your civilization. [ICON_Food] Food and [ICON_Production] Production are two of these yields.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] [ICON_Food] Food fuels city growth, increasing its [ICON_Citizen] Population. More [ICON_Food] Food, faster growth.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]  [ICON_Production] Production is used to build new items, like military units and city upgrades. The more [ICON_Production] Production your city has, the faster you can build things.
en_US.LOC_META_108_BODY: However, each hex will need to be worked by your [ICON_Citizen] Population in order to obtain the yield from that hex.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each [ICON_Citizen] Citizen can work 1 hex within your borders.
en_US.LOC_META_109_BODY: Growing your city’s [ICON_Citizen] Population is very important in order to take advantage of all the yields from the surrounding lands.
en_US.LOC_META_110_BODY: It is now up to you to decide what you would like to produce in this city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Suggestions:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]- Train a Builder to improve more of the surrounding lands within your borders.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]- Train a combat unit to expand the size and strength of your military.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-Build a Granary to provide additional [ICON_Food] Food for your city as well as more [ICON_Housing] Housing for your [ICON_Citizen] Population.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_1: EXPLORE: Explore undiscovered areas the region.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_1: Use your Scout to find and explore all of the Tribal Villages in the region.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_2: DEFENSE: Move Warriors back to city.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_2: Move your Warriors back to the city to defend.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_3: Keep your Warriors inside your city to defend it.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_4: TRAIN SETTLER: Complete training of a Settler unit.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_4: Complete training of a Settler unit to expand your civilization.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_5: ESTABLISH NEW CITY: Escort Settler to the specified location.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_5: Escort the Settler with your Warrior to the specified location.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_6: DEVELOP: Use Builder to improve land surrounding new city.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_6: Use a Builder to improve the lands surrounding the new city.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_7: SCIENCE: Construct a Campus in your capital.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_TOOLTIP_7: Complete construction of a Campus in your capital.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_8: Find and explore another Tribal Village.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_9: Reach a Population of 6 in one of your cities.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_11: EXTERMINATE: Eliminate the Barbarian threat from your region and destroy the Barbarian camp.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_13: BUILD IMPROVEMENT: Use your Builder unit to construct a 3rd improvement in your city.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_14: Build the Ancient Walls in your Capital City.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_15: Build an Encampment District and upgrade it with a Barracks.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_16: Train five Military units including at least one Archer or Battering Ram. [NOT IMPLEMENTED].
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GOAL_17: TO WIN: Eliminate the other civilization by capturing its Capital.
en_US.LOC_META_53_BODY: The symbols displayed inside the technology node represent new units, buildings, wonders, and abilities that are unlocked by the technology once it is completed. For example, once you have finished researching the Pottery technology, you will be able to construct the Granary building in all of your cities. Your Builders will also gain the ability to harvest Wheat resources near your city. While harvesting a Wheat resource gives you a large amount of [ICON_Food] Food, that resource is removed from the map. In most cases, it is better to nurture a Wheat resource by building a Farm improvement on it instead.
en_US.LOC_META_167_BODY: The technological advancement of your people is attained through research.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]By completing research on technologies you will unlock new ways to exploit the land, new military units, new city upgrades, and much more.
en_US.LOC_META_111_BODY: Just as building new units is fueled by [ICON_Production] Production, researching new technologies is fueled by [ICON_Science] Science.
en_US.LOC_META_112_BODY: Each city in your empire generates a small amount of [ICON_Science] Science per turn. How quickly your research projects are completed is determined by the total of all the [ICON_Science] Science generated by your cities. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The more [ICON_Science] Science you generate, the faster you research new technologies.
en_US.LOC_META_SELECT_IRRIGATION: Select Irrigation from the research chooser panel.
en_US.LOC_META_6_BODY: Click the Choose Research button to open the Research Panel.
en_US.LOC_META_113_BODY: For the purposes of this tutorial, we have ‘rushed’ the production of this unit. Normally, the production would have taken several more turns to complete.
en_US.LOC_META_12_BODY: Click the Choose Production notification to open the city’s Production Menu.
en_US.LOC_META_15_BODY: Click on the Warrior unit to select it.
en_US.LOC_META_114_BODY: All Tribal Villages will grant a reward when explored by a player. This Tribal Village has granted you a new Scout unit, which has appeared in your city.
en_US.LOC_META_115_BODY: Continue exploring the world with your Scout. End turn when its action is complete.
en_US.LOC_META_116_BODY: Your civilization will always be researching a technology. Because you just completed Mining, you must now choose what to research next before you can progress to the next turn.
en_US.LOC_META_117_BODY: Research has begun on the Pottery technology. End your turn once you have moved your Scout unit.
en_US.LOC_META_118_BODY: To win a game of Civilization, you need to defeat all other civilizations in the world. There are multiple ways to achieve this. Most games will also end in the year 2050 or after a set number of turns. If no player has achieved these Victories by then, score will determine the winner. Score is calculated as a general measure of each player’s achievements in all fields of endeavor.
en_US.LOC_META_119_BODY: The status of each Victory’s conditions are tracked on the World Rankings panel. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Open it now.
en_US.LOC_META_119a_BODY: Click to open the World Rankings panel
en_US.LOC_META_120_BODY: The Overall tab gives you an overview of all types of Victory and your ranking against other players
en_US.LOC_META_121_BODY: The other tabs give you more specific detail about each set of rankings. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Close the panel when you are ready to proceed.
en_US.LOC_META_122_BODY: The rest of this tutorial will help you to achieve your first Domination Victory.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The goal of a Domination Victory is for your civilization to be the last to occupy its own [ICON_Capital] Capital city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For this tutorial, that means you will have to use your military to capture the [ICON_Capital] Capital city of your rival, while preventing them from taking yours.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]How you ultimately achieve this will be up to you. However, we have provided three optional objectives that, if completed, will greatly assist you in achieving this.
en_US.LOC_META_123_BODY: If you are unsure about something, or are looking for more information about anything you’ve seen in this tutorial, there’s a good chance you’ll find it in the Civilopedia.
en_US.LOC_META_64_BODY: Districts are specific areas of your city dedicated to providing a specific yield. Buildings can be constructed in districts to increase that yield while also providing other benefits for your city.
en_US.LOC_META_65_BODY: For example, you have unlocked the {DISTRICT_TYPE} district which is dedicated to providing {YIELD_TYPE} to your civilization. Constructing a {DISTRICT_BUILDING} building in this district increases the {YIELD_TYPE} yield for your civilization.
en_US.LOC_META_66_BODY: To zone a district, select it in your city’s production menu as you would a building or a unit. Some districts have rules of where they can be placed, but even more important is that districts can have an even greater benefit if placed in an optimal location.
en_US.LOC_META_67_BODY: When you are ready to zone a district, the game will assist you in choosing the best location. Sometimes you might not have a valid spot in your city to place a new district right away. The location may have to be cleared of obstructions, or all of your existing city plots may already have improvements.
en_US.LOC_META_68_BODY: Expanding the size of your city is one way to gain more locations for districts, as well as improvements.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_LINE_5: Your Majesty, if I may… Although our scientists would be willing to explore other topics of research, I feel it is best to not distract them until they have completed their current project unless absolutely necessary.
en_US.LOC_META_69_BODY: Any research progress on a technology is not lost, so there are cases where changing your research focus is strategically valid. However, it is always better to have a completed technology rather than many incomplete ones.
en_US.LOC_META_73_BODY: In Civilization VI, you can get Eureka Moments that boost your technology research through in game achievements. This Eureka Moment was gained by discovering a natural wonder. Other achievements could be winning a battle with a specific unit or constructing a building. Achieving these greatly accelerates your technological progress.
en_US.LOC_META_127_BODY: Scouts are ideal for investigating Tribal Villages because they receive experience from it.
en_US.LOC_META_72_BODY: Any production progress on an item in the queue is not lost, so there are cases where changing your city’s production focus is strategically valid. However, it is often best to finish what you have started before starting something new.
en_US.LOC_META_74_BODY: You might have noticed that your Builder unit disappeared after using its last build ‘charge’. This is because all of its workforce has been expended. You will need to train more Builders as you progress through the game to improve the lands around your cities.
en_US.LOC_META_75_BODY: Scouts, unlike other military units, gain experience from exploring Tribal Villages. They can also gain experience from discovering natural wonders in the world.
en_US.LOC_META_128_BODY: You may have noticed that your cities have been generating a small amount of [ICON_Faith] Faith each turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_Faith] Faith is earned over time by certain buildings, districts, and policies.
en_US.LOC_META_129_BODY: Now that you’ve earned enough [ICON_Faith] Faith, you are able to take the first step towards founding a Religion by forming a Pantheon, which will provide you with a choice of strategic benefits.
en_US.LOC_META_129b_BODY: Click the Religion button to open the Religion screen and choose a Pantheon.
en_US.LOC_META_129c: There are many Pantheons to choose from with different gameplay effects. Once one is chosen by a player, it is removed from the list of available Pantheons and is exclusive to that player’s religion for the duration of the game. Choose wisely!
en_US.LOC_META_129d: Choose a Pantheon, then click the 'Found this Pantheon' button when you are done.
en_US.LOC_META_130_BODY: Well done! The next step is to attract a Great Prophet, who will be able to found a Religion. But first, you will need to build a Holy Site district, or enact an appropriate government policy, both of which will earn you Great Prophet Points.
en_US.LOC_META_131_BODY: There are a limited number of opportunities to found a Religion. Doing so is optional, but keep in mind that if you do not, you may not have an effective counter against a player who is seeking a Religious Victory by converting your [ICON_Citizen] Citizens.
en_US.LOC_META_132_BODY: Your [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet has founded a new Religion, and you must customize it by selecting a name, symbol, and selecting two additional religious beliefs that will complement the Pantheon belief you selected previously.
en_US.LOC_META_133_BODY: Your new Religion can spread between cities, converting its [ICON_Citizen] Citizens into followers. It is possible for a city to have a mix of several Religions. The Religion with the majority of followers in a city will be the one that imparts its bonuses.
en_US.LOC_META_134_BODY: While Religion will slowly spread from city to city organically, you can cause sudden shifts by training Missionary and Apostle units and sending them out to spread your people’s Religion. These units can be obtained by spending [ICON_Faith] Faith to buy them in the Purchase tab of a city’s Production Menu.
en_US.LOC_META_135_BODY: Aggressively spreading your Religion is essential if you are targeting a Religious Victory. Even if you are not, it is wise to keep track of how Religion is spreading around the world. Counter it where possible to mitigate the chances of another player claiming Victory this way.
en_US.LOC_META_136_BODY: You have gained the opportunity to claim a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person for your civilization. [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People provide significant benefits to your civilization based on their field. There are many types of [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, including artists, engineers, and military leaders.
en_US.LOC_META_136b_BODY: Open the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People panel to claim your [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person.
en_US.LOC_META_137_BODY: This is the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People panel. It shows all the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People that are currently available for civilizations to claim, their benefits, and their costs.
en_US.LOC_META_138_BODY: Each [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person has one or more opportunities to activate a special bonus. They will appear as a unit in one of your cities and you must Activate their bonus at a special location on the map. Once they have used all their bonuses, the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person will disappear.
en_US.LOC_META_139_BODY: A [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person is earned by saving up enough [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People Points of its type, then spending them to recruit the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person to your civilization. These points come primarily from districts and buildings, but can also come from policies and other effects. If you are in a rush, you can spend [ICON_Gold] Gold or [ICON_Faith] Faith to instantly earn the [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person you want.
en_US.LOC_META_140_BODY: You can choose to pass on a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person that you don’t want. If you do this, then other players will have the opportunity to claim them, and your choice to pass is not reversible. However, your [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People Points will be saved for a future opportunity.
en_US.LOC_META_141_BODY: You’ve just completed a Trader unit. Traders travel between two cities and generate income for their city of origin.
en_US.LOC_META_142_BODY: Your civilization can establish a limited number of [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes. You can expand this capacity with Commercial Hub or Harbor districts.
en_US.LOC_META_142b_BODY: Click the 'Assign Trade Route' unit action.
en_US.LOC_META_143_BODY: There are no other cities to trade with right now. Continue to explore the map, or build a Settler and found a new city of your own.
en_US.LOC_META_144_BODY: This is the Trade Panel, showing the cities that you can trade with currently. Traders have a limited range, but visiting nearby cities will establish a Trading Post there, allowing them to be used as a bridge to farther destinations.
en_US.LOC_META_145_BODY: Depending on the buildings and districts within a foreign destination, you stand to earn yields of [ICON_Science] Science, [ICON_Faith] Faith, [ICON_Culture] Culture, or [ICON_Gold] Gold each turn for a set number of turns. For domestic destinations, you can earn [ICON_Food] Food and [ICON_Production] Production.
en_US.LOC_META_145b_BODY: Select the destination of your choice from the list of available cities.
en_US.LOC_META_145c_BODY: Click 'Begin Route' to send this Trader on its way to the destination.
en_US.LOC_META_146_BODY: This Trader will now travel to the destination and back, generating the relevant yields each turn. Once it has returned, you can choose a new route.
