en_US.LOC_DIPLO_EMBASSY_CHOICE_POSITIVE: Your embassy is a welcome addition to our capital.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_MVEMBA_ANY: I am Mvemba a Nzinga and I greet you as a friend. I can see you are blessed by God. Are you here to share your enlightenment?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_CATHERINE_DE: I am Catherine, the Queen Mother of France, and I welcome you to the realm. I do so look forward to learning all there is to know about you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_CLEOPATRA_AN: I am Isis reborn, I am the living Nile. I am Cleopatra and an ally, if you are worthy.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_BARBAROSSA_A: Greetings. I am the Holy Roman Emperor Frederick, King of Germany, Italy, Burgundy, and many others. I trust that you will rule your lands as I do:  through might.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_GANDHI_ANY: Hello, I am Mohandas Gandhi. My people call me Bapu, but please, call me friend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_GILGAMESH_AN: I am Gilgamesh of Sumeria and King of Uruk. Do not be afraid… I am good to my friends.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_GORGO_ANY: I am Gorgo, Queen of Sparta and leader of the Greeks. Who are you? What victories can you speak of?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_HARDRADA_ANY: Harald Sigurdsson stands before you: a Viking unlike any the seas and lands have ever known. Hah, are you afraid?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_HOJO_ANY: Hello, I am Hojo Tokimune of Japan, a humble disciple of Bushido.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PEDRO_ANY: Good day. It is an honor to meet you in person. It seems great minds do attract each other, after all.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PERICLES_ANY: Hello, I am Pericles of Athens and I greet you on behalf of the Democracy. I trust you’ll let me conduct my business with these neutral parties?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PETER_GREAT_: Hello, I am Tsar Peter. So, a cultured leader such as yourself must enjoy the finer things in life. Are you fond of art as well?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PHILIP_II_AN: I am the King of Spain, Portugal, Sardinia and Sicily, Naples, Duke of Milan, etc., but most importantly, I am a devout follower of the one, true religion. I hope for your sake you are as well.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_QIN_ANY: Why do you come before the Immortal Son of Heaven, the Great Qin Shi Huang?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_SALADIN_ANY: By the grace of the one God, the powerful, the victorious, the everlasting of whose Kingdom there is no end, I greet you, my sincere friend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT_: Welcome to the United States of America. If you conduct yourself well, you can consider us friends.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_TOMYRIS_ANY: Let it be known between us: I will repay treachery with blood!  But, if you are a true friend, we will have peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_TRAJAN_ANY: Hail, stranger. I am the Imperator Caesar Trajan of far-reaching Rome. Who are you and what lands can you claim as your own?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_VICTORIA_ANY: Greetings. We are by the Grace of God, Victoria, Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. And soon, dare I say, the empire.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_ANY_ANY: Greetings traveler. You should know that you stand in the presence of greatness!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_CHOICE_FIRST_MEET_NEAR_RECIPIE: It is an honor to meet you.
Well met stranger, but I'm afraid we are too busy to stay and chat.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_VISIT_RECIPIENT_LEA: Before we continue, come worship with me at our nearby city. Then we can enjoy a meal of chicken moambé.
You have not lived until you have had our delicacies of food and drink. And I can show you how to use a fork, if you wish.
We have a city nearby. Would you like to visit? I'd like to introduce you to our boardgame, Senet.
As the Holy Roman Emperor, I welcome you to our land. If you wish, you can see some of its glory in the nearest city. Unless, of course, they are rebelling again.
Come to our nearest city. We can listen to the wisdom of Vedic poetry, and perhaps learn something.
The glory of Sumer is yours to see, if you wish: an ancient tradition of arts and sciences, Ziggurats too great to behold!
We have a city nearby. Would you like to visit and sample our hearty black broth?
Tell me, friend: would you like to visit our nearby city? It is no Bilskirnir, but it is nice.
I would be honored if you joined me for the ōban in our nearby city. You do like jellyfish aemono, yes?
Come to Brasil! Do you know how to dance samba? It doesn’t matter, you will enjoy the Carnival regardless.
Would you care to visit our nearby metropolis? We could debate politics before enjoying the theatre.

en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_PH: The Kingdom of Spain would kindly request to move through your lands. We mean you no harm.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_QI: We must pass through your territory and humbly request permission to enter your domain.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_SA: Will you allow my people to pass through your lands? I assure you they will be peaceful.

My people need land. Who are you to say that they cannot have it?
Your people settle too close! You should consider seeking land elsewhere.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_DONT_SETTLE_NEAR_ME_HU: If you cannot respect our lands, then I will not respect you.

en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_STOP_DIGGING_UP_ARTIFA: I hadn't realized that you laid claim to these lands. It was a simple mistake.

en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_STOP_CONVERTING_MY_CIT: Though I will respect your wishes, I am disappointed that you cannot see the error of your ways.
No, no. This is for the best. You will see, I assure you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Your troops tread too close to my borders. I hope it's just to view our picturesque countryside.
Your army is at our doorstep. Do you think we are blind? Move them, or we will be forced to action.
Do you think to intimidate us with force? That will not go well for you, at all.
Like the Eye of Ra, I see all. Did you think I would not notice your army at my borders? I would suggest you move them.

Move your army from our borders or we will move them for you.

Your troops tread too close to my borders. I hope it's just to view our picturesque countryside.

You march your troops so close to our borders that I am beginning to question your integrity.
Your troops tread too close to my borders. I hope it's just to view our picturesque countryside.
Your soldiers are only a few steps from being invaders. Move them from our borders at once!
Your army is not welcome at our borders. Remove them at once.

en_US.LOC_EPIC_PBC_OVERVIEW_DESC: Play By Cloud is an asynchronous multiplayer format where all players take their turns on a common savegame, which is stored on a hosted server. This is a more modern version of “passing the savegame,” which was the ancient practice of sharing a floppy disk with a common save file between friends (if you are unfamiliar with the concept of a “floppy disk,” please ask a respected adult of venerable age).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A Play By Cloud game may last a long time (on the order of days or weeks) as each player takes his or her turn at a time that is convenient to them. You will receive notifications when it is your turn to play. You may see an Epic notification if Epic is active, or you may use the webhooks. Webhooks are a generic message format that the technically-inclined can integrate into other messaging services, email, or Internet of Things devices.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In asynchronous multiplayer, it is considered courteous to take your turn at your earliest possible convenience to keep the game moving. In ancient times, players were morally obligated to protect the floppy disk from corruption, with unscrupulous players resorting to “losing” the savegame when in an untenable situation. Play By Cloud eliminates such rascally behavior.

en_US.LOC_EXPANSION1_MOD_TEASER: An Expansion pack with Great Ages, Loyalty, Governors, Emergencies, new civilizations and leaders and much, much more!
en_US.LOC_EXPANSION1_MOD_DESCRIPTION: This is a game using the Rise and Fall Expansion, which includes Great Ages, Loyalty, Governors, and Emergencies. Can you lead your people into a Golden Age of prosperity? Or will your empire face the challenges of a Dark Age?
en_US.LOC_EXPANSION2_MOD_TEASER: An Expansion pack with World Congress, environmental effects and disasters, power, new civilizations and leaders, and much, much more!
en_US.LOC_EXPANSION2_MOD_DESCRIPTION: This is a game using the Gathering Storm Expansion, which includes the World Congress, environmental effects and disasters, power, and more. Can you deal with the unpredictability of a changing world to make a civilization that will stand the test of time?
en_US.LOC_BLACKDEATH_SCENARIO_TOOLTIP: Can you guide your nation through the terrible plague? 4 players, 85 turns.
en_US.LOC_BLACKDEATH_SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION: In this scenario you must guide a Medieval civilization through the infamous Black Death, keeping their cultural and scientific efforts alive as their population falls and faith collapses. The plague will sweep the landscape in waves, killing citizens and rendering tiles unworkable. Can you hold on long enough to sow the seeds of the Enlightenment, or will your nation collapse into disloyalty and despair?
en_US.LOC_WARMACHINE_SCENARIO_TOOLTIP: 1v1 multiplayer scenario based on the German attack on France during the outbreak of WWI.
en_US.LOC_WARMACHINE_SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION: In this scenario you take command of the armies of France or Germany during the first month of WWI. You have a massive army poised to strike, an industrial nation ready to back it up, and only 40 turns to capture or defend Paris. Can you triumph in the greatest clash of arms the world has ever seen? Or will warfare on this scale and speed overwhelm you?
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_NATURAL_WONDER_DESCRIPTION: The discovery of a natural wonder gives Scouts bonus experience. Natural wonders also give an adjacency bonus to Holy Site districts. All adjacent tiles receive +2 Appeal.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_BARRIER_REEF_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder that can be found on coastal terrain. It appears as a Reef and provides +3 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, and +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder that can be found on coastal terrain. It appears as Cliffs and provides +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Provides +4 Appeal to adjacent tiles instead of the usual +2.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CRATER_LAKE_DESCRIPTION: One tile natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +5 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_DEAD_SEA_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder. It appears as a Lake and provides +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Units heal completely if they heal for one turn adjacent to the Dead Sea.

en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCORE_TEXT: From our humble beginnings ages ago have you forged a civilization that has withstood time itself. Though countless civilizations rise and fall around us, we do not just survive. We prosper.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TEXT: Much as our ancestors did ages ago, we thrust forward into the unknown. The first pioneers set forth on an uneasy course, and yet once again our people thrive.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_RELIGION_TEXT: We have a basic need to believe in something greater than ourselves. We crave solace in the darkness, a light unto our path. Thanks to you, we’ve found meaning amid the Cosmos.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_CULTURE_TEXT: The worth of a culture is not measured by its accomplishments, but in how those accomplishments last, and how they are remembered. The beauty that you have inspired our people to create will ensure that our culture stands for all time.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DOMINATION_TEXT: Though its face may change throughout the ages, history is written from the hand of the victor. By your actions this day, you ensure our people are glorious tomorrow.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DEFAULT_TEXT: Everyone else has lost... Therefore you've won!

en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BIG_STICK_POLICY_DESCRIPTION: Likes peaceful civilizations that have a city on his home continent. Hates civilizations starting wars against a city-state or civilization based on his continent.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BLACK_QUEEN_DESCRIPTION: Gains as many Spies and as much diplomatic access as possible.  Does not like civilizations who ignore these espionage activities.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BUSHIDO_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations that have a strong military and [ICON_Faith]Faith and [ICON_Culture] Culture output. Dislikes civilizations that are strong in military but weak in [ICON_Faith]Faith and [ICON_Culture] Culture output.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CITY_STATE_ALLY_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_COUNTER_REFORMER_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who follow the same Religion, and wants their cities to all follow the same Religion.  Hates anyone trying to spread their Religion into their empire.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DELIAN_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ENTHUSIASTIC_DISCIPLE_DESCRIP: Likes civilizations that bring Religion to the Kongo. Dislikes civilizations that have founded a Religion but not brought it to a Kongolese city.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_GREAT_PERSON_OBSESSED_DESCRIP: Likes civilizations who are not competing for [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People, and will recruit [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People whenever possible. Dislikes losing a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person to another civilization.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_IRON_CROWN_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who do not associate with city-states. Does not like Suzerains of city-states, or civilizations who conquered city-states.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_LAST_VIKING_KING_DESCRIPTION: Builds a large navy and respects civilizations who follow their lead.  Does not like civilizations with a weak navy.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_OPTIMUS_PRINCEPS_DESCRIPTION: Tries to include as much territory as possible in their empire.  Does not like civilizations who control little territory.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_PARANOID_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who pose no threat. Dislikes civilizations with strong militaries or ones with nearby cities.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_QUEEN_OF_THE_NILE_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations with powerful militaries, and will try to ally with them to avoid damaging military conflicts. Dislikes civilizations with weak militaries.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_PEACEKEEPER_DESCRIPTION: Never declares wars for which he can be branded a warmonger, and will try to befriend those who maintain the peace. Hates warmongers.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_SUN_NEVER_SETS_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations from her home continent, and wants to expand to all continents. Doesn’t like civilizations on continents where England has no city.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_TLATOANI_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations who have the same Luxury resources as he does, and will try to collect every Luxury resource available. Dislikes civilizations who have a new Luxury resource he has not yet collected.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WESTERNIZER_DESCRIPTION: Friendly to those civilizations that are ahead of him in [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture.  Dislikes backwards civilizations that are lacking in [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WONDER_OBSESSED_DESCRIPTION: Likes civilizations not competing for wonders, and builds wonders whenever possible. Dislikes losing a wonder to another civilization.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_BARBARIAN_LOVER_DESCRIPTION: Sympathizes with the barbarians.  Does not like civilizations that destroy barbarian outposts.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CIVILIZED_DESCRIPTION: Hates barbarians. Likes civilizations that clear out barbarian outposts. Does not like civilizations that ignore barbarian outposts.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CULTURED_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up [ICON_Culture] Culture, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Culture] Culture.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DARWINIST_DESCRIPTION: Likes to see civilizations at war, and believes in constant struggle.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_FUN_LOVING_DESCRIPTION: Tries to make the citizens in each city as happy as possible. Likes civilizations that also develop in this fashion.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_INDUSTRIALIST_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up industry, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Production] Production.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_MONEY_GRUBBER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to have the highest possible [ICON_Gold] Gold per turn income. Respects other high income civilizations.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION: Tries to find all natural wonders.  Likes civilizations that keep Woods and Rainforest unchopped, and those that establish National Parks.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_NUKE_LOVER_DESCRIPTION: Has no hesitation to use nuclear weapons. Respects other civilizations that project strength with nuclear weapons.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_POPULOUS_DESCRIPTION: Tries to have the highest overall population.  Respects other high population civilizations.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_STANDING_ARMY_DESCRIPTION: Always tries to keep a large standing army. Respects other civilizations with large armies.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_TECHNOPHILE_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up [ICON_Science] Science, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Science] Science.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_AIRPOWER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up air power. Admires civilizations with greater air power. Dislikes civilizations with weaker air power.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CITY_STATE_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPT: Emphasizes protectorate wars. Admires civilizations that start protectorate wars. Dislikes civilizations that attack city states.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_EXPLOITATIVE_DESCRIPTION: Clears all features and improves all possible tiles. Likes civilizations with a high percentage of improved tiles. Dislikes civilizations with low percentage of improved tiles or that found National Parks.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ENVIRONMENTALIST_DESCRIPTION: Builds National Parks, doesn't clear features, plants Woods. Likes civilizations that plant Woods or found National Parks. Dislikes civilizations that clear features.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_IDEOLOGUE_DESCRIPTION: Favors civilizations with the same type of government, dislikes civilizations that have different governments, and really dislikes civilizations with different governments of the same era as its own.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DEVOUT_DESCRIPTION: Tries to build up [ICON_Faith] Faith, and likes civilizations that also focus on [ICON_Faith] Faith.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to explore the map, and likes civilizations that have explored less of the map than itself and dislikes civilizations that have explored more of the map than itself.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ZEALOT_DESCRIPTION: Tries to gain a religious victory. Likes those civs who have already adopted their religion.
en_US.LOC_MINOR_CIV_SCIENTIFIC_TRAIT_DESCRIPTI: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Science] Science in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Library building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Science] Science in every Library building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Science] Science in every University building.
en_US.LOC_MINOR_CIV_RELIGIOUS_TRAIT_DESCRIPTIO: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Shrine building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith in every Shrine building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith in every Temple building.
en_US.LOC_MINOR_CIV_TRADE_TRAIT_DESCRIPTION: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Market or Lighthouse building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold in every Market and Lighthouse building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold in every Bank and Shipyard building.
en_US.LOC_MINOR_CIV_CULTURAL_TRAIT_DESCRIPTION: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every Amphitheater building.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture in every Amphitheater building.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture in every Art Museum and Archeological Museum building.
en_US.LOC_MINOR_CIV_MILITARISTIC_TRAIT_DESCRIP: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Production] Production in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every city with a Barracks or Stable when producing units.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with a Barracks or Stable building when producing units.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with an Armory building when producing units.
en_US.LOC_MINOR_CIV_INDUSTRIAL_TRAIT_DESCRIPTI: 1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy: +1 [ICON_Production] Production in the [ICON_Capital] Capital and in every city with a Workshop building when producing wonders, buildings, and districts.[NEWLINE]3 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with a Workshop building when producing wonders, buildings, and districts.[NEWLINE]6 [ICON_Envoy] Envoys: +2 [ICON_Production] Production in every city with a Factory building when producing wonders, buildings, and districts.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_AMSTERDAM_DESCRIPTION: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to foreign cities earn +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold for each Luxury resource at the destination.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_BRUSSELS_DESCRIPTION: Your cities get +15% [ICON_Production] Production towards wonders.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_BUENOS_AIRES_DESCRIPTIO: Your Bonus resources behave like Luxury resources, providing 1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity per type.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_GENEVA_DESCRIPTION: [ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas provide an additional +5% of the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science cost for researching technologies.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_HATTUSA_DESCRIPTION: Provides you with 1 of each Strategic resource you have revealed but do not own.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_HONG_KONG_DESCRIPTION: Your cities get +20% [ICON_Production] Production towards city projects.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_JAKARTA_DESCRIPTION: Your [ICON_TRADINGPOST] Trading Posts in foreign cities provide +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold to your [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes passing through or going to the city. +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold on international [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_JERUSALEM_DESCRIPTION: Automatically converts to the Religion you founded, and exerts pressure for that Religion as if it were a Holy City.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_KABUL_DESCRIPTION: Your units receive double experience from battles they initiate.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_KANDY_DESCRIPTION: Receive a [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relic every time you discover a new natural wonder, and earn +50% [ICON_Faith] Faith from all [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_KUMASI_DESCRIPTION: Your [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to any city-state provide +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every specialty district in the origin city.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_LA_VENTA_DESCRIPTION: Your Builders can now make Colossal Head improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Colossal Heads provide +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Woods. Cannot be built on Snow or Snow Hills.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_LISBON_DESCRIPTION: Your Trader units are immune to being plundered. +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold on international [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_NAN_MADOL_DESCRIPTION: Your [ICON_DISTRICT] specialty districts on or next to Coast or Lake tiles provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Additional +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture once the Exploration civic is reached.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_SEOUL_DESCRIPTION: When you enter a new era, earn 1 random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka from that era.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_TORONTO_DESCRIPTION: Regional effects from your Industrial Zone and Entertainment Complex districts reach 3 tiles farther.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_VALLETTA_DESCRIPTION: City Center buildings and Encampment district buildings can be bought with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Cost of purchasing Ancient, Medieval, and Renaissance Walls is reduced, but they can only be bought with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_YEREVAN_DESCRIPTION: Your Apostle units can choose from any possible promotion instead of receiving a random promotion.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_ZANZIBAR_DESCRIPTION: Receive the [ICON_RESOURCE_CINNAMON] Cinnamon Luxury resource and with Banking the [ICON_RESOURCE_CLOVES] Cloves Luxury resource. These cannot be earned any other way in the game, and provide +6 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities each.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_UNIT_NORWEGIAN_LONGSHIP: Harald Hardrada unique unit: Viking Longship
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_UNIT_AMERICAN_ROUGH_RID: Theodore Roosevelt unique unit: Rough Rider
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_THERMOPYLAE_DESCRIPTION: Combat victories provide [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 50% of the [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength of the defeated unit (on Online speed).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for each Military policy slot in your [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_MEDITERRANEAN_DESCRIPTI: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to other civilizations provide +4 [ICON_Gold] Gold for Egypt. Other civilizations' [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to Egypt provide +2 [ICON_Food] Food for them and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for Egypt.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_DIVINE_WIND_DESCRIPTION: Land units receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength in land tiles adjacent to Coast; naval units receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength in shallow water tiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Theater Square, Holy Site, and Encampment districts.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_EL_ESCORIAL_DESCRIPTION: Inquisitors can Remove Heresy one extra time. Inquisitors eliminate 100% of the presence of other Religions. Combat and Religious units have a bonus of +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength against players following other Religions. Missionaries are 25% cheaper to purchase.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_GRAND_EMBASSY_DESCRIPTI: Receives [ICON_Science] Science or [ICON_Culture] Culture from [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to civilizations that are more advanced than Russia. +1 per 3 technologies or civics ahead.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_HOLY_ROMAN_EMPEROR_DESC: One extra Military policy slot in any [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government.[NEWLINE]+7 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking city-states.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_PAX_BRITANNICA_DESCRIPT: Cities settled 10 or more tiles from your capital receive a free melee unit. Constructing Royal Navy Dockyard grants you the strongest naval unit you can build. Naval melee units may escort civilian units at their higher movement speed. Gain the Redcoat unique unit when the Military Science technology is researched.[NEWLINE]Lighthouse grants +1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] Great Admiral point per turn.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_RIGHTEOUSNESS_OF_FAITH_: The worship building for their [ICON_RELIGION] Religion can be purchased by any player for just one-tenth of the usual [ICON_FAITH] Faith cost. It adds 10% to the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith to the city's output, increasing to 20% with Reformed Church.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_RELIGIOUS_CONVERT_DESCR: May not build [ICON_DISTRICT_HOLYSITE] Holy Site districts, gain [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophets, or found Religions. Receives +0.2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold per citizen in a city following any religion. Receives an Apostle (of that city's majority Religion) each time he finishes a [ICON_DISTRICT_MBANZA] Mbanza or [ICON_DISTRICT_THEATER] Theater Square district.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All land combat units and [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great Generals ignore the Rainforest and Woods [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement penalty.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_ROOSEVELT_COROLLARY_DES: Units receive a +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when defending on their home continent or attacking on a foreign continent. +1 Appeal to all tiles in a city with a National Park. Gain the Rough Rider unique unit when they research the Military Science technology.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_SATYAGRAHA_DESCRIPTION: Grants an extra belief when founding a [ICON_RELIGION] Religion. +5 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each civilization (including India) they have met that has founded a Religion and is not currently at war.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settlers and Builders produced in cities with a [ICON_DISTRICT_HOLYSITE] Holy Site receive +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. Opposing civilizations receive +50% war weariness for fighting against Gandhi.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_THUNDERBOLT_DESCRIPTION: +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength and +25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Naval Melee Units. Naval Melee units can perform coastal raids.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Units gain the ability to enter Ocean tiles after researching the Shipbuilding technology.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_FIRST_EMPEROR_DESCRIPTI: Builder receive an additional [ICON_CHARGES] charge. When building Ancient and Classical Wonders you may spend Builder [ICON_CHARGES] charge to complete 15% of the Wonder [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food per wonder built in each city. Canals are unlocked with the Masonry technology.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When completing a wonder receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration from the era of the wonder if available.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_FLYING_SQUADRON_DESCRIP: Has 1 level of [ICON_VisLimited] Diplomatic Visibility greater than normal with every civilization that she's met.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_TRAJANS_COLUMN_DESCRIPT: All founded cities get free Monument building after unlocking Early Empire.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_KILLER_OF_CYRUS_DESCRIP: All units receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking wounded units, increasing to +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength after you enter the Medieval Era. When they eliminate a unit, they heal up to 30 hit points.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_MAGNANIMOUS_DESCRIPTION: After recruiting or patronizing a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person, 20% of its [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point cost is refunded.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_SURROUNDED_BY_GLORY_DES: +5% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +5% [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per City-state you are the Suzerain of.[NEWLINE]Awards 1 [ICON_ENVOY] envoy when an Amphitheater is completed.
en_US.LOC_MACEDONIA_PERSIA_MOD_TEASER: New Civilizations and Leaders - Alexander the Great of Macedon and Cyrus of Persia
en_US.LOC_MACEDONIA_PERSIA_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Contains two new civilizations, two leaders, and two new world wonders.
en_US.LOC_MOD_ALEXANDER_SCENARIO_TEASER: Can you conquer an empire worthy of Alexander the Great? Lasts no more than 60 Turns.
en_US.LOC_MOD_ALEXANDER_SCENARIO_DESCRIPTION: In this timed single-player scenario, you must rush to expand your empire to truly earn the title of "Alexander the Great." This scenario emphasizes combat, territorial expansion, and calculated use of the Great Generals who will fight by your side.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]To win, conquer every city on the map within a number of turns determined by your difficulty level:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settler: 60 turns[NEWLINE]Warlord or Chieftain: 55 turns[NEWLINE]King or Prince: 50 turns[NEWLINE]Immortal or Emperor: 45 turns[NEWLINE]Deity: 37 turns
en_US.LOC_NAPOLEON_RULESET_TEASER: Claw territory from your enemies in this combat-focused scenario set in the Industrial Era. Lasts 50 Turns.[NEWLINE]Victory Conditions[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Prove yourself the grandest strategist of the Industrial Era by possessing the most territory at the turn limit.[NEWLINE]Gameplay Changes[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Greatly reduced unit maintanence costs.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Units no longer require strategic resources to be built.
en_US.LOC_NAPOLEON_VICTORY_DESC: Prove yourself the grandest strategist of the Industrial Era by possessing the most territory at the turn limit.
en_US.LOC_NAPOLEON_VICTORY_WIN_BLURB: "The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. The winner will be the one who controls that chaos, both his own and the enemies." —Napoleon Bonaparte
en_US.LOC_NAPOLEON_MOD_TEASER: Claw territory from your enemies in this combat-focused scenario set in the Industrial Era. Lasts 50 Turns.
en_US.LOC_NAPOLEON_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Victory Conditions[NEWLINE]Prove yourself the grandest strategist of the Industrial Era by possessing the most territory at the turn limit.
en_US.LOC_NAPOLEON_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_QUOT: "Victory belongs to the most persevering." —Napoleon Bonaparte

en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_FITZGERALD_1_QUOTE: Amory Blaine inherited from his mother every trait, except the stray inexpressible few, that made him worth while.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_FITZGERALD_2_QUOTE: She was dazzling—alight; it was agony to comprehend her beauty in a glance.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_WELLS_1_QUOTE: No one would have believed in the last years of the nineteenth century that this world was being watched keenly and closely by intelligences greater than man's and yet as mortal as his own...
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_WELLS_2_QUOTE: Very simple was my explanation, and plausible enough - as many wrong theories are!
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TAGORE_1_QUOTE: I am willing to serve my country, but my worship I reserve for Right which is far greater than my country. To worship my country as a god is to bring a curse upon it.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_TAGORE_2_QUOTE: If some wanderer, leaving home, come here to watch the night and with bowed head listen to the murmur of the darkness, who is there to whisper the secrets of life into his ears if I, shutting my doors, should try to free myself from mortal bonds?
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CAPEK_1_QUOTE: My dear Miss Glory, Robots are not human. Mechanically, they are more perfect than us, they possess an amazing rational intelligence, but they do not have any soul.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_CAPEK_2_QUOTE: Great God of the Ants, thou hast let the victory prevail! I hereby name thee the Colonel.
en_US.LOC_GREATWORK_SUN_TZU_QUOTE: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_PYRAMIDS_QUOTE: “From the heights of these pyramids, forty centuries look down on us.”[NEWLINE]– Napoleon Bonaparte
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_PETRA_QUOTE: “Petra is a brilliant display of man’s artistry in turning barren rock into majestic wonder.”[NEWLINE]– Edward Dawson
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_MONT_ST_MICHEL_QUOTE: “Church and State, Soul and Body, God and Man, are all one at Mont Saint Michel, and the business of all is to fight, each in his own way, or to stand guard for each other.”[NEWLINE]– Henry Adams
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_CHICHEN_ITZA_QUOTE: “The Great Ball Court is also very impressive. I would like to have seen them play a game, although it sounds like the end was pretty violent. I think it was safer to be a spectator.”[NEWLINE]– IslaDeb
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_STONEHENGE_QUOTE: “Can you imagine trying to talk six hundred people into helping you drag a fifty-ton stone eighteen miles across the countryside and muscle it into an upright position, and then saying, ‘Right, lads! Another twenty like that … and then we can party!”[NEWLINE]– Bill Bryson
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_ORACLE_QUOTE: “I sprang upon the swift ship in the form of a dolphin, pray to me as Apollo Delphinius; also the altar itself shall be called Delphinius and overlooked forever.”[NEWLINE]– Homer
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_TERRACOTTA_ARMY_QUOTE: “There were seven wonders in the world, and the discovery of the Terracotta Army, we may say, is the eighth miracle of the world.”[NEWLINE]– Jacques Chirac
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_ALHAMBRA_QUOTE: “Everything here appears calculated to inspire kind and happy feelings, for everything is delicate and beautiful.”[NEWLINE]– Washington Irving
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_CRISTO_REDENTOR_QUOTE: “Thus, the sculpture serves to give people one thought – ‘Everything is in God’s hands.’”[NEWLINE]– Sergey Semenov
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_POTALA_PALACE_QUOTE: “The first time I stepped onto the rooftop of the Potala Palace, I felt, as never before or since, as if I were stepping onto the rooftop of my being: onto some dimension of consciousness that I’d never visited before.”[NEWLINE]– Pico Iyer
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_HANGING_GARDENS_QUOTE: “The ascent to the highest story is by stairs, and at their side are water engines, by means of which persons, appointed expressly for the purpose, are continually employed in raising water from the Euphrates into the garden.”[NEWLINE]– Strabo
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_FORBIDDEN_CITY_QUOTE: “The whole palace complex is built along a central axis, the axis of the world, everything in the four directions suspend from this central point represented by these palaces.”[NEWLINE]– Jeffrey Riegel
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_HERMITAGE_QUOTE: “Museums are on the front lines of the fight for culture, of good with evil – in any case, of the fight against platitudes and primitiveness.”[NEWLINE]– Mikhail Piotrovsky, Director of the State Hermitage
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_EIFFEL_TOWER_QUOTE: “I ought to be jealous of the tower. She is more famous than I am.”[NEWLINE]– Gustave Eiffel
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSUS_QUOTE: “At Rhodes was set up a Colossus of seventy cubits high, representing the Sun … the artist expended as much bronze on it as seemed likely to create a dearth in the mines.”[NEWLINE]– Philo of Byzantium
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIGHTHOUSE_QUOTE: “This Lighthouse was the cynosure of all eyes.”[NEWLINE]– Henry David Thoreau
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_SYDNEY_OPERA_HOUSE_QUOTE: “An opera begins long before the curtain goes up and ends long after it has come down. It starts in my imagination, it becomes my life, and it stays part of my life long after I've left the opera house.”[NEWLINE]– Maria Callas
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_ZIMBABWE_QUOTE: “King Solomon gave the Queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.”[NEWLINE]– 1 Kings, 10:13
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_BIG_BEN_QUOTE: “Don’t watch the big clock; do what it does. Keep going.”[NEWLINE]– Sam Levenson
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_COLOSSEUM_QUOTE: “While the Colosseum stands, Rome shall stand; when the Colosseum falls, Rome shall fall; when Rome falls, the world shall fall.”[NEWLINE]– Saint Bede
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_ESTADIO_DO_MARACANA_QUOTE: “Down through its history, only three people have managed to silence the Maracana: the Pope, Frank Sinatra, and me.”[NEWLINE]– Alcides Ghiggia, Uruguayan soccer player
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_VENETIAN_ARSENAL_QUOTE: “The commonwealth of Venice in their armory have this inscription: ‘Happy is that city which in time of peace thinks of war.’”[NEWLINE]– Robert Burton
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_RUHR_VALLEY_QUOTE: “The industrial heart of Germany practically stopped beating. Hardly anyone worked; hardly anything ran. The population of the Ruhr area … had to be supported by the rest of the country.”[NEWLINE]– Adam Fergusson
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_MAHABODHI_TEMPLE_QUOTE: “In a dusty, bustling corner of the Indian state of Bihar, there is a magical place that one might think of as the hub of Buddhism.”[NEWLINE]– Visitor’s Guide, Bodh Gaya
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_HAGIA_SOPHIA_QUOTE: “It is a beautiful and important monument and an international, inter-cultural treasure … Unless and until it can be shared by both religions in harmony – which would be a grand idea – it should remain a secular building honoring both religions who have made it beautiful.”[NEWLINE]– Ljubo Vujovic
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_LIBRARY_QUOTE: “We can roam the bloated stacks of the Library of Alexandria, where all imagination and knowledge are assembled; we can recognize in its destruction the warning that all we gather will be lost.”[NEWLINE]– Alberto Manguel
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_OXFORD_UNIVERSITY_QUOTE: “The clever men at Oxford... Know all that there is to be knowed. But they none of them know one half as much... As intelligent Mr. Toad!”[NEWLINE]– Kenneth Grahame
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_BOLSHOI_THEATER_QUOTE: “Bolshoi Ballet is a universe of the imagination, a place of magic and enchantment, beauty and romance. Its many worlds vibrate with graceful dancers, glorious music, and sumptuous costumes.”[NEWLINE]– Trudy Garfunkel
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_BROADWAY_QUOTE: “There’s no business like show business.”[NEWLINE]– Irving Berlin, 'Annie Get Your Gun'
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LADY_OF_THE_REEDS_AND_MARSHES: Lady of the Reeds and Marshes
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DANCE_OF_THE_AURORA_DESCRIPTI: Holy Site districts get +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith from adjacent flat Tundra tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DESERT_FOLKLORE_DESCRIPTION: Holy Site districts get +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith from adjacent Desert tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_SACRED_PATH_DESCRIPTION: Holy Site districts get +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith from adjacent Rainforest, Woods, and Marsh tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RIVER_GODDESS_DESCRIPTION: Rivers give +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith adjacency to Holy Site Districts. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity to cities if they have a Holy Site district adjacent to a River.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DIVINE_SPARK_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point from Holy Site (Prophet), Campus (Scientist), and Theater Square (Writer) districts.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LADY_OF_THE_REEDS_AND_MARSHES: +1 [ICON_Production] Production from Marsh, Oasis, and Floodplains.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_IDOLS_DESCRIPTION: +3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from Mines over Luxury and Bonus resources.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_CRAFTSMEN_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Production] Production from Mines over Strategic resources.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_THE_FORGE_DESCRIPTION: +30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Ancient and Classical military units.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_WAR_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point for Encampment ([ICON_GreatGeneral] Great General), Harbor ([ICON_GREATADMIRAL] Great Admiral), and Commercial Hub ([ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant) districts.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_FERTILITY_RITES_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for [ICON_RESOURCE_CATTLE] Cattle, [ICON_RESOURCE_RICE] Rice, and [ICON_RESOURCE_WHEAT] Wheat tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_SETTLEMENTS_DESCRIP: +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Settlers.[NEWLINE]Border expansion rate is 50% faster and new cities get 2 free tiles on foundation.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GODDESS_OF_THE_HARVEST_DESCRI: Harvesting a resource or removing a feature receives [ICON_Faith] Faith equal to the other yield's quantity.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CITY_PATRON_GODDESS_DESCRIPTI: +40% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts in cities without a specialty [ICON_DISTRICT] district.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_EARTH_GODDESS_DESCRIPTION: +1 Faith [ICON_Faith] from tiles with Charming or better Appeal.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CATHEDRAL_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Cathedrals (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, 1 slot for Great Work of any type).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DAR_E_MEHR_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Dar-e Mehrs (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GURDWARA_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Gurdwaras (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +3 [ICON_FOOD] Food).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MEETING_HOUSE_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Meeting Houses (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MOSQUE_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Mosques (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, grants 1 free Missionary of that city's majority Religion when constructed, Missionaries and Apostles created here have +2 spreads).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PAGODA_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Pagodas (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_STUPA_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Stupas (+3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WAT_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Wats (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +3 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_FEED_THE_WORLD_DESCRIPTION: Shrines and Temples provide [ICON_Food] Food equal to their intrinsic [ICON_Faith] Faith output.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_JESUIT_EDUCATION_DESCRIPTION: May purchase Campus and Theater Square district buildings with [ICON_FAITH] Faith. Reduce purchase cost for Campus and Theater Square buildings by 15%.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIQUARIES_DESCRIPTION: [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics have triple yield of both [ICON_Faith] Faith and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_COMMUNITY_DESCRIPTI: Holy Site Districts, Shrines, and Temples each provide +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WARRIOR_MONKS_DESCRIPTION: Allows spending [ICON_FAITH] Faith to train Warrior Monks, land combat units with a unique promotion tree. May be purchased in a city with a Shrine in its Holy Site.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC_DESCRIPTION: Shrines and Temples provide [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production equal to their intrinsic [ICON_FAITH] Faith output.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_ZEN_MEDITATION_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity in cities with a specialty district.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CHURCH_PROPERTY_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for each city following this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CROSS_CULTURAL_DIALOGUE_DESCR: +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for every 3 followers of this Religion in other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LAY_MINISTRY_DESCRIPTION: Each Holy Site or Theater Square district in a city following this Religion provides +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith or +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture respectively.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PILGRIMAGE_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every city following this Religion in other civilizations and City-States.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_UNITY_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy at each City-State when it first adopts this Religion, in addition to any envoy from a City-State quest.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_STEWARDSHIP_DESCRIPTION: Each Campus or Commercial Hub district in a city following this Religion provides +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science or +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold respectively.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WORLD_CHURCH_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every 3 followers of this Religion in other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_BURIAL_GROUNDS_DESCRIPTION: Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Holy Site.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DEFENDER_OF_FAITH_DESCRIPTION: Combat units gain +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when within the borders of friendly cities that follow this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_HOLY_ORDER_DESCRIPTION: Missionaries and Apostles are 25% cheaper to produce
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_ITINERANT_PREACHERS_DESCRIPTI: Religion spreads to cities 30% further away.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_JUST_WAR_DESCRIPTION: Combat units gain +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength near foreign cities that follow this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MISSIONARY_ZEAL_DESCRIPTION: Religious units ignore [ICON_Movement] Movement costs of terrain and features.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_MONASTIC_ISOLATION_DESCRIPTIO: Your Religion's pressure never drops due to losses in Theological Combat.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_COLONIZATION_DESCRI: Cities start with this Religion in place if founded by a player who has this as their majority Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_SCRIPTURE_DESCRIPTION: Religious spread from adjacent city pressure is 25% stronger. Boosted to 50% once Printing is researched.
en_US.LOC_RELIGIOUS_COMBAT_RULESET_TEASER: Battle for holy domination in this religion-focused scenario set in the Medieval Era. Lasts until the Industrial Era.[NEWLINE]Victory Conditions[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Holy Victory - Have the most religious followers at the dawn of the Industrial Era (first Industrial technology or civic)[NEWLINE]Gameplay Changes[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]First Holy Site grants a free Great Prophet.
en_US.LOC_RELIGIOUS_COMBAT_VICTORY_DESC: Have the most religious followers at the dawn of the Industrial Era (first Industrial technology or civic)
en_US.LOC_RELIGIOUS_COMBAT_MOD_TEASER: Battle for holy domination in this religion-focused scenario set in the Medieval Era.  Lasts until the Industrial Era.
en_US.LOC_RELIGIOUS_COMBAT_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Victory Conditions[NEWLINE]Holy Victory - Have the most religious followers at the dawn of the Industrial Era (first Industrial technology or civic)
en_US.LOC_ROUTE_ANCIENT_ROAD_DESCRIPTION: Can be constructed through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes or by Military Engineers. Improves [ICON_Movement] Movement speed of any unit moving from one road tile to another.
en_US.LOC_ROUTE_MEDIEVAL_ROAD_DESCRIPTION: Can be constructed through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes or by Military Engineers. Improves [ICON_Movement] Movement speed of any unit moving from one road tile to another.
en_US.LOC_ROUTE_INDUSTRIAL_ROAD_DESCRIPTION: Can be constructed through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes or by Military Engineers. Improves [ICON_Movement] Movement speed of any unit moving from one road tile to another.
en_US.LOC_ROUTE_MODERN_ROAD_DESCRIPTION: Can be constructed through [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes or by Military Engineers. Improves [ICON_Movement] Movement speed of any unit moving from one road tile to another.
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_CHINA_MOD_TEASER: New Alternate Leaders - Yongle of China, Wu Zetian of China, and Qin (Unifier) of China
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_CHINA_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Contains 3 new alternative Leaders for existing Civilizations. Includes Yongle, Wu Zetian, and Qin (Unifier).
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_ENGLAND_MOD_TEASER: New Alternate Leaders - Elizabeth I of England, Harald Hardrada (Varangian) of Norway, and Victoria (Age of Steam) of England
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_ENGLAND_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Contains 3 new alternative Leaders for existing Civilizations. Includes Elizabeth I, Harald Hardrada (Varangian), and Victoria (Age of Steam).
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_THE_SAHARA_MOD_TITLE: Rulers of the Sahara Leader Pack
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_THE_SAHARA_MOD_TEASER: New Alternate Leaders - Ramses II of Egypt, Sundiata Keita of Mali, and Cleopatra (Ptolemaic) of Egpyt
en_US.LOC_RULERS_OF_THE_SAHARA_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Contains 3 new alternative Leaders for existing Civilizations. Includes Ramses II, Sundiata Keita, and Cleopatra (Ptolemaic).
en_US.LOC_TECH_POTTERY_DESCRIPTION: Allows harvesting of Bonus resources improved by Farms.
en_US.LOC_TECH_ANIMAL_HUSBANDRY_DESCRIPTION: Allows harvesting of [ICON_RESOURCE_CATTLE] Cattle, [ICON_RESOURCE_SHEEP] Sheep, and [ICON_RESOURCE_DEER] Deer.
en_US.LOC_TECH_MINING_DESCRIPTION: Allows chopping of Woods, and harvesting of [ICON_RESOURCE_Copper] Copper.
en_US.LOC_TECH_IRRIGATION_DESCRIPTION: Allows clearing of Marsh, and harvesting of [ICON_RESOURCE_BANANAS] Bananas.
en_US.LOC_TECH_BRONZE_WORKING_DESCRIPTION: Allows chopping of Rainforest. Reveals [ICON_RESOURCE_IRON] Iron.
en_US.LOC_TECH_SHIPBUILDING_DESCRIPTION: Allows all land units to embark.
en_US.LOC_TECH_CELESTIAL_NAVIGATION_DESCRIPTIO: Allows Traders to embark, and allows harvesting of [ICON_RESOURCE_FISH] Fish and [ICON_RESOURCE_CRABS] Crabs.
en_US.LOC_TECH_CASTLES_DESCRIPTION: Bonus [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for the Great Wall improvement for adjacency. Gain a free Spy if playing as France.
en_US.LOC_TECH_CARTOGRAPHY_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold from the Fishing Boat improvement. All naval and embarked units can navigate Ocean tiles.
en_US.LOC_TECH_PRINTING_DESCRIPTION: Provides one more level of diplomatic visibility on all other civilizations. All [ICON_Tourism] Tourism yields from [ICON_GreatWork_Writing] Great Works of Writing are doubled.
en_US.LOC_TECH_STEAM_POWER_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for embarked units. +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement for all naval units. +50% [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism for Great Works of Art.
en_US.LOC_TECH_FLIGHT_DESCRIPTION: Receive [ICON_Tourism] Tourism on tile improvements equivalent to their [ICON_Culture] Culture output.  Amount of [ICON_Tourism] Tourism generated is equivalent to the improvement's [ICON_Culture] Culture output.
en_US.LOC_TECH_STEEL_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks Urban Defenses, giving all of your cities an automatic 300 Fortification Strength and the ability to perform a ranged attack. All previous wall improvements become obsolete and siege support units are no longer effective.
en_US.LOC_TECH_FUTURE_TECH_DESCRIPTION: Can be completed multiple times, increasing your points towards the Score Victory.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_SAILING: Found a city on the Coast.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_ARCHERY: Kill a unit with a Slinger.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MILITARY_TACTICS: Kill a unit with a Spearman.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_SQUARE_RIGGING: Kill a unit with a Musketman.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_ASTRONOMY: Build a University adjacent to a Mountain.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BALLISTICS: Have 2 Forts in your territory. Both constructed by a Military Engineer.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MILITARY_SCIENCE: Kill a unit with a Knight.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_FLIGHT: Build an Industrial era or later wonder.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_GUIDANCE_SYSTEMS: Kill a unit with a Fighter.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_MUST_STEAL: Boost through Great Scientist or Spy.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SAILING: Gaining a city on the Coast has given your civilization insight into navigating the waves.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ASTROLOGY: Discovering a natural wonder has inspired your people with the majesty of the universe.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_IRRIGATION: Farming a resource has given you an appreciation of the importance of irrigating your crops.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ARCHERY: After finally killing an enemy with a Slinger, you long for a stronger ranged weapon.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_WRITING: After meeting another civilization you see the need for new ways to communicate.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASONRY: Quarrying a resource has given you the raw materials you need to employ masons.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BRONZE_WORKIN: Your fights with Barbarians highlight the need for stronger weaponry.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_THE_WHEEL: Your mining operations have given you the ability to create an axle. Will the wheel follow?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CELESTIAL_NAV: Your fishermen are learning how to guide their travels based on studying the night sky.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CURRENCY: Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route directly exchanges goods, but a medium of exchange would make trade more flexible.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_HORSEBACK_RID: With animals now domesticated into Pastures, it is time to learn to ride.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_IRON_WORKING: Access to a steady source of Iron has enabled you to build better weapons and stronger armor.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SHIPBUILDING: Constructing a squadron of Galleys has taught you much about building larger ships.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MATHEMATICS: Your district planners have worked out the basics of geometry. Maybe a full mathematical system will follow soon?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CONSTRUCTION: Work on the Water Mill has taught your workers much about construction practices.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ENGINEERING: Completing walls around your city demonstrated the principles of engineering needed for Aqueducts and Catapults.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_TACT: Your spearmen are proving effective, but now your opponents are stronger and faster. Perhaps a longer weapon is needed?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_APPRENTICESHI: With raw materials now coming in from a wide variety of mines, the need to better teach new craftsmen to use them is essential.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STIRRUPS: The feudal lords in your realm want a champion to defend their lands. Perhaps mounting an armored warrior will do the trick?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MACHINERY: You look to machinery to improve the performance of your sizable contingent of ranged troops.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_EDUCATION: The teachings from your Great Scientist have inspired a renewed interest in learning in your realm.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_ENGI: Your military leaders carefully followed the progress on your aqueduct. They see new ways to use these engineering skills.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CASTLES: Our new government’s defense minister suggests that we might want to build impressive defenses to protect our bustling capital.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CARTOGRAPHY: With so many ships leaving the harbors of your empire you long to document your explorations.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MASS_PRODUCTI: Now that you have a ready supply of standardized boards, your shipping industry will soon take off.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BANKING: Your emerging guilds have plans that require a large influx of gold. Perhaps we can find a way to let them take out a loan?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUNPOWDER: Your men at the armory are fashioning a new weapon that will devastate opponents.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PRINTING: Out of necessity your scholars are devising methods for quickly copying books.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SQUARE_RIGGIN: The success of your Musketmen on land has spurred a new idea: what if we upgrade to gunpowder weaponry at sea?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ASTRONOMY: Your scientists are hiking into the mountains for a sharper view of the heavens. Maybe a permanent facility would help?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_METAL_CASTING: With so many Crossbowmen in the field, we’ve had a lot of practice studying ranged weapons.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SIEGE_TACTICS: After creating bombards you realize that castles are not impregnable – you need a stauncher defense!.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_INDUSTRIALIZA: The busy workshops of your empire hint at greatness to come. Is an Industrial Revolution about to commence?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SCIENTIFIC_TH: The dawning of an age of enlightenment in our realm has sparked a serious discourse on our scientific methods.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BALLISTICS: Your cities have been protected by multiple fortifications, what if they could be defended by cannons?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_MILITARY_SCIE: Your valiant Knight has vanquished his foe. Let us learn from this victory and become students of military affairs.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STEAM_POWER: Let us apply our industrial acumen to your newly-constructed shipyards. Steam-powered naval vessels could rule the seas.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SANITATION: With the introduction of neighborhoods, our cities are growing larger than ever before.  Developing a sanitation plan is crucial.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ECONOMICS: The power of your banks in on the rise.  It is time to formally study the forces that are shaping your national economy.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RIFLING: With a source of niter, your firearms industry is switching into top gear. The next step will be to improve our accuracy.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_FLIGHT: Having completed a modern wonder, our engineers are sure they can tackle anything. What, are they thinking of flying next?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REPLACEABLE_P: Your armament makers are tired of having to hand craft so many muskets.  Perhaps some standardization would help?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_STEEL: Your coal-powered blast furnaces and test runs with an Ironclad should soon allow us to produce the finest-grade steel.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ELECTRICITY: Your crafty privateers are intrigued by the discovery of electric current. Could they use this to create stealthy propulsion?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_RADIO: Your new national park needs visitors. Perhaps a new form of communications will help advertise it?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_CHEMISTRY: Joining forces with other nations has started a chain reaction of scientific advances.  Will the next push be in chemistry?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMBUSTION: Your archaeologist has noticed petroleum seeping out of the rocks. Perhaps your geologists would like to take a look?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ADVANCED_FLIG: Your extensive experience with biplanes has led to several aeronautic breakthroughs.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ADVANCED_BALL: Development of new power plants has spurred on industrial advances that could help your armament production.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMBINED_ARMS: Now that your military has expanded could it be further enhanced with a new resource?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_PLASTICS: Having a source of petrochemicals should lead to many advances. Its plasticity is of particular interest.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMPUTERS: A modern government comes with a lot of bureaucracy. Developing ways to efficiently track data will be a huge help.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_SYNTHETIC_MAT: With facilities for aircrafts in multiple cities, your aeronautic industry is taking off.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_TELECOMMUNICA: With your pioneers in radio and television leading the way, you’ve grown adept at transmitting data quickly.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_GUIDANCE_SYST: Your military has defeated an enemy plane. Now it is time to have the best defense against enemy aircraft.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_COMPOSITES: Tanks have been the backbone of your army so your scientists are striving for a more advanced model.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_ROBOTICS: Having a diverse set of metals to experiment on will help your scientists push into new fields.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NANOTECHNOLOG: Having a diverse set of metals to experiment on will help your scientists push into new fields.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_TEAM_MEMBER_O: A team member has shared their research notes for a recently acquired technology. Their innovation will improve our own progress dramatically.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_STATEMENT: You have achieved the level of {1_LeaderName}
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_1_QUOTE: I found Rome a city of bricks and left it a city of marble.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_2_QUOTE: The first duty of government is to protect the powerless from the powerful.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_3_QUOTE: Leave nothing for tomorrow which can be done today.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_4_QUOTE: Where there is great power there is great responsibility; where there is less power there is less responsibility; and where there is no power there can, I think, be no responsibility.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_5_QUOTE: Real leaders must be ready to sacrifice all for the freedom of their people.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_6_QUOTE: Power without a nation's confidence is nothing.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_7_QUOTE: It is forbidden to decry other sects; the true believer gives honor to whatever in them is worthy of honor.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_8_QUOTE: The object of life is not to be on the side of the majority, but to escape finding oneself in the ranks of the insane.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_9_QUOTE: As a nation, we have the right to decide our own affairs, to mold our own future.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_10_QUOTE: Hear ye, all persons! Ye people as many as ye are! I have done things according to the design of my heart.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_11_QUOTE: Let us be firm, pure and faithful; at the end of our sorrow, there is the greatest glory of the world, that of the men who did not give in.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_13_QUOTE: To shave the beard is a sin that the blood of all martyrs cannot cleanse. It is to deface the image of God.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_14_QUOTE: What the country needs is a good big laugh … if someone could get off a good joke every ten days, I think our troubles would be over.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_15_QUOTE: Every time that I fill a high office, I create a hundred discontented men and an ingrate.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_17_QUOTE: A man who is always ready to believe what is told him will never do well.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_18_QUOTE: Our most dangerous tendency is to expect too much of government, and at the same time do for it too little.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_19_QUOTE: In the name of the Holy Trinity, three things do I promise to this Christian people, my subjects: first, that I will hold God's Church and all the Christian people of my realm in true peace; secondly, that I will forbid all rapine and injustice to men of all conditions; thirdly, that I promise and enjoin justice and mercy in all judgments.
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_20_QUOTE: In thee, O Lord, is my trust; let me never be confounded: if God be for us, who can be against us?
en_US.LOC_UI_ENDGAME_RANKING_LEADER_21_QUOTE: We are ready for any unforeseen event that may or may not occur.

en_US.LOC_UNIT_SETTLER_DESCRIPTION: May create new cities. Reduces city's [ICON_Citizen] Population by 1 when completed.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION: May create tile improvements, remove features like Woods or Rainforest, or Harvest some resources. Builders can be used 3 times. This can be increased through policies or wonders like the Pyramids.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_TRADER_DESCRIPTION: May make and maintain a single [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route. Automatically creates Roads as it travels. Can embark once either Celestial Navigation or Shipbuilding are researched.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MISSIONARY_DESCRIPTION: May convert [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to their Religion. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).
en_US.LOC_UNIT_APOSTLE_DESCRIPTION: May convert [ICON_Citizen] Citizens to their Religion and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions. Once per game may Launch Inquisition to allow the purchase of Inquisitors. Once per game may Evangelize Belief to add an additional Belief to their Religion. These uses consume the Apostle.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_INQUISITOR_DESCRIPTION: May eliminate the presence of other Religions in their territory, and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GURU_DESCRIPTION: May use a charge to heal itself and all adjacent friendly religious units. May not initiate theological combat with units of other Religions (but can defend).
en_US.LOC_UNIT_WARRIOR_MONK_DESCRIPTION: Fast-moving land combat unit with a unique promotion tree.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receives all combat bonuses of melee units except bonus vs. anti-cavalry. Receives bonuses from [ICON_GREATGENERAL] Great General from any era. Has scaling cost that depends on advancement through Tech and Civics tree.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Has unique ability Battle Meditation: +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for every researched civic (up to and including Industrial Era).
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ARCHAEOLOGIST_DESCRIPTION: Find and extract [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] Artifacts from [ICON_RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE] Antiquity Sites to be displayed in their home city's Museum.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SPY_DESCRIPTION: Performs secret missions in foreign cities and protects your cities from enemy Spies.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_NATURALIST_DESCRIPTION: A late-game civilian who can create a single National Park to attract [ICON_Tourism] Tourists. Must be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
