en_US.LOC_DEAL_AI_HAS_NO_CAP_ROOM: They already have the maximum amount of this item.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_SAPA_INCA_LOW_MOUNTAI: Pachacuti is pleased you have few cities near Mountains
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_SAPA_INCA_HIGH_MOUNTA: Pachacuti is displeased because you have many cities near Mountains
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_SICILIAN_WARS_LOW_COA: Dido is pleased you have few coastal cities
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_SICILIAN_WARS_HIGH_CO: Dido is displeased because you have many coastal cities
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_EXPANSION: They like Empires that claim a lot of land, and dislike those that do not
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_GREAT_WHI: They like Empires with significant navies
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_FLAT_EART: They dislike those who try to leave the Earth
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_HIGH_FAVO: They do not like you competing so actively for Favor
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_LOW_FAVOR: They are happy you are not earning much Favor
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_HIGH_TOUR: They are unhappy that your Tourism is so strong
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_LOW_TOURI: They are pleased you are not competing in Tourism
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_INTOLERANT_SAME: They are happy you share a religion
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_INTOLERANT_ENCROACHIN: They are angry that your religion is present in their empire
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_HIGH_DIPL: They are angry that you are getting closer to a Diplomatic Victory
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_LOW_DIPLO: They are pleased you are not a threat for Diplomatic Victory
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_HIGH_PILL: They are pleased to see another civilization who enjoys pillaging
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MODIFIER_DESCRIPTION_LOW_PILLA: They would like to see you pillage opponents more often
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_: War? Are you a fool? Your cities will suffer the fate of Epirus and Saguntum.
I regret that we must now go to war with each other—but I regret it only a little.
I regret that we must now go to war with each other—but I regret it only a little.
Sweden will chastise those who threaten the world. Prepare yourself for war.
Look at the big civ leader over there with the war declaration! Great job, mate. Really shows off how hard you are.
As we can reach no peaceful resolution with you Canada must turn, with reluctance, to war.
Enough! My forbearance ends here! We must have war between us, instead of a false peace.
Surely you had to know that one day there would be war between us.
Now is the time for war. Hear the stamp of our warriors—warriors with the hearts of the puma.
Good. The world shall witness the incontestable might of my armies and the glory of the Empire.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_DID: Now we have war between us. Look to the seas—already the horizon is crowded with the sails of my fleets.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELE: I see weak lands, led by a weak ruler. You see my armies massing to overthrow you.
I see weak lands, led by a weak ruler. You see my armies massing to overthrow you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_KRI: Sweden will do her part to push back the evils of the world. Art is one way to do this—war with you is another.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_KUP: You choose death! Your people wail and moan! The pillars of your houses shake, all your lands are shaking!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_LAU: As an unstinting malignancy defines your relationship to Canada, we have no recourse than war.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_MAN: Your transgressions are as deep as oceans. O God, grant that I may chastise this one!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_MAT: Your insolence has provoked this war, and I shall be happy to lead the Black Army to victory over you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_PAC: Let there be war between us! I will wrestle your lands away, and rule your subjects with strength.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_WAR_FROM_AI_LEADER_SUL: Your continued insolence and failure to recognize my preeminence leads us to war.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_REASON_FROM_AI_LEADER: (You are not treating the environment well.)
(Your cities and trade routes are not very profitable.)
(You have not levied many city-state troops.)
(You are gaining too many cities near Mountains.)
(You are gaining too many cities along the coast.)
(You have circumnavigated or worked to get into space.)
(You are spreading your religion into their empire.)
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_DIDO_ANY: I, Dido, queen and mother of Carthage, greet you on behalf of the Phoenicians.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_ELEANOR_ENGL: Welcome to the court of Eleanor, Duchess of Aquitaine, Queen consort of France and England, the judge of love. What tidings?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_ELEANOR_FRAN: Welcome to the court of Eleanor, Duchess of Aquitaine, Queen consort of France and England, the judge of love. What tidings?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_KRISTINA_ANY: I am Kristina, queen of Sweden, patron of arts and letters. Do I greet a fellow lover of learning?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_KUPE_ANY: I am Kupe the navigator, and you approach the place of the Māori. Will you tell me about yourself?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_LAURIER_ANY: On behalf of the people of Canada, welcome. I am Prime Minister Laurier.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_MANSA_MUSA_A: I am Sultan Musa, lord of Mali, and—thanks be to God—a very, very rich man. I am pleased to meet you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_MATTHIAS_COR: I am Matthias. I am King of Hungary, scourge of my foes, and defender of the faithful. Greetings.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_PACHACUTI_AN: You stand before Pachacuti Inca Yupanqui. I accept your greeting and the service you can provide the Inca.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_LEADER_SULEIMAN_ANY: From the magnificence of Topkapi, I, Suleiman, Kayser-I Rum, bestow upon you my welcome.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_VISIT_RECIPIENT_LEA: Come and see the great Phoenician cities. Carry word of it back to your land, and to the rest of the world.
I have invited the visitors from your lands to come and visit my fair court.
I have invited the visitors from your lands to come and visit my fair court.
Your representatives are most welcome to come and view my collections for themselves.
I brought your people to my marae, which does them honor. I hope you will likewise give some respect.
Please come to visit the capital of Canada. Our people would be honored by your visit.
Please, come visit the capital of Mali! It is a place of great learning—and profit, too.
I will personally lead your delegates on a tour of my capital, that they may understand the power of Hungary more fully.
Come and witness what the Inca have done under my guidance.
I would welcome your representatives to take in the sight of my palace and my capital, that they may be awed by its majesty.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_NEAR_INITIATOR_POSI: Good. This offer benefits both our people.
Your terms are good. Let our chanceries work out the details.
Your terms are good. Let our chanceries work out the details.
Sweden thanks you, as do I.
Yes. But only because I'm such a generous guy.
Canada thanks you for an equitable exchange.
Yes. I agree to your terms on behalf of Hungary.
Yes, the Inca will grant you this.
Great is my charity! It will be done.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_FIRST_MEET_NO_MANS_INFO_EXCHAN: Tell me of the location of your capital, that our maps might be complete. I shall share our capital's location in exchange.
I delight in hearing of distant lands. If you tell me of your capital, I shall share the location of mine.
I delight in hearing of distant lands. If you tell me of your capital, I shall share the location of mine.
I will inform your delegates of the location of our capital, but I expect that you will grant us the same favor.
I would welcome guests from you to my marae, but in exchange, you should tell me where your capital is.
We would be honored to welcome representatives to learn about our capital. Grant us the same courtesy, if you will.
Shall we fill the empty places on our maps with the locations of our mutual capitals?
I invite your people to learn of the capital of Hungary, but only if you grant me the same right.
If your scouts can climb as high as my palace, they may learn its location. But I would ask the location of your capital in exchange.
If you tell me of the location of your capital, I shall make a gift of my capital's location, as a sign of my generous intent.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_DIDO_ANY: May prosperity come to your cities—the ones away from the coast.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_DIDO_ANY: We have no interest in the land-that is for you to claim-but the seas and the shores are Phoenician
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_ELEANOR_ENGLA: I am told you have placed great cities near our common border, like a garden of splendid roses. Delightful!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_ELEANOR_EN: If you are going to trouble yourself to make cities near our border, at least make them beautiful, prosperous cities, so I may enjoy the view.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_ELEANOR_FRANC: I am told you have placed great cities near our common border, like a garden of splendid roses. Delightful!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_ELEANOR_FR: If you are going to trouble yourself to make cities near our border, at least make them beautiful, prosperous cities, so I may enjoy the view.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_KRISTINA_ANY: I’ve just acquired a new work and will host a viewing soon. Your emissaries are invited to attend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_KRISTINA_A: I suppose you think art is great when it ties a room together, you philistine.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_KUPE_ANY: Your land stays green and your waters are clean and clear. Choice.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_KUPE_ANY: You pile filth on the land and dump it in the sea! You waste and spoil the world!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_LAURIER_ANY: You have proved a reliable partner in resolving international conflict, Canada commends you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_LAURIER_AN: Why do you not help resolve the crises that affect the world? Are you unmoved by the plight of others?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_MANSA_MUSA_AN: Rejoice with me, friend, for we are free from every want and can devote our time to the will of God.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_MANSA_MUSA: What have you done, that God has withdrawn his bounty from you? See that you return to righteousness!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_MATTHIAS_CORV: The quickest way to success is to levy the strengths of your little allies, wouldn’t you agree?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_MATTHIAS_C: They say you pay your auxiliaries in patriotism. That and two pennies will buy them a beer.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_PACHACUTI_ANY: You recognize that the Inca are the masters of the heights. This shows wisdom on your part.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_PACHACUTI_: The Inca are the masters of the mountains. Do not challenge me on this ground. Be content with the lowlands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_EXIT_LEADER_SULEIMAN_ANY: You, too, must possess the wisdom of Solomon, for your nation is made of many people who live in harmony.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_EXIT_LEADER_SULEIMAN_A: If you would be master of the world, you must first be master of your people—and you show no signs of mastery in this matter.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: It is better that you lack ambition to claim land, because I believe you lack the acumen to rule what you would take.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: How can you dare to claim such lands for yourself, when your people are weak and so badly led?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_QIN_REASON_EXPANSI: I am pleased you have chosen to remain a barbarian people, whose kingdom merely emphasizes my glory.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_QIN_REASON_EXPA: I am the Emperor of all under heaven. That means all lands, including those you seek to possess for yourself, are rightfully mine.  Do not strive to equal me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: I agree with you—There are too many pressing problems on earth to be pinning our hopes on space.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: How can you think about a future in space, when the present situation on earth should command your full attention!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_CLEOPATRA_REASON_A: Blessed is the one who leaves the heavens to the Gods, and does not aspire to walk among them.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_CLEOPATRA_REASO: Do not approach the sun god Amun-Ra, nor the sky goddess Nut! Your impiety offends them! You will bring about the ruin of the world!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: Those of us with great navies can make our will felt across the world, and we are the true masters of the seas.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: You must make an effort at building ships and projecting your power across the seas, or no nation will respect you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT_REASON: So, you seek to challenge our supremacy at sea? Bully! I relish the competition!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_T_ROOSEVELT_REA: Do you so readily concede competition in the arena of the seas? Why intentionally constrain your sovereignty? Are you afraid?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: I am pleased that you are ready to accept me as the supreme leader of this planet. Already others whisper that my time is at hand.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: I see through your honeyed words and your curried favors. You seek ultimate power for yourself, and you would have the nations give it to you of their own free will.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_PERICLES_REASON_AG: You will never know the joy of a responsive mob to a good speech, because you never practice the art of politics.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_PERICLES_REASON: I’ll ostracize you for what you’re doing! Playing on emotions of the mob is my route to power!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: We’ve started a tour package for your citizens who want a world-class vacation. Apparently, nothing like this exists in your civilization.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: I know the world is beating a path to your tourist sites, but be warned! Our people possess blue jeans and rock music and are not afraid to use them.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_MVEMBA_REASON_AGEN: Your people have a simple culture. It is amusing and somewhat tragic. You could learn from the rest of the world.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_MVEMBA_REASON_A: Vibrant and unique cultures are threatened by the rising tide of your popular culture.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: How happy is the land whose ruler follows the one true religion, and protects the souls of his people!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: Blasphemy and heresy spill from the lips of your subjects! You must restore your people’s souls by restoring the true religion!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_PEDRO_REASON_AGEND: You know that a good ruler leads the souls of his people on the right course, and in doing so brings the blessings of heaven to them.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_PEDRO_REASON_AG: I fear you have mistaken spreading religious infidelity for a lively carnival of ideas.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: Maximal freedom can come only from civilizations pursuing their own interests, wouldn’t you say?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: By what right do you impose your political agenda on my sovereign civilization? I do not consent to be ruled against my will.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_BARBAROSSA_REASON_: I am pleased that you recognize these political gestures are mere games, devoid of true power and without respect for the right of rule.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_BARBAROSSA_REAS: Your attempts at creating this greater political union comes close to stealing the authority of my crown. I do not take kindly to those who do not respect this crown.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: Your enemies know you by flame and fear. They pray to be delivered from your wrath, but the heavens are silent.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: Your enemies make war on you, but you do not plunder their lands in retribution. Is it out of cowardice? Or an excess of politeness?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_HARDRADA_REASON_AG: Good! You punish your enemies with fire and sword until they tremble at the sound of your name. Pity you were not born a Viking.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_HARDRADA_REASON: You lack the courage to punish your enemies, and you lack the fortitude to make their lands an ashen wasteland. Pathetic.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: Good fences make good neighbors, and good defenses a peaceable kingdom. I am pleased you are content to protect your lands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: In your rush to war and conquest, you set events into motion whose course you cannot foresee. Better to stay home and protect, than go abroad and conquer.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_HOJO_REASON_AGENDA: Ambition for territory is the seed that ruins dynasties. I am pleased you seek only to defend your lands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_HOJO_REASON_AGE: I perceive your conquests with concern, but not with fear. Know that if you invade Japan, the very wind and seas will come to our aid.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_KUDO_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGENDA_: Your treasury is filling up quite nicely. It's always nice to have such strong income, isn't it?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_LEADER_ANY_REASON_AGEN: Your empire is headed toward bankruptcy.  How can you survive with debt piling up?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: When two great peoples such as ours share such an accord, it is right to call them friends.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: You flatter yourself. Phoenicia recognizes the existence of your nation—but we do not recognize a mutual friendship.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: Come, gracious one, and declare to the world that you stand as Phoenicia's friend!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_: I do not consent to this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Your delegation is welcome, and will find rest among us.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Phoenicia has no need of your delegation, for we already have the measure of your people.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_DIDO: Accept these gifts of murex purple, Lebanon cedar, and olives—a mere taste of the wealth of Phoenicia.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_DID: Your senators call for our destruction and you dare acclaim them as orators? You walk blind into your destruction.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_DIDO_A: I pray you are sent into the fire for Moloch! I pray you be made an offering to Mot! I pray Yam rises and devours you! (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_D: You have been just and righteous towards Phoenicia. Will you take the next step and declare that we are allies?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: You have made your point. Let us have peace, before we make a ruin of the world.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: No. You ask in vain.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_DIDO: I offer you peace—a happier choice than ruined walls and lamentation songs.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Yes. Crossing freely through our lands will enrich both our people.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: I see little gain in allowing your units to trample our lands. Do not cross the frontiers of Phoenicia.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_DI: A mindless insistence on the fiction of borders is for lesser rulers. Let us open our borders to each other.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: What treachery do you intend? Move your armies away from our borders at once.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_DIDO_ANY: Do not glory in your conquest. One day you may see your capital bathed in flame.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: I do not consent to this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Yes, you are indeed a good friend to me, and I am pleased to recognize you as such.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Your admiration is flattering, but I reject it.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: So few understand the art of the monarch as we do. Should we not tell the world we stand as friends?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_: How could I turn down such a charming offer?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Your delegation has been welcomed as guests to my court. I will send you a copy of the poems written to mark the occasion.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Paltry fare, offered badly, has no place in my court.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEA: Be pleased to accept my gifts: a crystal vase, wine, truffles, and a dozen troubadours to enliven your court.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_ELE: A time will come when you pay for your misdeeds. And after that, a time when your name will live only as the villain of comical verse.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEANO: Because your deeds promote only darkness and deceit, I will stand opposed to you—and stand for love and laughter! (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_GREETING_LEADER_ELEANOR_ENGLAN: Ah! We were just talking about you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_E: Have we not long found agreement in our affairs? Let us formalize this with an alliance.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: To prolong this war would pass from laudable gallantry to lamentable slaughter. Join me in peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: Assuredly not.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEA: Congratulations—your martial prowess is proven. Have you a heart for peace, or is this the extent of your character?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Let our borders be open, then!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Open my lands to your spies and vagrants? Certainly not. Be content with your own borders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_EL: I open my lands to those units of yours that would cross them, but I ask leave likewise from you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Parading your forces in such a manner speaks of a desperate weakness, and not strength. Move them from my borders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEANOR_: If your lust for power drives you to destroy my rule, so be it! I will still rule the court of love.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: Your terms are good. Let our chanceries work out the details.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Yes, you are indeed a good friend to me, and I am pleased to recognize you as such.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Your admiration is flattering, but I reject it.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: So few understand the art of the monarch as we do. Should we not tell the world we stand as friends?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_: How could I turn down such a charming offer?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Your delegation has been welcomed as guests to my court. I will send you a copy of the poems written to mark the occasion.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Paltry fare, offered badly, has no place in my court.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEA: Be pleased to accept my gifts: a crystal vase, wine, truffles, and a dozen troubadours to enliven your court.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_ELE: A time will come when you pay for your misdeeds. And after that, a time when your name will live only as the villain of comical verse.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEANO: Because your deeds promote only darkness and deceit, I will stand opposed to you—and stand for love and laughter! (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_GREETING_LEADER_ELEANOR_FRANCE: Ah! We were just talking about you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_E: Have we not long found agreement in our affairs? Let us formalize this with an alliance.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: To prolong this war would pass from laudable gallantry to lamentable slaughter. Join me in peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: Assuredly not.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEA: Congratulations—your martial prowess is proven. Have you a heart for peace, or is this the extent of your character?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Let our borders be open, then!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Open my lands to your spies and vagrants? Certainly not. Be content with your own borders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_EL: I open my lands to those units of yours that would cross them, but I ask leave likewise from you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Parading your forces in such a manner speaks of a desperate weakness, and not strength. Move them from my borders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_ELEANOR_: If your lust for power drives you to destroy my rule, so be it! I will still rule the court of love.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: Your terms are good. Let our chanceries work out the details.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: I do consider you a friend! I should be delighted to share this with the world.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: I think you confuse your admiration of me with friendship. We are not yet friends. Perhaps someday.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: Will you join me as we tell the world that our nations are friends with one another? We will surely inspire them all.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: I will accept your delegation, and they will stay as my honored guests. My dramaturge has a new work to share for them.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Sweden has no need of these petty trifles.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_KRIS: I send you a gift of bandy sticks, pickled herring, lingonsylt, and knäckebröd. Don't eat the bandy sticks.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_KRI: I will tell the whole world of your villainy, of your boorishness, of your perfidy!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_KRISTI: In Sweden, we have many amusing folk songs that depict you as a villain. Even the simplest arts imitate truths of life. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_GREETING_LEADER_KRISTINA_ANY: I am pleased to see you again.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_K: I believe it is time that we show the world the harmony of our relationship, and publically declare an alliance.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: As neither of us questions the other's valor, let us now make a dignified peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: No, I will not allow this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_KRIS: Don't the sufferings of our people demand that we make peace now?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Your units may pass across Sweden unhindered.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: No, this is not in Sweden's interest. Respect our borders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_KR: There is much we can gain by free access across each others' borders, wouldn't you agree?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Do not march your units up and down along our border like a child playing with toy soldiers. Move them now.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_KRISTINA: I never loved power, and now I am left without art. Only regret and loss remain for me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Yeah you're alright. We Māori are happy to be your friend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Yeah nah, the Māori just aren't ready for public friendship yet.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: There are worse people than you in the world, certainly. Mind if I tell the others you're not a complete jerk?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: You honor us with these fine gifts, the sign of your mana.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: No. Do not send us your gifts. We want no obligation to you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_KUPE: Here are gifts of pounamu, korowai cloaks, and huhu grubs. Go on, I want to see you eat the huhu grubs.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_KUP: Your bad behavior has defined our history, and so I'm actually happy I can declare this to the world.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_KUPE_A: The world sees your actions, and they believe what we have known for a long time—that of all leaders, you are the most evil. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_K: You're not half bad. How do you feel about an alliance?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: So it turns out both our people are brave and tough. Let's try peace and see how that goes.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: That won't happen.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_KUPE: You have the courage for war, this is true. Do you have courage for peace?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: That'll do. We've plenty of world to explore on the other side of your lands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Borders exist for a reason. Keep to your side of them, please.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_KU: I offer open borders with the Māori, in exchange for the right to cross your land unthreatened.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Maybe you want to move all those armies near Māori land? Before something terrible happens? Just a thought.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_KUPE_ANY: I have done my utmost, but your strength was greater. My heart, at least, will beat undefeated.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: I join the people of Canada in their wish to accept your friendship. Let us declare it to the world!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: While you have my respect, and the respect of the people of Canada, it is not yet time to declare a lasting friendship.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: You have proven a steadfast and loyal friend of Canada. Will you let us declare our mutual accord to the world?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Thank you for the kindness of your delegation. We are pleased to receive them.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Canada has no need of trifling gifts. Please withdraw your delegation.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_LAUR: The people of Canada present gifts of maple syrup, wool blankets, and our honored, traditional headgear: The toque.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_LAU: Negotiating with you tests the limits of human patience, and I will no longer indulge your behavior.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_LAURIE: I wish you had proved to be a wiser, more agreeable ruler, but your actions leave me scant hope for a peaceful future. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_GREETING_LEADER_LAURIER_ANY: I am pleased to see you again.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_L: We have many areas of mutual interest—would these not be well-served by an alliance?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: Why must we prolong suffering and inflame hatred? Let us end this war, and have peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: I am sorry, no.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_LAUR: There is more to be gained by appealing to the heart and soul than by force of arms. Let us have peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: I am pleased to accept your agreement, and welcome your units to cross Canadian land.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: I cannot accept this proposal, as it is not in Canada's interest to allow you units into our land.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_LA: I would like to propose a mutual agreement of open borders between our people.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: The coureurs de bois bring me disturbing tidings of many troops along our borders. Perhaps you could withdraw them?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_LAURIER_: So ends our dream of a Canada that might have been. Our people are good-hearted. Rule with mercy, and learn from them.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: This proposal would not benefit us.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: I accept your proposal, with thanks.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: I am pleased that you should call me "friend," for I consider you a friend of mine.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Your enthusiasm exceeds the reality of our situation. I cannot yet call you a friend of Mali.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: Do we not both gain much from our bond? Shall we tell the world we stand as friends?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Though I want for nothing, the sincerity of your gift is its own blessing. I will accept your delegation.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Solomon, in his splendor, declined gifts from the Queen of Sheba, and thus I should not accept yours.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_MANS: Please accept these simple gifts of indigo cloth, Kikeliba tea, and one hundred porters carrying sacks of gold dust.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_MAN: Serpent! Tempter! Wretch! Look to the hour of your chastisement, for it is coming soon!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_MANSA_: O God, why do you permit this dark-hearted one wield the power of kings? Bring down your wrath, O heaven! (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_M: Shall we become allies? God willing, you will say yes, and we shall proclaim it to the world!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: The time has come to set aside this foolish, wastrel war, and have peace between our people.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: No, this is not acceptable.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_MANS: This war is wasteful and fruitless. Is not God better pleased by a peace between us?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Yes, free travel can only lead to blessings for both of us.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Ah, while charity would lead me to grant this, wisdom dictates that I forbid it for now.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_MA: It is my great desire that my units pass unimpeded across your borders. Please, grant that this be so.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: I see no need for you to parade your great armies at the borders of Mali. Please remove them now.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_MANSA_MU: Wealth is fleeting; learning is vanity. All I have done, O God, I did in your name.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: Praise God, this I shall accept.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Yes! There are few rulers who understand the burden of kings as well as you. I am glad to call you friend.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: A king must choose his friends with great caution. It is not time for me to call you that.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: Do not we both rule with the acclaim of our people and the will of God? Should this not bind us as true friends before the world?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Thank you for the gifts of your delegation, and may your generosity be blessed.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: We need no gifts nor their implicit obligations. Hungary is rich enough.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_MATT: I am sending you gifts worthy of a prince: Fine lace, a crossbow emblazoned with your heraldry, and paprikash made from my family's recipe.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_MAT: You are a lawless snake, a grasping vulture, who would see the world cower before you. Know that I will never fear you!
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_MATTHI: You pursue power—always and only power—but Hungary will resist you to the bitter end. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_M: You respect the rights and authority of Hungary, and have proven a worthy friend. Let us cement our bond with an alliance.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: Alright, I think we've both proven our points. Now let us move on to mercy and peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: Never, never.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_MATT: There is neither mercy in prolonging this war nor justice in pursuing the causes. Let us make peace.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: Yes, let this be so. Thank you for the right of open passage.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: This would be an imposition, and an unacceptable one at that.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_MA: Grant that we may have the rights of movement across your borders, and I will extend the same to you.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: The scouts of my armies have spent days following the progress of your armies near the border. Move them away from Hungary.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_MATTHIAS: Today you wear the victor's laurels, but can you keep what you have taken?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: It would be beneath a prince's dignity to accept this offer.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: A generous offer! I accept with a grateful heart.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Yes, we are as close as siblings, and the world must hear of this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: I know you seek to appear glorious to the world, but you must not claim this friendship with me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: We are as the sun and the moon, giving light to the world. Shall we declare friendship?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Your delegation and its gifts are welcome. You honor me with your benevolence.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: Take your delegation away and do not presume to show charity to me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_PACH: Receive these gifts of alpaca wool and turquoise. I am also sending you some cuy—eat it while it's hot.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_PAC: Simpering, cuy-hearted fool! Ask what friends you have to protect you, for you lack the strength to protect yourself.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_PACHAC: Your authority is empty, your lands contemptible, your people dissolute. Your day of destruction comes soon. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_P: You have proved honorable and true to your word. Let us deepen our obligations to each other and swear alliance.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: Our subjects have suffered greatly in this war. Let us have peace now.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: This will not be.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_PACH: It seems you have some prowess at war. Do you also have a heart for peace?
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: I give your units permission to enter Inca lands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: You do not have permission to cross our borders. Do not pursue the matter.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_PA: I have need to send units across your borders. Grant this permission to me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Your armies circle like dogs at our borders. What do you mean by this? Remove them immediately.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_PACHACUT: How did you darken the sun? I ruled with diligence and mercy—see that you do so as well.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: I am generous—but not to such a degree.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: Yes, the Inca will grant you this.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: God has given you wisdom to see the alignment of our interests.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_HUM: Who are you to claim friendship with me? You are not my equal, merely an ardent admirer.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DECLARE_FRIEND_FROM_AI_LEADER_: As your behavior towards me is always proper, I give you leave to publicly claim my friendship.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: I have received your delegation. Their gifts have been placed in the treasury with those of the others.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_DELEGATION_FROM_HUMAN_L: If you send a delegation, they will be turned back at the gate. Spare them—and yourself—this shame.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DELEGATION_FROM_AI_LEADER_SULE: I send you gifts of rubies, emeralds,  goldwork, and many delicacies, as well as a chesnidjibashi who will taste them for poison on your behalf.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_HUMAN_LEADER_SUL: You are the liege of the viper, the jackal, the vulture, the hyena, the rat—all things hateful and spiteful claim you as their ruler.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DENOUNCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_SULEIM: Your insolence and effrontery are permitted only inasmuch as they are a lesson to the world in how not to treat me. (Denounces You).
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_ALLIANCE_FROM_AI_LEADER_S: Your prestige with the world would rise greatly, were you to accept an alliance with me.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_ACCEPT_DEAL_LEAD: You must end this war between us, for to prolong the matter invites ruin and the displeasure of God.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_AI_REFUSE_DEAL_LEAD: I grow tired of this game.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_MAKE_PEACE_FROM_AI_LEADER_SULE: Compassion demands that the state of war between us be brought to an end at once.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: I accept your recognition of my right to cross your lands. And I give you permission to pass through Ottoman lands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_REJECT_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_HUMAN: I am the only sovereign with claims to my land, and you may not pass across my borders.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_OPEN_BORDERS_FROM_AI_LEADER_SU: You must open your borders to me, and in doing so I shall grant you a similar privilege on my own lands.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_WARNING_TOO_MANY_TROOPS_NEAR_M: Do not make martial displays on my border, for it risks angering me. Already many within my empire are offended on my behalf.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_DEFEAT_FROM_AI_LEADER_SULEIMAN: Ruin! Ruin! Istanbul becomes Iram of the Pillars, remembered only by the melancholy poets.
en_US.LOC_DIPLO_ACCEPT_MAKE_DEAL_FROM_AI_LEADE: I suppose I could do this in a spirit of almsgiving.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_DESCRIPTION: A district that provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 [ICON_Housing] Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity. Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT_ALT_DESCRIPTION: A district that provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 [ICON_Housing] Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity. Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of an Aqueduct's production.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_CANAL_DESCRIPTION: A district built on flat land to connect two bodies of water or a body of water to a City Center. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination. Canals may either go straight through the hex or bend by 60 degrees. However three-way Canal junctures are not allowed and Canals must have a full land tile on each side of the waterway they create. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Canal's production.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_DAM_DESCRIPTION: A district built on a Floodplains tile to improve the comfort of living along this river. Prevents damage from flooding of this river (though yields from flooding drop by 50%). Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Only one may be built along each river's floodplain (whichever player completes one first) and the river must traverse at least two sides of the Dam hex. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Dam's production.

en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_LAVRA_GOLD: +{1_num} [ICON_Gold] Gold from the adjacent Lavra district.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_SUGUBA_DESCRIPTION_ADJACENC: Adjacency: Major [ICON_Gold] Gold bonus for each adjacent Holy Site. Major [ICON_Gold] Gold bonus from a tile containing a River edge. Minor [ICON_Gold] Gold bonus for adjacent district tiles.

en_US.LOC_PROJECT_COTHON_CAPITAL_MOVE_DESCRIPT: Phoenician unique project available to any city with a Cothon. When complete, the Phoenician [ICON_Capital] Capital moves to this city.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_CARBON_RECAPTURE_DESCRIPTION: Can be run in any city with an Industrial Zone. When complete, the lifetime carbon emissions of this civilization are reduced by 50 and 30 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor are earned. This project can even reduce your carbon debt to zero and allow you to accumulate reductions against the global CO2 footprint.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_CONVERT_REACTOR_TO_COAL_DESC: Decommissions the current Power Plant in this city, and replaces it with the Coal Power Plant.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Coal Power Plant:[NEWLINE]Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal [ICON_PowerRight] 4 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Heavy CO2 into the atmosphere
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_CONVERT_REACTOR_TO_OIL_DESCR: Decommissions the current Power Plant in this city, and replaces it with the Oil Power Plant.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Oil Power Plant:[NEWLINE]Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil [ICON_PowerRight] 4 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Moderate CO2 into the atmosphere[NEWLINE]Its [ICON_Production] Production bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_CONVERT_REACTOR_TO_URANIUM_D: Decommissions the current Power Plant in this city, and replaces it with the Nuclear Power Plant.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Nuclear Power Plant:[NEWLINE]Automatically converts any amount of [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium into [ICON_Power] Power for cities within 6 tiles that need it each turn, at the rate of:[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]1 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium [ICON_PowerRight] 16 [ICON_Power] Power[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Miniscule CO2 into the atmosphere[NEWLINE]Once built, as a Nuclear Power Plant ages, there is an increased chance for a Nuclear Accident to occur. Its [ICON_Production] Production and [ICON_Science] Science bonus is extended to all City Centers within 6 tiles that do not already have a bonus from a Power Plant building.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_MARS_BASE_POPUP: You successfully establish a colony on Mars! Marks the third step towards the Science Victory.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_LAUNCH_EXOPLANET_EXPEDITION_: Your seed ship is on its way to another star system! Wins the Science Victory once it arrives. Travels 1 Light Year per turn, and can be sped up by other projects.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_ORBITAL_LASER_DESCRIPTION: Requires 30 [ICON_RESOURCE_ALUMINUM] Aluminum to begin construction. (on Standard Speed) Space Race project which speeds up your Exoplanet Expedition by +1 Light Year per turn, accelerating your progress towards a Science Victory.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_ORBITAL_LASER_POPUP: You establish a Lagrange Laser Station in orbit, speeding up your Exoplanet Expedition ship by 1 Light Year per turn and bringing you closer to a Science Victory!
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_TERRESTRIAL_LASER_DESCRIPTIO: Once completed, this city's [ICON_Power] Power requirements increase by 5. Space Race project which speeds up your Exoplanet Expedition by +1 Light Year per turn as long as the city is [ICON_Power] Powered, accelerating your progress towards a Science Victory.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_TERRESTRIAL_LASER_POPUP: You establish a Terrestrial Laser Station in the Spaceport, speeding up your Exoplanet Expedition ship by 1 Light Year per turn and bringing you closer to a Science Victory!
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_SEND_AID_DESCRIPTION: Project to earn score for your Aid Request competitions.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_SEND_AID_POPUP: Your aid package has been delivered, increasing your score in the Aid Request competition.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_TRAIN_ATHLETES_DESCRIPTION: Project to earn score for the World Games competition.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_TRAIN_ATHLETES_POPUP: Your athletes are now ready for the games, increasing your score in the World Game competition.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_TRAIN_ASTRONAUTS_DESCRIPTION: Project to earn score for the International Space Station competition.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_TRAIN_ASTRONAUTS_POPUP: Your astronauts are ready to work in the International Space Station, increasing your score in the International Space Station competition.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_ENHANCE_DISTRICT_HOLY_SITE_E: District-based project which provides [ICON_Faith] Faith and +100% Religious Pressure every turn. Awards [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet points once finished.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_ENHANCE_DISTRICT_INDUSTRIAL_: District-based project which provides this city with full [ICON_Power] Power while active. It also provides [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer points once finished.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_RECOMMISSION_REACTOR_DESCRIP: Allows for the recommissioning of a nuclear reactor to increase safety measures and reduce the risk of a nuclear accident.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Recommissioning resets the reactor age to 0. The older a reactor gets, the higher the chance that a Nuclear Accident can occur.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_DECOMMISSION_COAL_POWER_PLAN: Project to earn score for the Climate Accords competition. Removes the Coal Power Plant and all its effects from this city.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_DECOMMISSION_OIL_POWER_PLANT: Project to earn score for the Climate Accords competition. Removes the Oil Power Plant and all its effects from this city.
en_US.LOC_PROJECT_DECOMMISSION_NUCLEAR_POWER_P: Project to earn score for the Climate Accords competition. Removes the Nuclear Power Plant and all its effects from this city.

en_US.LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_DESERT_DESCRIPTI: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has flooded before, giving it more [ICON_Food] Food production than a usual Desert tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_GRASSLAND_DESCRI: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has not yet flooded so it starts the game with the same yields as a flat Grasslands tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_FLOODPLAINS_PLAINS_DESCRIPTI: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has not yet flooded so it starts the game with the same yields as a flat Plains tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.
en_US.LOC_FLOOD_WARNING_ICON_TOOLTIP: This location is susceptible to flooding.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_VOLCANO_DESCRIPTION: This mountain tile, probably located near a boundary between two continents, starts the game as an inactive volcanic site but may become active as the game progresses. Once active, beware -- an eruption could occur at any time. Volcanic eruptions damage features and structures in adjacent tiles but may also leave behind volcanic soil that boosts the yields from that location.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_GEOTHERMAL_FISSURE_DESCRIPTI: The ground in this area, probably located near a boundary between two continents, has been ruptured by subterranean geothermal activity. Heated water and steam escape from the ground here, making it ideal to place structures such as Aqueducts, Roman Baths, and Hungarian Thermal Baths nearby.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_VOLCANIC_SOIL_DESCRIPTION: This land adjacent to a volcano has suffered from a previous eruption. Although people and structures may have been damaged, the rich deposits of minerals the volcano has brought forth have probably enhanced the yields here. Rebuilding in this area may therefore be worthwhile, especially if the volcano goes dormant.
en_US.LOC_VOLCANO_WARNING_ICON_TOOLTIP: This location may suffer from the eruption of a nearby volcano.

en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_YI_SUN_SIN_EXPANSION2_AC: Instantly creates an Ironclad unit with 1 promotion level. Grants 1 [ICON_RESOURCE_Coal] Coal per Turn
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_FRANZ_VON_HIPPER_EXPANSI: Instantly creates a Battleship unit with 1 promotion level. Grants 1 [ICON_RESOURCE_Coal] Coal per Turn.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_CHESTER_NIMITZ_EXPANSION: Instantly creates a Submarine unit with 1 promotion level. Grants 1 [ICON_RESOURCE_Oil] Oil per Turn. +20% [ICON_Production] Production towards units of the Naval Raider promotion class.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_ZHENG_HE_EXPANSION2_ACTI: Grants a free Trader unit in this city, and increases [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity by 1. Foreign [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes to this city provide +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold to both cities.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_RAJENDRA_CHOLA_EXPANSION: +3 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength for all naval units.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_LEIF_ERIKSON_EXPANSION2_: +1 sight range for all naval units. Allows all naval units to move over ocean tiles without the normal technology requirement.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_CHING_SHIH_EXPANSION2_AC: Gain 500 [ICON_Gold] Gold (on Standard speed). Military units get +60% rewards for plundering sea [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_THEMISTOCLES_EXPANSION2_: Instantly creates a Quadrireme unit. +20% [ICON_Production] Production towards units of the Naval Ranged promotion class.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_FRANCIS_DRAKE_EXPANSION2: Instantly creates a Privateer unit with 1 promotion level. Military units get +50% rewards for plundering sea [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes. +25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Naval Ranged and Naval Raider Units
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_HORATIO_NELSON_EXPANSION: Instantly builds a Lighthouse and Shipyard in this district. +50% flanking bonus for all naval units.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_DOUGLAS_MACARTHUR_EXPANS: Instantly creates a Tank unit with one promotion level. Grants 2 [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium per turn.
en_US.LOC_GREATPERSON_JOHN_ROCKEFELLER_EXPANSI: Grants 3 [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil per Turn. Your [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes gain +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold for each Strategic resource at the destination city.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CHATEAU_DESCRIPTION: French unique builder improvement unlocked at Feudalism. Cannot be built adjacent to another Chateau.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing and +1 Appeal to adjacent tiles.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent wonder, increasing to +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with the Flight technology.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each adjacent Luxury resource.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold if built next to River.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ZIGGURAT_DESCRIPTION: Sumerian unique builder improvement available from the start of the game. Cannot be built on Hills or adjacent to another Ziggurat.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if built next to River.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith after Early Empire for each adjacent district or for every 2 adjacent Farms.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_GEOTHERMAL_PLANT_DESCRIP: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Geothermal Plant.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +3 [ICON_POWER] Power per turn.[NEWLINE]Additional +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +3 [ICON_POWER] Power per turn after researching Synthetic Materials.[NEWLINE]Must be built on a Geothermal Fissure.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SOLAR_FARM_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Solar Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on flat terrain. Cannot be built on Snow.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_WIND_FARM_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold. +1 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on Hills terrain.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OFFSHORE_WIND_FARM_DESCR: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Offshore Wind Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Production] Production. Provides 2 [ICON_Power] Power per turn. Must be built on Coast or Lake terrain.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SEASTEAD_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Seastead.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food. +1 [ICON_Production] Production for each adjacent Fishing Boats. Fishing Boats receive +1 [ICON_Production] Production for each adjacent Seastead. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism for every adjacent Reef. +2 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. Must be built on Coast, Lake or Ocean terrain. Cannot be placed adjacent to another Seastead.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOAI_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Moai.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture for every 2 adjacent Moai. +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture if on or adjacent to a Volcanic Soil tile. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture if adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile . Additional [ICON_Culture] Culture and [ICON_Tourism] Tourism as you advance through the Civics and Technology Tree. Can be built on Plains, Plains Hills, Grassland, Grassland Hills, or Volcanic Soil.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUND_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Cahokia Mounds.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Cities receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from their first Cahokia Mound improvement. Upon discovering Natural History, cities receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from their second Cahokia Mound improvement. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every 2 adjacent Districts once Feudalism is discovered or for every adjacent District once Replaceable Parts is researched. Provides +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. Receive an additional [ICON_HOUSING] Housing once Cultural Heritage is discovered. Cannot be built adjacent to other Cahokia Mounds.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_NAZCA_LINE_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Nazca Line.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith to adjacent tiles with a resource. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food to adjacent Desert and Desert Hill tiles after discovering Civil Service. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to adjacent flat tiles after researching Mass Production. +1 Appeal. Can only be built on flat Desert. This tile cannot be worked .
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_SKI_RESORT_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Ski Resort.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides +4 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. Provides an [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity. Can only be built on a Mountain. Cannot be built adjacent to another Ski Resort. Cannot be pillaged, worked or removed.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUNTAIN_TUNNEL_DESCRIPT: Unlocks the Military Engineer ability to construct a Mountain Tunnel.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acts as a movement portal on a mountain range, allowing units to move into it and exit from another portal at the cost of 2 [ICON_Movement] Movement. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination. Can only be built on an adjacent Mountain tile. Cannot be pillaged or removed.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ALCAZAR_EXPANSION2_DESCR: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct an Alcázar.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Culture] Culture. Provides [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 50% of the tile's Appeal. Occupying unit receives +4 [ICON_Strength] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be built next to another Alcázar.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_CAMP_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct Camps.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Gold] Gold. Can only be built on valid resources.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If built on Luxury resources, the city will gain use of that resource.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_COLOSSAL_HEAD_EXPANSION2: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Colossal Head.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Rainforest or for every adjacent Rainforest once Humanism is discovered. +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 2 adjacent Woods or for every adjacent Woods once Humanism is discovered. en_US.LOC_CLIMATE_STORM_EVENT_DESCRIPTION_TOOL: STORM EVENT[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When event occurs:[NEWLINE]- One of four possible storms (blizzard, dust storm, hurricane, or tornado) spawns based upon the terrain at the storm's origin.[NEWLINE]- Storms then move across the map for two more turns, causing damage to buildings and improvements and possibly adding fertility to affected tiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]As the global temperature rises from greenhouse gas emissions into the atmosphere, the chance that a storm will occur increases. Using cleaner sources of energy reduces the global temperature increase and thus mitigates the chance of storms.
en_US.LOC_CLIMATE_RIVER_FLOOD_EVENT_DESCRIPTIO: RIVER FLOOD EVENT[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When event occurs:[NEWLINE]- Floodplain tiles along the affected River will flood, possibly adding fertility.[NEWLINE]- Buildings and improvements on flooded tiles may become pillaged or destroyed.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Prevent Flood damage by building a Dam or the Great Bath wonder on the affected River.
en_US.LOC_CLIMATE_VOLCANO_EVENT_DESCRIPTION_TO: VOLCANO EVENT[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When event occurs:[NEWLINE]- Non-mountain tiles adjacent to the eruption will gain the Volcanic Soil feature, possibly adding fertility.[NEWLINE]- Buildings and improvements on those tiles may become pillaged or destroyed.
en_US.LOC_CLIMATE_DROUGHT_EVENT_DESCRIPTION_TO: DROUGHT EVENT[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When event occurs:[NEWLINE]- Farm, Camp, Plantation, and Pasture improvements, as well as Mekewap, Outback Station, and Cahokia Mound improvements are pillaged.[NEWLINE]- These improvements cannot be rebuilt until the Drought ends.[NEWLINE]- All tiles affected by the Drought yield 1 less [Icon_Food] Food than usual.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Build an Aqueduct, Dam, or Stepwell in your city to prevent the [Icon_Food] Food loss from Drought.  Drought targets areas that are devoid of all Features. Keep some Woods, Rainforest, or Marsh near your cities to lessen the chance that Drought will strike.
en_US.LOC_CLIMATE_POLAR_ICE_MELT_DESCRIPTION_T: POLAR ICE MELT[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Climate change impacts the number of Polar Ice tiles lost.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Melted Polar Ice tiles may open advantageous naval passageways but also contribute to rising sea levels.

en_US.LOC_AGENDA_ANGEVIN_EMPIRE_DESCRIPTION: Builds populous cities. Likes civilizations whose nearby cities have high [ICON_Citizen] Population. Dislikes civilizations with small cities nearby that may become disloyal easily.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_CANADIAN_EXPEDITIONARY_DESCRI: Responds to as many Emergencies and Scored Competitions as possible. Likes those who also participate in such activities; dislikes those who have not gotten involved.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_KAITIAKITANGA_DESCRIPTION: Retains natural features in their empire and builds National Parks. Likes civs who respect the environment; dislikes those who treat the planet poorly.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_LAWGIVER_DESCRIPTION: Keeps his citizens happy and loyal. Impressed by those with similar priorities, especially if their cities were founded by many players. Dislikes those with happiness/loyalty issues or few captured cities.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_LORD_OF_MINES_DESCRIPTION: Tries to maximize [ICON_Gold] Gold output from cities and [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes. Respects civilizations that act similarly, dislikes those who do not.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_RAVEN_BANNER_DESCRIPTION: Levies troops from city-states. Likes civilizations that also use city-state troops, dislikes those that shun such mercenaries.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_PATRON_OF_ARTS_DESCRIPTION: Wants to have more Great Works than anyone else. Likes those who leave the Great Works to her, dislikes those who also have many Great Works.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_SAPA_INCA_DESCRIPTION: Wants to settle near Mountains. Likes those who leave the areas near Mountains to him, dislikes those who also settle near Mountains.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_SICILIAN_WARS_DESCRIPTION: Wants to settle coastal cities. Likes those who settle inland. Dislikes those with mostly coastal cities.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_WITH_YOUR_SHIELD_OR_ON_IT_DES: Never gives up items in a peace deal, and likes civilizations who match that approach. Dislikes civilizations who have capitulated or who have never gone to war. Grievances against this leader decay at twice the usual rate.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DEMAGOGUE_DESCRIPTION: Wants to be the civilization earning the most [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor, dislikes those who compete in [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_DESTINATION_CIV_DESCRIPTION: Wants to be the civilization with the most [ICON_Tourism] Tourism, dislikes those who compete in [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_FLAT_EARTHER_DESCRIPTION: Wants to block humankind from circumnavigating the globe or going into space.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_LIBERTARIAN_DESCRIPTION: Dislikes any civilization who makes a strong attempt to win a Diplomatic Victory.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_PILLAGER_DESCRIPTION: Tries to pillage as many tiles as possible. Respects other civilizations who pillage.
en_US.LOC_AGENDA_TURTLER_DESCRIPTION: Wants to stay safe from conquest. Dislikes those who have conquered other player's original capitals.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_AKKAD_DESCRIPTION: Melee and anti-cavalry unit's attacks do full damage to the city's Walls.
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_BOLOGNA_DESCRIPTION: Your districts with a building provide +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point of their type ([ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, and [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician for Theater Square districts with a building).
en_US.LOC_LEADER_TRAIT_CAHOKIA_DESCRIPTION: Your Builders can now make Cahokia Mounds improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cahokia Mounds provide +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Cities receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from their first Cahokia Mound improvement. Upon discovering Natural History, cities receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from their second Cahokia Mound improvement. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every 2 adjacent Districts once Feudalism is discovered or for every adjacent District once Replaceable Parts is researched. Provides +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. Receive an additional [ICON_HOUSING] Housing once Cultural Heritage is discovered. Cannot be built adjacent to other Cahokia Mounds.

en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_LAURIER: You chose the sunny ways, Wilfrid Laurier, and made cheerfulness and courtesy the character of the Canadian people. Where others look to divide and sow mistrust, you inspire cooperation and understanding. Show the world that a unified people can forever stand the test of time.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_ELEANOR_FRANCE: Duchess of Aquitaine, regent of two lands, patron of troubadours and judge of the court of love, ascend your throne again. Inspire the hearts of your subjects, that they will cheer you and flock to your banners, for all who know your reign know your compassion.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_ELEANOR_ENGLAND: Duchess of Aquitaine, regent of two lands, patron of troubadours and judge of the court of love, ascend your throne again. Inspire the hearts of your subjects, that they will cheer you and flock to your banners, for all who know your reign know your compassion.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_MATTHIAS_CORVINU: Mighty Matthias, your feats at arms are matched only by the depth of your knowledge. Let your mighty Black Army serve as your strong hand on the battlefield, both as sword against your enemies and as shield protecting your faithful people, and ages to come will utter your name in awe.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_PACHACUTI: Pachacuti, son of the Sun, father to a prosperous people who dwell among lofty peaks. Let the mountains be roads to you, and mighty walls to your enemies, for you grow in strength where others would starve. O, Sapa Inca who shakes the earth, show strength and diligence, and your name will shine throughout all of history.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_MANSA_MUSA: Mansa Musa, great king of Mali, you are blessed with wealth beyond comprehension, yet you remain uncorrupted. Raise your eyes from the marketplace to the heavens and satisfy your heart’s great yearning for peace. Protect the prosperity of your people, and history will write your name in golden letters.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_KUPE: Kupe the Navigator, you named the land of the long white cloud, and now you are called upon to settle new lands. Protect and honor the land and sea, just as your Toas protect your people. The Maori will guard the world’s natural beauty for all the ages after.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_SULEIMAN: All praise to you, Suleiman the lawgiver, rightly called Magnificent! Master of the sublime house of Osman, your loyal servants stand ready to carry your commands to the farthest corner of your mighty land, while your foes tremble at the sight of your armies. Sultan of Sultans and Khan of Khans, lead your people to greatness.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_DIDO: Queen Dido, mother of Carthage, all your life you faced great threats and overcame them through wit and cunning. Wherever waves break on the shore, there your cities shall rise.  The seas are your roads, the far horizon is your destiny and your refuge.
en_US.LOC_LOADING_INFO_LEADER_KRISTINA: Minerva of the North, unmatched in learning and wisdom, you chose a life of culture over that of power. Light up your kingdom with art and music. Let Sweden be the guiding star for other civilizations to follow. Once more the world has a need for great patrons of the arts and culture—and it looks to you.
