en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_RELIGIOUS_ROCK_DESCRIPTION: Performs a concert that converts the majority religion of that city to the religion founded by the player.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_SPACE_ROCK_DESCRIPTION: Performs at Spaceports and Campuses for +500 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism (+1000 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism if Campus has a University) and 1 level more experienced.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_SURF_ROCK_DESCRIPTION: Performs at Seaside Resorts and Harbors for +500 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism (+1000 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism if Harbor has a Shipyard) and 1 level more experienced.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SATCHEL_CHARGES_DESCRI: Breach Dam as if 2 levels more experienced.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_SURVEILLANCE_DESCRIPTI: When Counterspying all city districts are defended (and +1 level at districts within 1 hex).
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_SPY_POLYGRAPH_DESCRIPTION: If this Spy is in home territory, enemy Spies in your lands operate at 1 level below usual.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_GDR_SIEGE_LASER_DESCRIPTIO: When fighting against defensible districts gain +30 [ICON_RANGED] Ranged and +30 [ICON_STRENGTH] Melee Strength and Ranged attacks are 100% effective.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_GDR_BONUS_MOVEMENT_DESCRIP: +3 [ICON_Movement] Movement. Can perform a Jump action to cross over mountain terrain.
en_US.LOC_PROMOTION_GDR_ARMOR_UPGRADE_DESCRIPT: +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when defending against land and naval units.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CHOCOLATEHILLS_QUOTE: “The wicked king pursued the lovers Juan and Maria on his swiftest horse. As he overtook them, Maria flung down her ring, and at once rose up seven tall hills, and the king was slowed.”[NEWLINE] - Filipino Folk Tale
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_DEVILSTOWER_QUOTE: “Seven girls were chased by bears. The bears were just about to catch them when the girls jumped on a low rock. One of the girls prayed to the rock, "Rock take pity on us, rock save us!" The rock heard them and began to grow upwards, pushing the girls higher and higher.”[NEWLINE] - Kiowa Legend
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_GOBUSTAN_QUOTE: “Then weave the web of the mystic measure;[NEWLINE]From the depths of the sky and the ends of the earth,[NEWLINE]Come, swift Spirits of might and of pleasure,[NEWLINE]Fill the dance and the music of mirth.”[NEWLINE] - Percy Bysshe Shelley
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_IKKIL_QUOTE: “Son, have you seen the rain of God? It passed and entered beneath the mountains of God... There will be a ring in the sky where the water of God has passed.”[NEWLINE] - Books of Chilam Balam
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_PAMUKKALE_QUOTE: “Near the Mesogis, opposite Laodicea, is Hierapolis, where are hot springs, and the Plutonium, both of which have some singular properties. The water of the springs is so easily consolidated and becomes stone, that if it is conducted through water-courses dams are formed consisting of a single piece of stone.”[NEWLINE] - Strabo
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_VESUVIUS_QUOTE: “The sea seemed to roll back upon itself, and to be driven from its banks by the convulsive motion of the earth; it is certain at least the shore was considerably enlarged, and several sea animals were left upon it. On the other side, a black and dreadful cloud, broken with rapid, zigzag flashes, revealed behind it variously shaped masses of flame...”[NEWLINE] - Pliny the Younger
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_WHITEDESERT_QUOTE: “I have filled a water-bag from my people and gone to the desert,[NEWLINE]And walked empty wastes while the wolf howled, like a gambler whose family starves.”[NEWLINE] - Imru-ul-Quais
en_US.LOC_TECH_BUTTRESS_QUOTE_1: “An architect should live as little in cities as a painter. Send him to our hills, and let him study there what nature understands by a buttress, and what by a dome.”[NEWLINE] – John Ruskin
en_US.LOC_TECH_BUTTRESS_QUOTE_2: “Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out.”[NEWLINE] – Revelation 3:12
en_US.LOC_TECH_REFINING_QUOTE_1: "Engineering is the art of directing the great sources of power in nature for the use and convenience of man."[NEWLINE] - Thomas Tredgold
en_US.LOC_TECH_SEASTEADS_QUOTE_1: “I must go down to the seas again, to the vagrant gypsy life, To the gull’s way and the whale’s way where the wind’s like a whetted knife;”[NEWLINE] – John Masefield
en_US.LOC_TECH_SEASTEADS_QUOTE_2: “Then you drive out where the storm-clouds swallow, And the sound of your oar-blades, falling hollow, As all we have left through the months to follow.”[NEWLINE] – Rudyard Kipling
en_US.LOC_TECH_ADVANCED_AI_QUOTE_1: “Will no entreaties cause thee to turn a favourable eye upon thy creature, who implores thy goodness and compassion?”[NEWLINE] – Mary Shelley
en_US.LOC_TECH_ADVANCED_POWER_CELLS_QUOTE_1: “The incomplete becomes complete; the crooked becomes straight; the empty becomes full; the worn out becomes new.”[NEWLINE] - Tao Te Ching, Lao Tzu
en_US.LOC_TECH_CYBERNETICS_QUOTE_1: “If there is any work in the afterlife, you must do it. Behold me whenever you are called. Be watchful at any moment to work there. Plough my fields, carry water and sand to the east and west. Behold me whenever you are called.”[NEWLINE] – Inscription on an Egyptian Ushabti
en_US.LOC_TECH_SMART_MATERIALS_QUOTE_1: “It ascends from the earth to the heaven, and it again descends to the earth and receives the force of things superior and inferior.”[NEWLINE] – Hermes Trismegistus
en_US.LOC_TECH_PREDICTIVE_SYSTEMS_QUOTE_1: “If the enemy know not where he will be attacked, he must prepare in every quarter, and so be everywhere weak.”[NEWLINE] – Sun Tzu
en_US.LOC_TECH_OFFWORLD_MISSION_QUOTE_1: “No, my friends, we have not fallen back upon the earth; no, nor are we submerged in the Gulf of Mexico. Yes! we are mounting into space. See those stars shining in the night, and that impenetrable darkness heaped up between the earth and us!”[NEWLINE] – Jules Verne
en_US.LOC_TECH_OFFWORLD_MISSION_QUOTE_2: “After eleven Days Passage in this violent Flight, I perceived we began to approach another Earth (if I may so call it) being the Globe or very Body of that Star which we call the Moon.”[NEWLINE] – Francis Godwin
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_DIGITAL_DEMOCRACY_QUOTE_1: “Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.”[NEWLINE] – Joel 3:14
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_SYNTHETIC_TECHNOCRACY_QUOTE_1: “We find every where men of mechanical genius, of great general acuteness, and discriminative understanding, who make no scruple in pronouncing the Automaton a pure machine, unconnected with human agency in its movements, and consequently, beyond all comparison, the most astonishing of the inventions of mankind.”[NEWLINE] – Edgar Allen Poe
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_CORPORATE_LIBERTARIANISM_QUOTE: “Over himself, over his own body and mind, the individual is sovereign.”[NEWLINE] – John Stuart Mill
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_NEAR_FUTURE_GOVERNANCE_QUOTE_1: “Justice is the bond of men in states, for the administration of justice, which is the determination of what is just, is the principle of order in political society.”[NEWLINE] – Aristotle
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_EXODUS_IMPERATIVE_QUOTE_1: “This, O Best Beloved, is another story of the High and Far Off Times.”[NEWLINE] – Rudyard Kipling
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_CULTURAL_HEGEMONY_QUOTE_1: “Ah, my Belovéd, fill the cup that clears[NEWLINE]To-day of past Regrets and future Fears—[NEWLINE]To-morrow?—Why, To-morrow I may be[NEWLINE]Myself with Yesterday’s Sev’n Thousand Years.”[NEWLINE] – Edward FitzGerald
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_INFORMATION_WARFARE_QUOTE_1: “It has been said aforetime that he who knows both sides has nothing to fear in a hundred fights...”[NEWLINE] – Sun Tzu
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_INFORMATION_WARFARE_QUOTE_2: “If the enemy know not where he will be attacked, he must prepare in every quarter, and so be everywhere weak.”[NEWLINE] – Sun Tzu
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_GLOBAL_WARMING_MITIGATION_QUOT: “Fetter this malefactor to the jagged rocks[NEWLINE]In adamantine bonds infrangible.”[NEWLINE] – Aeschylus
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_SMART_POWER_DOCTRINE_QUOTE_1: “The time will come and is inevitably coming when all institutions based on force will disappear through their uselessness, stupidity, and even inconvenience becoming obvious to all.”[NEWLINE] – Leo Tolstoy
en_US.LOC_CIVIC_ENVIRONMENTALISM_QUOTE_1: "I shall return again to the light of the sun, to prepare a home for thy descendants."[NEWLINE] –Argonautica, Apollonius Rhodius
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_GOLDEN_GATE_BRIDGE_QUOTE: “The golden gates of Sleep unbar[NEWLINE]Where Strength and Beauty, met together,[NEWLINE]Kindle their image like a star[NEWLINE]In a sea of glassy weather!”[NEWLINE] - Percy Bysshe Shelley
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_GREAT_BATH_QUOTE: “Yet in this captious and intenible sieve[NEWLINE]I still pour in the waters of my love[NEWLINE]And lack not to lose still: thus, Indian-like,[NEWLINE]Religious in mine error, I adore[NEWLINE]The sun, that looks upon his worshipper,[NEWLINE]But knows of him no more.”[NEWLINE] - William Shakespeare
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_MACHU_PICCHU_QUOTE: “...Eagles fly, The turrets round, and seem to flout the sky;[NEWLINE]They eye those walls now crumbling in decay,[NEWLINE]And scare from quiet rest their destined prey.”[NEWLINE] - Samuel Prout Hill
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_MEENAKSHI_TEMPLE_QUOTE: “We greet you, Devi Meenakshi, she who shines like a thousand-million suns, adorned with bracelets and garlands... She who is auspicious, she who embodies existence. I always bow to you, whose compassion is an ocean.”[NEWLINE] - Adi Shankara
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_ORSZAGHAZ_QUOTE: “With self-government is freedom, and with freedom is justice and patriotism.”[NEWLINE] - Lajos Kossuth
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_PANAMA_CANAL_QUOTE: “Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea; Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof.”[NEWLINE] - Psalms 46:2-3
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_UNIVERSITY_SANKORE_QUOTE: “Scholars are the heirs of the prophets, for the prophets did not leave behind a legacy of wealth but that of knowledge.”[NEWLINE] - Musnad al-Bazzar 10/68
en_US.LOC_TECH_COMPUTERS_DESCRIPTION: Grants the ability to construct an additional Spy. +50% [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism across your empire.
en_US.LOC_TECH_ADVANCED_AI_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks Giant Death Robot upgrade: Drone Air Defense[NEWLINE]+140 [ICON_ANTIAIR_LARGE] Anti-Air Strength.
en_US.LOC_TECH_CYBERNETICS_DESCRIPTION: All Modern, Atomic and Information Era military units gain +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement.[NEWLINE]Unlocks the Giant Death Robot upgrade: Improved Mobility[NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. Allows jumping over Mountain tiles.
en_US.LOC_TECH_SMART_MATERIALS_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks Giant Death Robot upgrade: Reinforced Armor Plating[NEWLINE]+10 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when defending against land and naval units.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to the Mine improvement.
en_US.LOC_TECH_PREDICTIVE_SYSTEMS_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from the Oil Well and Offshore Oil Rig improvements.
en_US.LOC_TECH_FUTURE_TECH_XP2_DESCRIPTION: Can be completed multiple times, increasing your points towards the Score Victory. Also grants all of your cities +5% [ICON_Production] Production towards city projects each time it is completed.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_BUTTRESS: Build a Classical era or later wonder
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_BUTTRESS: Now that you have finished a wonder of the classical world, what will your architects build next?
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_REFINING: Your nation is now powered. However your scientists are already hard at work on developing alternative energy sources.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_CASTLES: Adopt a government with 6 inherent policy slots.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_COMPUTERS: Adopt a government with 8 inherent policy slots.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_LASERS_XP2: With our Drones in the air, refining and focusing the light becomes increasingly important.
en_US.LOC_BOOST_TRIGGER_LONGDESC_NUCLEAR_FUSIO: We've split the atom apart, now let's smash them together!
en_US.LOC_TECH_GUNPOWDER_DESCRIPTION: Unlocks a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor title for Suleiman (Kanuni).
en_US.LOC_TECH_SYNTHETIC_MATERIALS_DESCRIPTION: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from the Lumber Mill improvement. +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from the Camp improvement. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science from the Geothermal Fissure improvement.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_MODERATE_DESCRIPT: Rising waters overflow the banks of the river and spill into the land beyond.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_MAJOR_DESCRIPTION: Surging, murky water rushes over the land around the river during an intense flood.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_FLOOD_1000_YEAR_DESCRIP: The river bursts its banks, and rising water covers the land for miles around. Not for a thousand years has the river flooded to such an extent!
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_KILIMANJARO_GENTLE_DESC: People and animals view the rising column of ash from Kilimanjaro from miles around, and wonder at the Earth’s fury.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_KILIMANJARO_CATASTROPHI: Kilimanjaro roars, and a plume of smoke and ash jets into the sky, as people and animals flee in terror!
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_EYJAFJALLAJOKULL_CATAST: People must go far out of their way to avoid the huge plume of ash that erupts from Eyjafjallajökull.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_EYJAFJALLAJOKULL_MEGACO: Eyjafjallajökull tears open a rift in the earth, as if the goddess Hel herself were escaping from the netherworld!
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VESUVIUS_MEGACOLOSSAL_D: Citizens scream in terror and flee towards safety as the pyroclastic wave crashes down the flanks of Vesuvius!
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_GENTLE_DESCRIPT: People gaze skyward in concern, watching smoke rise from a once-quiet volcano.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_CATASTROPHIC_DE: People living near the volcano flee as lava and ash blankets the surrounding land.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_VOLCANO_MEGACOLOSSAL_DE: People flee in terror as pyroclastic flows lash the slopes of the volcano and jets of smoke pour into the sky!
en_US.LOC_COASTAL_LOWLAND_1M_DESCRIPTION: This is the first land that floods when sea levels rise.
en_US.LOC_COASTAL_LOWLAND_2M_DESCRIPTION: This land will flood when sea levels rise a second time.
en_US.LOC_COASTAL_LOWLAND_3M_DESCRIPTION: This will be the last land affected by rising sea levels.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE4_LONG_DE: Storms and Floods no longer improve fertility.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE5_LONG_DE: Storms and Droughts passing over a tile begin to remove bonus fertility added earlier in the game.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE6_LONG_DE: Storms and Droughts passing over a tile regularly remove bonus fertility added earlier in the game.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_SEA_LEVEL_RISE7_LONG_DE: Storms and Droughts passing over a tile quite often remove bonus fertility added earlier in the game.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_BLIZZARD_SIGNIFICANT_DE: An icy wind sweeps blanketing snow across the landscape, as living creatures huddle in their dens.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_BLIZZARD_CRIPPLING_DESC: The howling wind and lashing snow turn sky and land white. Familiar forms disappear beneath frozen mounds.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DUST_STORM_GRADIENT_DES: The sun is an angry orange disc in a hazy sky as people scurry about their business, cloth wrapped around noses and mouths.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DUST_STORM_HABOOB_DESCR: From far off people see the approaching wall of driven sand, and scatter to seek safety before the scouring wind!
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_TORNADO_FAMILY_DESCRIPT: A tornado slowly descends from a summer storm, and people seek refuge.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_TORNADO_OUTBREAK_DESCRI: A fast-moving line of storms gallop across the darkening summer sky, with tornadoes ominously forming beneath.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_HURRICANE_CAT_4_DESCRIP: Pelting rain and a howling gale mark the arrival of a mighty hurricane.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_HURRICANE_CAT_5_DESCRIP: The wind screams, the torrents of rain fall, and the waves drive inexorably ashore. Little can stand where this hurricane passes!
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_MAJOR_DESCRIPTI: Locusts whirr and dust stirs in the hot wind. The land is parched by drought.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_EXTREME_DESCRIP: A merciless sun beats down on the drought-stricken and withered earth. No rain has fallen, and the skies promise no relief.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_DAMAGE_FERTILITY: + May add fertility to tiles it passes over[NEWLINE]- May damage improvements or districts
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_ALL_DAMAGE_FERTILITY: + May add fertility to tiles it passes over[NEWLINE]- May damage improvements or districts[NEWLINE]- May damage units or reduce city populations
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_ALL_DAMAGE_NO_FERTILITY: - May damage improvements or districts[NEWLINE]- May damage units or reduce city populations
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_PROP_NAVAL_DAMAGE_FERTI: + May add fertility to tiles it passes over[NEWLINE]- May damage improvements or districts[NEWLINE]- May damage naval units
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_DROUGHT_DAMAGE: - Will drop [ICON_Food] Food by 1 per tile if the city has no Aqueduct, Dam, or Stepwell.[NEWLINE]- May destroy or pillage Farms, Camps, Pastures, and Plantations.
en_US.LOC_DEFORESTATION_LIGHT_DESCRIPTION: Removal of Marsh, Woods, and Rainforest features from the planet has been minimal to date.
en_US.LOC_DEFORESTATION_EXPECTED_DESCRIPTION: Removal of Marsh, Woods, and Rainforest features from the planet has proceeded at the expected pace.
en_US.LOC_DEFORESTATION_HEAVY_DESCRIPTION: Removal of Marsh, Woods, and Rainforest features from the planet has been considerable to date.
en_US.LOC_DEFORESTATION_EXTREME_DESCRIPTION: Removal of Marsh, Woods, and Rainforest features from the planet has been extensive.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_MINOR_: Engineers in the Nuclear Power Plant control room work feverishly to contain a spreading leak. They have already prevented a worse outcome, but the situation is still serious.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_MAJOR_: Alarms sound at the Nuclear Power Plant! Jets of steam rise from cracks in the reactor and dosimeters click and whir as radiation blankets the area.
en_US.LOC_RANDOM_EVENT_NUCLEAR_ACCIDENT_CATAST: An ominous explosion thunders, and a dark plume rises above the Nuclear Power Plant. One by one, the wailing of sirens becomes a shrieking chorus, as hellish lumps of burning fuel begin to rain down.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GODDESS_OF_FIRE_DESCRIPTION: +3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith from Geothermal Fissures and Volcanic Soil.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GOD_OF_CRAFTSMEN_EXPANSION2_D: +1 [ICON_Production] Production and +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith from improved Strategic resources.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DIVINE_SPARK_EXPANSION2_DESCR: +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point for Holy Sites ([ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet), Campuses ([ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist), Amphitheaters ([ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer), and Workshops ([ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_EARTH_GODDESS_EXPANSION2_DESC: +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith from tiles with Charming or better Appeal.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_FERTILITY_RITES_EXPANSION2_DE: +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for [ICON_RESOURCE_CATTLE] Cattle, [ICON_RESOURCE_RICE] Rice, [ICON_RESOURCE_WHEAT] Wheat, and [ICON_RESOURCE_MAIZE] Maize resources.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_SETTLEMENTS_EXPANSI: +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Settlers.[NEWLINE]Border expansion rate is 50% faster and new cities get 2 free tiles on foundation.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RIVER_GODDESS_EXPANSION2_DESC: Rivers give +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith adjacency to Holy Site Districts. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity to cities if they have a Holy Site district adjacent to a River.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_INITIATION_RITES_EXPANSION2_D: When chosen receive a Warrior in your [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital. Receive 30% of a non-civilian unit's production value in [ICON_FAITH] Faith when produced.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LADY_OF_THE_REEDS_AND_MARSHES: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production on improved Marsh, Oasis, and Floodplains tiles or City Centers founded on these tiles.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_HOLY_WATERS_DESCRIPTION: Increases Healing of your units by +20 within the borders of cities that follow your religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_FEED_THE_WORLD_EXPANSION2_DES: Shrines provide +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. Temples provide +4 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_RELIGIOUS_COMMUNITY_EXPANSION: Shrines provide +6 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Temples provide +12 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WARRIOR_MONKS_EXPANSION2_DESC: Allows spending [ICON_FAITH] Faith to train Warrior Monks, land combat units with a unique promotion tree. May be purchased in a city with a Shrine in its Holy Site. Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Holy Site.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WORK_ETHIC_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP: Holy Site district’s [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Production] Production as well.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_SACRED_PLACES_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, [ICON_GOLD] Gold, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each city following this Religion that has a World Wonder.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_CROSS_CULTURAL_DIALOGUE_EXPAN: +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for every 4 followers of this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_LAY_MINISTRY_EXPANSION2_DESCR: +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith or +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from each Holy Site or Theater Square district respectively for each city following this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PILGRIMAGE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP: +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each city following this Religion. Gain an additional +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith with Theology.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_STEWARDSHIP_EXPANSION2_DESCRI: Each Campus or Commercial Hub district in a city following this Religion provides +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science or +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold respectively.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_TITHE_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each city following the Religion. Gain an additional +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold with Theology.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_WORLD_CHURCH_EXPANSION2_DESCR: +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every 4 followers of this Religion.
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_DAR_E_MEHR_EXPANSION2_DESCRIP: Allows construction of Dar-e Mehrs (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Cannot be pillaged by natural disasters).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_GURDWARA_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI: Allows construction of Gurdwaras (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +3 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing).
en_US.LOC_BELIEF_PAGODA_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTION: Allows construction of Pagodas (+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] Influence Point per turn).
en_US.LOC_ROUTE_RAILROAD_DESCRIPTION: Can only be constructed by Military Engineers. Does not cost a charge, but does cost 1 [ICON_RESOURCE_IRON] Iron.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Greatly improves [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement speed of any unit moving from one Railroad tile to another. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes traveling over Railroads can multiply the [ICON_GOLD] Gold they get from districts at their destination.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_GIANT_DEATH_ROBOT_DESCRIPTION: Information Era Super-Unit. Able to move and fight in water. Resistant to Weapons of Mass Destruction. Combat abilities can be upgraded by researching future technologies.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MILITARY_ENGINEER_DESCRIPTION: Medieval era support unit. Requires an Armory to produce. Can construct Roads, Railroads, Forts, Airstrips, Missile Silos, and Mountain Tunnel improvements. One of their build charges can also be used to complete 20% of a Canal or Dam district.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MILITARY_ENGINEER_ALT_DESCRIPTI: Classical era support unit. Requires a Barracks or a Stable in the city. Can construct Roads, Railroads, Forts, Airstrips, Missile Silos, and Mountain Tunnel improvements (Forts are replaced by Reinforced Forts after researching Ballistics). One of their build charges can also be used to complete 20% of a Canal, Dam or Aqueduct district or 50% of a Flood Barrier building.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_ROCK_BAND_DESCRIPTION: Can perform a rock concert at a valid venue, including at Wonders, at a District with one of the required buildings, or at a special target allowed by one of the band's promotions. Their Album Sales stat is the expected [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism strength at their next concert. After performing concerts their Album Sales and Rock Band Level may increase. Must be purchased with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Cannot perform on the same tile twice.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_INQUISITOR_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTI: May reduce the presence of other Religions in their territory by 75%, and initiate theological combat with units of other Religions.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_BATTERING_RAM_EXPANSION2_DESCRI: Ancient era support unit. When adjacent to a city, attacking melee and anti-cavalry units do full damage to the city’s Walls. Does not affect cities with Medieval or Renaissance Walls. Ineffective against Urban Defenses.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SIEGE_TOWER_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPT: Medieval era support unit. When adjacent to a city, attacking melee and anti-cavalry units ignore Walls and immediately assault the city. Does not affect cities with Renaissance Walls. Ineffective against Urban Defenses.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_GUIDE_MOVEMENT_AOE_RELIGIOUS: Gives movement to nearby religious units.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_SAGE_COMBAT_AOE_RELIGIOUS_DE: Gives additional combat strength to nearby religious units.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_MEDITERRANEAN_COLONIES_DESCR: +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement and +2 sight range while embarked.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Ignore additional [ICON_Movement] Movement costs from embarking and disembarking.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_BIREME_PROTECT_TRADER_DESCRI: Protects nearby Trade units from being Plundered on Water Tiles.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_TRADER_PROTECTED_BY_BIREME_D: Trade units near a your Bireme are immune to being Plundered on Water Tiles.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_THE_RAVEN_KING_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement and +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength to Levied units.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_BLACK_ARMY_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength from each adjacent Levied unit.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_HUSZAR_DESCRIPTION: +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength from every City-state of which you are suzerain.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_MOUNTIE_DESCRIPTION: Can create a National Park.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting within 2 tiles of a National Park.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]+5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting within 2 tiles of a National Park owned by you.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_MANDEKALU_DESCRIPTION: Protects land Trade units from Plunder within 4 tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Gain [ICON_GOLD] Gold equal to 50% that unit's base [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength (on Online speed).
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_MANDEKALU_PROTECT_TRADER_DES: This Mandekalu Cavalry protects nearby Trade units from being plundered on land tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Gain [ICON_GOLD] Gold equal to 50% that unit's base [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength (on Online speed).
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_TRADER_PROTECTED_BY_MANDEKAL: Trade units near a your Mandekalu Cavalry are immune to being Plundered on Land Tiles.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_EXPERT_MARKSMAN_DESCRIPTION: +1 additional attack per turn if unit has not used all its movement.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_GREAT_TURKISH_BOMBARD_DESCRI: +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength vs. district defenses. (Great Turkish Bombard)
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_CORSAIR_DESCRIPTION: It costs no [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement to coastal raid.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET] Can enter Ocean tiles regardless of researched Technologies.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_ROCK_BAND_ENTER_FOREIGN_LAND: Even without Open Borders, this unit can enter foreign territory.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_FINEST_HOUR_FRIENDLY_TERRITO: +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when in your territory (Finest Hour)
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_CYBER_WARFARE_COMBAT_BONUS_D: +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat against units from the Information and Future Eras from Cyber Warfare.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_TOA_DESCRIPTION: Adjacent enemy units receive -5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.[NEWLINE][ICON_Bullet]Can build the unique Pā improvement.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_UNIT_WMD_RESISTANCE_DESCRIPT: Resistant to Weapons of Mass Destruction.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_UNIT_FIGHT_WHILE_EMBARKED_DE: Able to move and fight in water.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_ENABLE_WALL_PROMOTION_CLASS_: When adjacent to an enemy city, melee and anti-cavalry units do full damage to the city's Walls. Does not affect cities with Medieval or Renaissance Walls. Ineffective against Urban Defenses.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_BYPASS_WALLS_PROMOTION_CLASS: When adjacent to an enemy city, friendly melee and anti-cavalry units can bypass the city walls and attack the city directly. Does not affect cities with Renaissance Walls. Ineffective against Urban Defenses.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_CHOLA_NAVAL_COMBAT_DESCRIPTI: +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength to all naval units (Ferdinand Magellan).
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_ERIKSON_NAVAL_SIGHT_DESCRIPT: +1 sight range for all naval units. (Leif Erikson)
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_MILITARYORGANIZATION_MOVEMEN: +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement to [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great Generals from the Military Organization policy.
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_RAVEN_LEVY_COMBAT_DESCRIPTIO: +{Amount} Combat Strength from the Raven King trait
en_US.LOC_COMBAT_PREVIEW_ADJACENT_LEVIED_BONUS: +{1_Amount} Combat Strength from adjacent Levied units
en_US.LOC_ALL_PARK_COMBAT_BONUS_DESCRIPTION: +{1_Amount} Combat Strength when within 4 tiles of a National Park
en_US.LOC_OWNER_PARK_COMBAT_BONUS_DESCRIPTION: +{1_Amount} Combat Strength when within 4 tiles of an Owned National Park
en_US.LOC_GREAT_TURKISH_BOMBARD_COMBAT_BONUS_D: +{1_Amount} Combat Strength from the Great Turkish Bombard trait
en_US.LOC_ABILITY_TOA_NEGATIVE_COMBAT_MODIFIER: {1_Amount} Combat Strength when adjacent to an enemy Toa
en_US.LOC_COMBAT_PREVIEW_CITY_FRIENDLY_COMBAT_: +{1_Amount} Combat Strength from the Head Falconer
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_INTRO_TO_WORLD_CONGRESS: We have been invited to join the World Congress. On this international stage, we will decide important topics that must be addressed by the world at large, voting on resolutions and agreements between world leaders.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The World Congress meets every 30 turns (Standard Speed). During the Congress, players vote on Resolutions and Discussions using their accumulated [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to influence how the game rules will change until the next time Congress meets.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_WORLD_CONGRESS_STAGE_2: We have been summoned to this Special Session of the World Congress. An Emergency demands the World's attention.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Special Sessions may be called every 15 turns (Standard Speed) by players who have been negatively affected by conditions that would give rise to an Emergency.  This might be another player (such as in a Military Emergency) or the environment (such as in a Request for Aid).  During this stage, players who might be involved in the Emergency must vote on the related Discussion.  If the Discussion passes, those players who voted for it will join the Emergency.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_WORLD_CONGRESS_STAGE_OVER: World Congress is over. It will meet again soon, but in the meantime, take advantage of the new game rules in effect! You can view them by going into Diplomacy and clicking on the top-most icon on the left.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_FLOODPLAIN_REVEAL: This River has floodplains, which means it has flooded before and might burst its banks again. A Flood along this river might happen at any point in the future. This presents us with risks, but potentially benefits, too.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A Flood might affect any tile along the River. A flooded tile will pillage or destroy Improvements and pillage Districts on the tile, but it might also increase the yields for the tile as a result.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_VOLCANO_REVEAL: This Volcano is quiet now, but it could erupt again at some point in the future. It might be a danger to our people—or an unexpected blessing.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]An Eruption might affect any tile adjacent to the Volcano. The Eruption will pillage or destroy improvements and pillage districts on the tile, but it might also increase the yields on the tile as a result.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_GEOTHERMAL_REVEAL: Steam hisses from the ground here, rising in swirling clouds. This is a Geothermal Fissure—a place where the planet's heat escapes through natural vents.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In time, you may research technologies that allow you to make use of these natural features.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_FIRST_CLIMATE_CHANGE: The world is warming, and there may be serious consequences to come. Some polar ice has melted, and low-lying settlements may be at risk in the future. If the temperature rises further, additional coastal lowland may flood, eventually sinking beneath the waves. We may want to construct a Flood Barrier in our cities at risk. Climate change will also lead to worsening and more frequent storms and droughts that can even strip the land of earlier fertility gains. You can see information about the world's climate on the Climate Screen at any time.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_CONSUME_POWER_RESOURCE: Our people have created a new source of power. Even as they rejoice, plumes of smoke rise into the sky. By burning fuel, we are adding CO2 to the atmosphere. Continuing to do so will eventually warm the planet.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A warmer planet will cause sea levels to rise and coastal areas to flood. While this threat may happen in the future, you may want to consider how coastal flooding would affect your cities and civilization.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_STORM_REVEAL: The wind howls and rain lashes—A powerful Storm rages across the land! There is danger here, but opportunity as well.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Storm will pass across a number of tiles before dissipating. It will pillage or destroy Improvements and pillage Districts on any tile it crosses, but it might also increase the yields on the tile as a result.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_DAM_TECHNOLOGY_UNLOCK: Our people's discovery means we can regulate the flow of rivers and prevent even in a severe flood. You now have the ability to construct the Dam district.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You can build one Dam per river, which will prevent Floods along this River.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_CANAL_TECHNOLOGY_UNLOCK: Our people imagine a waterway where none exists yet, and this new discovery may allow them to build it. You now have the ability to construct Canals.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These allow naval units and trade caravans to pass through land. A Canal will improve the yield from any Trade Route that passes through it.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_WORLD_CONGRESS_CONVENE: Wise minds in many lands propose to solve disputes between civilizations through peaceful counsel. Shall we join the call for a World Congress?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The World Congress is an organization of all the civilizations of the world. Successfully using this organization is an essential part of the Diplomatic Victory.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_DISCUSSION_ACCEPT: Our eloquent arguments have convinced the other civilizations of the world, and our Discussion is accepted!
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_DISCUSSION_FAIL: Despite our pleas, we were unable to convince the other civilizations of the world of our cause. Our Discussion was rejected.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_INTERVENTION_AVAILABLE: We have an opportunity to request that players band together to address an Emergency.  Shall we propose this to World Congress?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When the conditions are met to trigger an Emergency, affected players can spend [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to request a Special Session of the World Congress, where players will vote if a Scored Competition should start to combat the situation.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_INTERVENTION_PROPOSED_AND_W: Another civilization has requested a Special Session of the World Congress to address an Emergency.  We have an Emergency of our own to discuss: shall we add it to the agenda?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In a single Special Session, multiple Emergencies may be discussed at once.  Once a Special Session has ended, another cannot be called until a certain number of turns have elapsed: if you want to propose a discussion, now is the time to do it.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_INTERVENTION_PASS: The World Congress has agreed that civilizations should band together in a common cause. We can work with the other civilizations to gain their approval, or we can choose not to participate in this Intervention.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_EMERGENCY_1_XP2: We have joined together with other civilizations against a larger threat.  If we succeed, we will be rewarded.  But should we fail in our mission, the enemy will become stronger.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_SCORED_COMPETITION_BEGUN: We are now facing other civilizations in a peaceful competition.  Who will prove the most capable in this activity?  If we perform well, we will walk away with powerful bonuses.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_DENOUNCED: Whether from frustration or malice, another civilization in the world is angry with our actions. They have Denounced us before the world to show their displeasure. They may be justifying a future war with us. We must beware.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_GENERATES_GRIEVANCE: We have opposed the will of another civilization, and have angered them. They have a Grievance against us, which may make it more difficult to work with them in the future.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_AI_GENERATES_GRIEVANCE: Another civilization's actions are an affront to our dignity. We have a Grievance against them, which may justify our actions against them to the other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_GAINS_FAVOR: The World Congress approves of our actions with regard to this Resolution. We have gained a Diplomatic Favor with the other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_CB_REVOKED: The World Congress has determined that our Casus Belli for our current war was not justified. We no longer claim diplomatic benefit from it. We must be cautious, lest we be isolated diplomatically.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_CIV_MAKES_REQUEST: Another Civilization in the world has made a formal Request to you. Your response to this diplomatic gesture in this pivotal moment will decide the future of your relationship with this Civilization.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Depending on how you respond to the Request and behave afterwards, other options may be available to this Civilization—including Casus Belli becoming available.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_PLAYER_ABLE_REQUEST: A political situation of importance has arisen involving another Civilization in the world. You may make a Request of another Civilization. These Requests represent pivotal moments in your relationship with the other Civilizations.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Depending on how the other Civilization responds, other diplomatic options may become available to you—including Casus Belli to justify a war with that Civilization.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_STRATEGIC_RESOURCE_AVAILABL: We have begun to accumulate a Strategic Resource! Our people know this new Resource may be essential for building certain military units and they will stockpile it for future use. We should manage our use of this Resource to make the most of it.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_UNIT_REQUIRES_FUEL_BUILT: We are now able to train a military unit that requires a strategic resource. If we do not keep an adequate supply of the resource in our stockpile, it will be much less effective in battle.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]These units will require a constant supply of resources. We should ensure we have supplies of those resources on hand.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_POWER_REQUIRED_BUILDABLE: Our wisest minds have developed plans to build a new device, but it will require a regular source of Power that is greater than human effort. We must develop a way to provide our cities with Power if we are to use it.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_DIRTY_POWER_AVAILABLE: We have learned of a method to supply Power to our city, but it will require us to burn Fuel. This source will produce smoke and pollution, so we must weigh the costs and benefits carefully.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_CLEAN_POWER_AVAILABLE: Excellent news! We have a new method of producing Power — one which will not pollute the world by burning Fuel. This will allow us to supply Power to our cities without risking damage to the environment.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_CITY_POWER_SHORTAGE: Work in this city proceeds fitfully, for the city is short of Power. If we do not have enough resources stockpiled, our units, cities, and civilization will not achieve their greatest potential.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]We should build a building that provides Power to this city.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_NEGATIVE_RESOURCE_RATE: There is greater demand for our Resources now, and our stockpiles are in danger of depletion. If this happens, our units will become much less effective.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If we run out of Resources, any unit that requires these Resources will be much less effective in combat. We may wish to consider building fewer units, or finding ways to make better use of the Resources we have.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_EXOPLANET_PROJECT_AVAILABLE: Our scientists and engineers believe they can construct a ship capable of carrying colonists to a new home on a distant world. To accomplish this feat would be the greatest technological achievement of human history, and would secure our civilization's place in history.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_EXOPLANET_SUPPORT_PROJECT_A: Our spaceship to settle a distant world has departed on its journey, but there are yet more opportunities available to help it on its way. We can construct additional projects that will speed the journey.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_FUTURE_ERA_IMMINENT: The mysteries of science and the questions of culture are still open to us, but now the connections between discoveries are tantalizingly dim. As our investigations proceed, the relationship between technologies and civics will reveal themselves in time.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_BUILD_ROUTE_MOUNTAIN_AVAILA: Mountains that brush the heavens might daunt others, but our people have the knowledge of ways to cross them. Crossing mountains will make travel easier for our units—as well as those of our foes.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_BUILD_RAILROAD_AVAILABLE: A Railroad is an expensive undertaking, but it will boost our trade power and the speed of our units along its line. We should consider where to build these.	Military Engineers will be required for the task.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_BUILD_ROCKBAND_AVAILABLE: Our civilization has the ability to recruit Rock Bands! These world-class performers can be purchased with Faith in a city. Send them on tour to distant lands to perform concerts and generate Tourism for our civilization.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_BUILD_COASTAL_LOWLANDS: Our people have chosen to create a city along the low coast, within the sound of the ocean's waves. But this is low land, and will flood if the sea level rises.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_WELCOME: Welcome to Civilization VI: Gathering Storm! This guide will introduce you to new features in this expansion. Additional information can be found in the Civilopedia and Advisor tips.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_WORLD_CONGRESS: The World Congress is where you make your voice heard amongst the other civilizations in the world. It is also an important part of the new Diplomatic Victory. Proposals are sent before the World Congress for vote, and come in two types: Resolutions and Discussions.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_WORLD_CONGRESS_DE: Resolutions affect all civilizations, such as banning a Luxury Resource or gaining extra [ICON_Amenities] Amenities from each copy of the resource.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Discussions are potential Scored Competitions or Emergencies that members of the World Congress may join, like World Games or a Religious Emergency.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Members can summon a Special Session if they have an Emergency they need addressed, like a request for aid after a natural disaster.
Resolutions affect all civilizations, such as banning a Luxury Resource or gaining extra [ICON_Amenities] Amenities from each copy of the resource.
Discussions are potential Scored Competitions or Emergencies that members of the World Congress may join, like World Games or a Religious Emergency.
Members can summon a Special Session if they have an Emergency they need addressed, like a request for aid after a natural disaster.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_FAVOR: [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor is a new form of currency in the game. Your diplomatic actions will earn you [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor that can be used in the World Congress to help you or hinder others.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_FAVOR_DETAILS: [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor can be earned through Alliances, City States of which you are the Suzerain, success in Scored Competitions, and more.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There are major and minor ways to gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor through a game.  Some actions will grant a large payout of Favor all at once, and some will grant it slowly over time.  Try trading for other players' Favor to strengthen your position in World Congress.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You can spend your [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to extract promises from other players, call Special Sessions of Congress, and buy votes in World Congress.  Or save up Diplomatic Favor throughout the game to pursue Diplomatic Victory Points in the later eras.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_FAVOR_DETAILS_1: [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor can be earned through Alliances, City States of which you are the Suzerain, success in Scored Competitions, and more.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_FAVOR_DETAILS_2: There are major and minor ways to gain [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor through a game.  Some actions will grant a large payout of Favor all at once, and some will grant it slowly over time.  Try trading for other players' Favor to strengthen your position in World Congress.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_FAVOR_DETAILS_3: You can spend your [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor to extract promises from other players, call Special Sessions of Congress, and buy votes in World Congress.  Or save up Diplomatic Favor throughout the game to pursue Diplomatic Victory Points in the later eras.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_DIPLO_VICTORY: Gather Diplomatic Victory Points to pursue the new Diplomatic Victory.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_DIPLO_VICTORY_DET: When World Congress meets, there will be a number of Resolutions available for determination.  When voting resolves, all players will receive a Diplomatic Victory Point for each Resolution for which they chose the winning target and option.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Starting in the Modern Era, players will be able to use their [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor in World Congress to compete for Diplomatic Victory Points.  Win the Resolution to bring yourself closer to victory, or to prevent other players from achieving their own.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Emergencies such as Aid Requests and World Games will provide Diplomatic Victory Points to the players who get the highest score.

When World Congress meets, there will be a number of Resolutions available for determination.  When voting resolves, all players will receive a Diplomatic Victory Point for each Resolution for which they chose the winning target and option.

Starting in the Modern Era, players will be able to use their [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor in World Congress to compete for Diplomatic Victory Points.  Win the Resolution to bring yourself closer to victory, or to prevent other players from achieving their own.
Emergencies such as Aid Requests and World Games will provide Diplomatic Victory Points to the players who get the highest score.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_GRIEVANCES: The previous Warmongering system has been replaced with a new representation of how other players view your warlike actions: [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_GRIEVANCES_DETAIL: Now, when other players wrong you by Denouncement, Declaration of War, or capturing or razing one of your cities, you gain [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against them and may retaliate in kind with the world's approval.  No longer will you be Denounced for a fair, punitive city capture after an unjustified war.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You may also use [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances to request Promises from other players.  If the other player continues to go against your wishes that you indicate in this manner, they will continually generate [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances that you can use to justify a war against them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But the world at large still pays attention to the overall [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances that other players have against you.  If you have grieved others more than they have grieved you, third-parties will notice, and it will impact their opinion of you.

Now, when other players wrong you by Denouncement, Declaration of War, or capturing or razing one of your cities, you gain [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against them and may retaliate in kind with the world's approval.  No longer will you be Denounced for a fair, punitive city capture after an unjustified war.

You may also use [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances to request Promises from other players.  If the other player continues to go against your wishes that you indicate in this manner, they will continually generate [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances that you can use to justify a war against them.

But the world at large still pays attention to the overall [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances that other players have against you.  If you have grieved others more than they have grieved you, third-parties will notice, and it will impact their opinion of you.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_ENVIRONMENT: In Civilization VI: Gathering Storm, the environment around you is more alive than ever before. Natural disasters like floods, storms, and volcanoes can pillage or destroy your Improvements and Districts—but they might refresh and enrich the lands after they pass.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_ENVIRONMENT_DETAI: From Blizzards to Dust Storms, from Tornadoes to Hurricanes, storms are another challenge to overcome.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Flooded rivers may damage your improvements, but they might improve the [ICON_Food] Food yield on a tile, too.
From Blizzards to Dust Storms, from Tornadoes to Hurricanes, storms are another challenge to overcome.
Flooded rivers may damage your improvements, but they might improve the [ICON_Food] Food yield on a tile, too.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_VOLCANOES: Volcanoes are high risk, but high reward, settlement locations. Volcanic eruptions can pillage or destroy improvements, districts, and buildings, and even kill or damage units. But volcanic soil is highly valuable and very fertile.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_GEOTHERMAL: Geothermal Fissures are new features that provide benefits to nearby buildings or districts like additional [ICON_Amenities] Amenities or [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_STRATEGIC_RESOURC: Strategic resources have been divided into two types: Fuel and Material. Fuel resources are used to meet the [ICON_Power] Power needs of your cities, whereas Material resources are required to produce resource-dependent units.
Manage the [ICON_Power] Power in your city to make late-game buildings more effective.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Trade Material Resources and Fuel with other civilizations.
Manage the [ICON_Power] Power in your city to make late-game buildings more effective.
Trade Material Resources and Fuel with other civilizations.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_RESOURCES: Your choices about resource usage will directly affect the world’s temperature, and can cause rising sea levels. Some coastal tiles will be at risk of becoming flooded or completely submerged. When settling cities, consider the risk of these coastal lowland tiles, but keep in mind that in the Atomic era, Flood Barriers can be used to protect these tiles.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_RESOURCES_DETAILS: Burning Fuel heats up the atmosphere, leading to melted ice caps and rising sea levels.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Your Settler will now tell you if you are building a city in low area near a coast.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Flood Barrier will help protect your city from the rising sea.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_RESOURCES_DETAIL_: Burning Fuel heats up the atmosphere, leading to melted ice caps and rising sea levels.
Your Settler will now tell you if you are building a city in low area near a coast.
The Flood Barrier will help protect your city from the rising sea.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_MORE: There is plenty more to explore in Civilization VI: Gathering Storm including new eras in the Technology and Civics Trees, new Historic Moments, new global units including the Giant Death Robot, leaders and civilizations that synergize with new systems, and more.
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_END: Will your civilization weather the gathering storm? How will you rule in Sid Meier's Civilization VI?
en_US.LOC_TUTORIAL_XP2_INTRO_END_DETAILS_1: You can always review this information by consulting the advisor, checking the Civilopedia, or reopening this tutorial in the Pause menu.
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_CITYPANEL_POWER_PLANTS: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Build a Power Plant in this city or a nearby city, and ensure you have a stockpile of the resource it uses ([ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal, [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil, or [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium)
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_CITYPANEL_HYDROELECTRIC_DAM: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Build a Dam district and a Hydroelectric Dam building
en_US.LOC_ADVISOR_CITYPANEL_RENEWABLE_ENERGY: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Research advanced technologies and construct tile improvements like the Solar Farm, Wind Farm, Offshore Wind Farm, or Geothermal Plant
en_US.LOC_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTION: This is a game using the Gathering Storm Expansion, which includes the World Congress, environmental effects and disasters, power, and more. Can you deal with the unpredictability of a changing world to make a civilization that will stand the test of time?
en_US.LOC_GAME_REALISM_DESCRIPTION: Set natural disaster intensity. Choose from a setting of 0 (no natural disasters) to 4 (frequent and intense natural disasters). Note that on settings of 3 and 4, severe volcanic eruptions may damage tiles two hexes away.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DIPLOMATIC_TT: You show the world that cooperation among nations is the only way to a lasting and just peace. Earn this victory through respect and the World Congress.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_DIPLOMATIC_TEXT: Harmony and peace replace war and violence. The differences and disagreements between people can always be resolved through goodwill. With conflict behind us, what glories will our shared future hold?
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CHOCOLATEHILLS_DESCRIPTION: Four tile natural wonder. It appears as a Hill and provides +3 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_DEVILSTOWER_DESCRIPTION: One tile impassable natural wonder. It provides +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_GOBUSTAN_DESCRIPTION: Three tile natural wonder. It provides +4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +4 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_IKKIL_DESCRIPTION: One tile impassable natural wonder. +50% [ICON_Production] Production when producing wonders and districts in adjacent tiles. It provides Fresh Water.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_PAMUKKALE_DESCRIPTION: Two tile impassable natural wonder. It provides +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity to the cities that own at least one tile of Pamukkale. Major adjacency bonus to Theater Square, Campus, and Commercial Hub districts. Additional standard adjacency bonus to the Holy Site district. Entertainment Complex provides +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity if adjacent to the Pamukkale. It provides Fresh Water.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_WHITEDESERT_DESCRIPTION: Four tile natural wonder. It provides +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +6 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_EYJAFJALLAJOKULL_XP2_DESCRIP: Two tile impassable natural wonder. It appears as a Volcano and provides +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food. On eruption it gives medium yields and is most likely to damage buildings and districts. Infrequently erupts, but is always active.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_CLIFFS_DOVER_XP2_DESCRIPTION: Two tile natural wonder that can be found on coastal terrain. It appears as Cliffs and provides +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Provides +4 Appeal to adjacent tiles instead of the usual +2.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_YOSEMITE_XP2_DESCRIPTION: Two tile impassable natural wonder. It appears as a Mountain and provides +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science to adjacent tiles.
en_US.LOC_FEATURE_EYE_OF_THE_SAHARA_XP2_DESCRI: Three tile natural wonder. Provides +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, and +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science.
en_US.LOC_MAP_CONTINENTS_ISLANDS_DESCRIPTION: A few large landmasses surrounded by islands.
en_US.LOC_MAP_PRIMORDIAL_DESCRIPTION: A map from early time with unpredictable continents and islands. More volatile conditions exist with extra coastal lowlands and volcanoes.
en_US.LOC_MAP_SPLINTERED_FRACTAL_DESCRIPTION: A highly random map that will often form thin, snaky continents and islands.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_FOUNDING_FATHERS_: All Diplomatic policy slots in the current [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government are converted to Wildcard slots.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor per turn for every Wildcard slot in their [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Grassland and Plains Mountain.
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_FILM_STUDIO_EXPANSION2_DESC: A building unique to America. +30% [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism pressure from this city towards other civilizations who reached the Modern era.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_AMERICAN_ROUGH_RIDER_EXPANSION2: American unique Industrial era unit that replaces Cuirassier when Teddy Roosevelt (Rough Rider) is their leader. Combat victories on their [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital's continent provide [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 25% of the [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength of the defeated unit (on Online speed). +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when fighting on Hills. Lower maintenance cost.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_ICE_HOCKEY_RINK_DESCRIPT: Canadian unique Builder improvement unlocked with Diplomatic Service. Can be built on Tundra, Tundra Hills, Snow, and Snow Hills. One per city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent Tundra, Tundra Hills, Snow, and Snow Hills tile.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity and +2 Appeal to adjacent tiles.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food and [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Professional Sports.[NEWLINE]+4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if adjacent to a Stadium building.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from Culture once Flight is unlocked.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_FACES_OF_PEACE_DE: Cannot declare war on City-States or surprise wars. Surprise wars cannot be declared on Canada.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For every 100 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per turn earn 1 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor per turn. Receive +100% [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor from successfully completing an Emergency or Scored Competition.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Tundra.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_LAST_BEST_WEST_DESCRIPT: City Centers in Tundra receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Farms can be constructed in Tundra. After Civil Engineering is unlocked, Farms can be built on Tundra Hills. Improvements in Tundra and Snow receive the following bonuses: Mines and Lumber Mills +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, Farms and Camps +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food. Receive double the normal accumulation rate for Strategic Resources improved in tundra and snow. -50% of the normal cost to purchase Snow and Tundra tiles.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_CANADA_MOUNTIE_DESCRIPTION: Canadian unique Modern era unit. Has Sight of 4. Can create 2 National Parks. +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when fighting within 4 tiles of a National Park. Additional +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when fighting within 4 tiles of an Owned National Park.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_INDUSTRIAL_REVOLU: [ICON_RESOURCE_IRON] Iron and [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal Mines accumulate 2 more resources per turn. Harbor buildings increase Strategic Resource Stockpiles by +10 (on Standard speed). +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Military Engineers. Military Engineers receive +2 [ICON_CHARGES] charges.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast, T5 Iron and Coal.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_PAX_BRITANNICA_EX: Cities settled 10 or more tiles from your capital receive a free melee unit. Constructing Royal Navy Dockyard grants you the strongest naval unit you can build. Naval melee units may escort civilian units at their higher movement speed. Gain the Redcoat unique unit when the Military Science technology is researched.[NEWLINE]Lighthouse grants +1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] Great Admiral point per turn.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_ITERU_EXPANSION2_: +15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards [ICON_DISTRICT] districts and wonders if placed next to a River. Does not receive damage from Floods.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T2 Floodplains, T5 Rivers
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_ELEANOR_LOYALTY_DESCRIP: +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Theater Square Buildings. +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Ancient and Classical wonders (French Eleanor only).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Works receive additional yields based on the districts built in this city (+1 for [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Writings and [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] Relics, +2 for [ICON_GREATWORK_LANDSCAPE] Art and [ICON_GREATWORK_ARTIFACT] Artifacts, +4 for [ICON_GREATWORK_MUSIC] Music):[NEWLINE][ICON_SCIENCE] Science for Campus.[NEWLINE][ICON_CULTURE] Culture for Theater Square.[NEWLINE][ICON_GOLD] Gold for Harbor or Commercial Hub.	[NEWLINE][ICON_FAITH] Faith for Holy Site.[NEWLINE][ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for Industrial Zone.[NEWLINE][ICON_FOOD] Food for Neighborhood.[NEWLINE](Can't receive bonus yields on great works from Anshan)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Works in Eleanor's cities each cause -1 Loyalty per turn in foreign cities within 9 tiles. A city that leaves another civilization due to a loss of Loyalty and is currently receiving the most Loyalty per turn from Eleanor's civilization skips the Free City step to join this civilization.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_GOLDEN_AGE_QUESTS: When making Dedications at the beginning of a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age, receive the [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age bonus towards improving Era Score in addition to the other bonus.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards walls.
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_THERMAL_BATH_DESCRIPTION: A building unique to Hungary. +2 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities and +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production extends to each city center within 6 tiles. These bonuses apply once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]This city receives +3 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism and +2 additional [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities if there is at least one Geothermal Fissure in this city's borders.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_PEARL_DANUBE_DESC: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to [ICON_DISTRICT] Districts and Buildings constructed directly across a river from a City Center.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Rivers, T5 Geothermal Fissures.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_RAVEN_KING_DESCRIPTION: Levied units gain an ability giving them +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. It cost 75% less [ICON_GOLD] Gold and resources to upgrade Levied units. If you Levy troops from a City-state, receive 1 [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys with that City-state. Gain the Black Army unique unit when the Castles technology is researched.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_HUNGARY_BLACK_ARMY_DESCRIPTION: Hungarian unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Courser. +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength from each adjacent Levied unit.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_HUNGARY_HUSZAR_DESCRIPTION: Hungarian unique Industrial era unit that replaces Cavalry. +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength from every City-state of which you are suzerain.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_GREAT_MOUNTAINS_D: Citizens can work Mountain tiles. Mountain tiles provide +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, increasing to +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production after you reach the Industrial Era, and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Terrace Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cities do not suffer penalties on non-food yields for being negative amenities.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Grassland and Plains Mountains. Special "Mountain Lover".
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_TERRACE_FARM_DESCRIPTION: Incan unique builder improvement available at the start of the game. Can be placed on Grassland Hills, Plains Hills, Desert Hills, or Volcanic Soil.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Mountain.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every 2 adjacent Terrace Farms, increasing to +1 Food for every Terrace Farm with Replaceable Parts.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if adjacent to Fresh Water and not an Aqueduct.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for each adjacent Aqueduct.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_INCA_WARAKAQ_DESCRIPTION: Incan unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Skirmisher. Stronger at ranged combat than the Skirmisher and +1 additional attack per turn.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_PACHACUTI_QHAPAQ_NAN_DE: Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes gain +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every Mountain tile in the origin city. International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes gain +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every Mountain tile in the origin city. -50% of the normal [ICON_GOLD] Gold cost to purchase Mountain tiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain the Qhapaq Ñan improvement with Foreign Trade. Recon units gain +1 [ICON_CHARGES] build charge to build a Qhapaq Ñan.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MOUNTAIN_ROAD_DESCRIPTIO: Unlocks the Builder ability to construct a Qhapaq Ñan, unique to Pachacuti.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Acts as a movement portal on a mountain range, allowing units to move into it and exit from another portal at the cost of 2 [ICON_Movement] Movement. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination. Can only be built on an adjacent Mountain tile. Cannot be pillaged or removed.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_MALI_GOLD_DESERT_: -15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in all cities.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food on all featureless Desert tiles other than City Centers.[NEWLINE]Your capital and any cities settled on Desert tiles gain +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE]Farms can be constructed in Desert. After Civil Engineering is unlocked, Farms can be built on Desert Hills.[NEWLINE]Mines on desert tiles grant +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Desert, T5 Minable Resources.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_SAHEL_MERCHANTS_DESCRIP: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity after Banking. Holy Sites grant major adjacency to Sugubas instead of standard adjacency. +15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Holy Sites and their buildings.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_SUGUBA_DESCRIPTION: A district unique to Mali that replaces the Commercial Hub. Units, Buildings, and Districts are 20% cheaper to purchase with [ICON_GOLD] Gold and [ICON_FAITH] Faith in this City.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Standard adjacency from Holy Sites. +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold bonus from a tile containing a City Center, River Edge, or an Oasis. +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold bonus for every two adjacent district tiles.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MALI_MANDEKALU_CAVALRY_DESCRIPT: Mali unique Medieval Era unit that replaces the Knight. Trader units are immune to being plundered if they are within 4 tiles of a Mandekalu Cavalry and on a land tile. Combat victories provide [ICON_GOLD] Gold equal to 50% of that unit's base [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength (on Online speed).
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_MAORI_MANA_DESCRI: Embarked units gain +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement with Ship Building. Fishing Boats Culture Bomb adjacent tiles and provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food with Celestial Navigation. Resources cannot be harvested. [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writers cannot be earned.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unimproved Woods and Rainforest tiles gain:[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Early Empire.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Mercantilism.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Conservation.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_KUPES_VOYAGE_DESCRIPTIO: Settlers can embark after researching the Sailing technology. The Palace grants +3 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_MARAE_DESCRIPTION: A building unique to the Māori. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and [ICON_FAITH] Faith to all of this city's tiles with a passable feature or natural wonder. After Flight is researched receive +1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism to all of this city's tiles with a feature or natural wonder. Costs no maintenance. Has no Great Work slots.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_MAORI_TOA_DESCRIPTION: Māori unique Classical era melee unit. Adjacent enemy units receive -5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength. Has 1 [ICON_CHARGES] charge to build Pā improvement.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_MAORI_PA_DESCRIPTION: Maori unique improvement built by the Toa.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Occupying units receive +1 Sight and +4 [ICON_STRENGTH] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification. A Māori unit occupying a Pā heals even if they just moved or attacked. Must be built on a Hill tile.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_GROTE_RIVIEREN_EX: Major adjacency bonus for Campuses, Theater Squares, and Industrial Zones if next to a river.[NEWLINE]Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Harbor.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_Production] Production toward the Dam district and Flood Barrier building.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T2 Rivers, T3 Coast.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_GREAT_TURKISH_BOM: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward siege units. All siege units gain +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.[NEWLINE]Conquered cities do not lose [ICON_CITIZEN] population. Cities not founded by the Ottomans gain +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity and +4 Loyalty per turn.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rivers, T5 Niter.
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_GRAND_BAZAAR_DESCRIPTION: A building unique to the Ottomans that replaces the Bank. Accumulate 1 extra Strategic resource for every different type of Strategic resource this city has improved. Receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity for every Luxury resource this city has improved. Grants a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor Title when constructed for the first time.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade route capacity.[NEWLINE]+6 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each [ICON_TRADEROUTE] trade route from this city.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each [ICON_TRADEROUTE] trade routes to this city.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant points per turn.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_OTTOMAN_BARBARY_CORSAIR_DESCRIP: Ottoman unique Medieval era naval unit that replaces the Privateer. Can enter Ocean tiles regardless of researched Technologies. It costs no [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement to coastal raid. Can only be seen by other Naval Raiders unless adjacent to it. Reveals Naval Raiders within sight range.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SULEIMAN_JANISSARY_DESCRIPTION: Ottoman unique Renaissance Era unit that replaces the Musketman. Starts with a [ICON_PROMOTION] free promotion. Stronger and cheaper than the Musketman. To train a Janissary a city must have a population of at least 2. If a city is founded by the Ottomans and trains a Janissary it loses a population.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_MEDITERRANEAN_COL: Begin the game with the Writing technology [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka. Coastal cities founded by Phoenicia and located on the same continent as the Phoenician [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital are 100% Loyal. Settlers gain +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and +2 sight range while embarked. Settlers ignore additional [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement costs from embarking and disembarking.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_FOUNDER_CARTHAGE_DESCRI: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity for each Government Plaza building. +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward [ICON_DISTRICT] districts in the city with the Government Plaza.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_COTHON_DESCRIPTION: A district unique to Phoenicia for naval activity in your city. Replaces the Harbor district and cheaper to build. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards naval units and Settlers in this city.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_PHOENICIA_BIREME_DESCRIPTION: Phoenician unique Ancient Era unit that replaces the Galley. Increased [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and [ICON_Movement] Movement. Trader units are immune to being plundered if they are within 4 tiles of a Bireme and on a water tile.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_DHARMA_EXPANSION2: Receives Follower Belief bonuses in a city from each Religion that has at least 1 Follower. Cities gain +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity if they follow your majority religion. Missionaries have +2 spreads. +100% Religious pressure from your [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_STEPWELL_EXPANSION2_DESC: Indian unique builder improvement unlocked with Irrigation.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food, +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith with Feudalism.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Farm.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith if adjacent to a Holy Site district.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing with Sanitation.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cannot be built on Hills or adjacent to another Stepwell.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_DIVINE_WIND_EXPANSION2_: Land units receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength in land tiles adjacent to Coast; naval units receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength in shallow water tiles. Units do not receive damage from Hurricanes. Civilizations that are at war with Japan receive +100% unit damage from Hurricanes in Japanese territory.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Theater Square, Holy Site, and Encampment districts.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_SATYAGRAHA_EXPANSION2_D: Grants an extra belief when founding a [ICON_RELIGION] Religion. +5 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each civilization (including India) they have met that has founded a Religion and is not currently at war.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Settlers and Builders produced in cities with a [ICON_DISTRICT_HOLYSITE] Holy Site receive +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. Opposing civilizations receive +50% war weariness for fighting against Gandhi.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_LEADER_FIRST_EMPEROR_EXPANSION: Builder receive an additional [ICON_CHARGES] charge. When building Ancient and Classical Wonders you may spend Builder [ICON_CHARGES] charge to complete 15% of the Wonder [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost. +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food per wonder built in each city. Canals are unlocked with the Masonry technology.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When completing a wonder receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration from the era of the wonder if available.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_BATH_EXPANSION2_DESCRIPTION: A district unique to Rome for city growth. Replaces the Aqueduct district and cheaper to build.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 [ICON_Housing] Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity. In all cases the Bath provides an additional bonus of +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing and +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity. Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_MOTHER_RUSSIA_EXP: Extra territory upon founding cities. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Tundra tiles.[NEWLINE]Units do not receive damage from Blizzards. Civilizations that are at war with Russia receive +100% unit damage from Blizzards in Russian territory.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Tundra.
en_US.LOC_TRAIT_CIVILIZATION_NOBEL_PRIZE_DESCR: Sweden gains 20 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor (on Standard speed) when earning a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person. Having Sweden in the game adds three unique World Congress competitions starting in the Renaissance Era.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Libraries, Workshops, Universities, Factories and Government Plaza buildings.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer point from Factories.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist point from Universities.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATWRITER] Great Writer points from tier 1 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATARTIST] Great Artist points from tier 2 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] Great Muscician points from tier 3 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: Special "King of the North"
en_US.LOC_IMPROVEMENT_OPEN_AIR_MUSEUM_DESCRIPT: Swedish unique builder improvement unlocked with Diplomatic Service. Limited to one per city. Tiles with Open-Air Museums cannot be swapped.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +2 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism for each type of terrain (Snow, Tundra, Desert, Plains or Grassland) in which at least one Swedish city is founded.[NEWLINE]+2 Loyalty per turn in this city.
en_US.LOC_BUILDING_QUEENS_BIBLIOTHEQUE_DESCRIP: A building unique to Sweden. +6 Great Work slots (any type). This building is not mutually exclusive with other buildings in Government Plaza.[NEWLINE]Awards +1 [Icon_Governor] Governor Title.
en_US.LOC_UNIT_SWEDEN_CAROLEAN_DESCRIPTION: Swedish unique Renaissance Era unit that replaces the Pike and Shot. Faster than the Pike and Shot. +3 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength per unused [ICON_Movement] Movement.
en_US.LOC_ERA_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION: The world contains marvels beyond the dreams of ancient prophets, and terrors more fearsome than any apocalypse. Machines search for meaning and new matter weaves dream-like forms. Choices made long ago bear grave consequences in this age and demand resolute answers. Go now, and achieve your vision for the future of civilization.
en_US.LOC_VICTORY_SCIENCE_TT_XP2: Be the first to complete the Exoplanet Expedition to another star system to win a Science victory. This victory is straight-forward, but can be difficult to achieve before time runs out.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_WATER_STREET_CARNIVAL_EXPAN: A district unique to Brazil that doesn't cost a district population slot and is not a specialty district. Replaces the Water Park district, and provides +2 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities. Cannot be built in a city with a Street Carnival. Cannot be built on Reef.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity when underway and a earns [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer, [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant, [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician points upon completion.
en_US.LOC_DISTRICT_STREET_CARNIVAL_EXPANSION2_: A district unique to Brazil that doesn't cost a district population slot and is not a specialty district. Replaces the Entertainment Complex district, and provides +2 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities.  Cannot be built in a city with a Copacabana.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity when underway and a earns [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer, [ICON_GreatMerchant] Great Merchant, [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician points upon completion.
